「예수께서 전하신 좋은 소식」 드라마를 생각해 보십시오.
부활된 사람들에게 하느님의 아들에 관해 가르치기에 정말 좋은 도구가 아닙니까?
여러 해 전에 「파수대」에서는 끝이 올 때
하느님의 백성이 어떻게 활동하고 있을지에 대해 이렇게 설명해 주었습니다.
그 파수대 기사의 내용을 읽어 드리죠.
“주 예수께서 심판을 집행하기 위해 오시는 일은 전적으로 뜻밖에,
심지어 여호와의 백성에게도 뜻밖이 될 것입니다.
틀림없이 그들이 가장 바쁘게 활동하고 있을 때에 오실 것이기 때문입니다.”
따라서 끝은 우리가 매우 바쁘게 활동하고 있을 때 올 것입니다.
만약 이 두 프로젝트가 끝나기 전에 끝이 온다면 우리는 이렇게 말할 것입니다.
하지만 우리는 끝이 올 때까지 여호와의 도움과 지원을 받아 계속 바쁘게 일할 것입니다.
왕은 화살을 집고 땅을 세 번 친 뒤 멈췄습니다.
열정과 열심이 없는 태도를 좋아하지도, 축복하지도 않으시기 때문입니다.
따라서 우리는 끝이 올 때까지 열심히 부지런히 일하기를 원합니다.
지금까지 들으신 것처럼 여러분이 계속 지원하고 기도해 주신 덕분에
놀라운 일들이 빠른 속도로 진행되고 있습니다.
거대한 하늘 수레를 타고 계시고 인도하시는 그분께 정말 감사드리고
우리는 여호와의 성령의 인도를 받아 계속 전진하고 있습니다!

en.text: Second Samuel 15:1
tells us that Absalom,
who was trying to usurp the throne,
had a royal chariot built for himself.
It was pulled by majestic horses.
Fifty men ran ahead of that chariot.
Now, as impressive
as that chariot and rider may have seemed to many,
compared to the celestial chariot
mentioned in Ezekiel chapter 1,
Absalom’s chariot would be a sluggish,
minuscule rattletrap.
As we know, that chariot mentioned in Ezekiel chapter 1
represents the heavenly part
of Jehovah’s organization.
Who is the rider of this chariot?
Jehovah himself.
Why is he depicted this way?
Well, Jehovah lovingly controls
the movements of his organization
to accomplish his will and purpose.
No wonder Ezekiel 1:18
describes the rims of the wheels of the chariot
as having “eyes all around”!
All-seeing Jehovah directs everything.
What is the speed of Jehovah’s chariot?
Absalom’s chariot may have been able to reach speeds
of up to 45 miles an hour (72 km/hr)
—the speed of a racehorse.
But what about Jehovah’s chariot?
Well, in the Bible in verse 14 of chapter 1,
it describes its movements
in comparison with “flashes of lightning.”
Now, a flash of lightning
travels at 186,000 miles per second (300,000 km/sec),
the speed of light.
But if we think about it, Jehovah’s chariot is a lot faster than that.
In fact, we could say
it travels at the speed of thought,
at the speed of Jehovah’s thought.
And obviously that would be immeasurably fast.
Now, we can’t see into the invisible realm
and see how Jehovah is using the heavenly part of his organization
with lightning speed to accomplish his will and purpose,
but we can see how fast things are moving
in the visible part of Jehovah’s organization.
And that only makes sense —doesn’t it?—
because the earthly part is closely related to the heavenly
and is actually a reflection
of the heavenly part of Jehovah’s organization.
Now, the foregoing discussion
brings us to what Brother Cook mentioned
are updates of two fast-moving projects
that Jehovah obviously is directing,
and we’re going to get brought up to speed.
You like the way I used that —right?—
up to speed, since we’re talking about moving.
But things are happening,
and Jehovah certainly is directing matters.
And, as mentioned,
we’re going to have an update regarding the audio/video facility
being built at Ramapo, New York.
Now, you’ll probably recall
that it’s being built on property that the organization already owned.
And it’s conveniently located only two miles (3 km)
from our world headquarters facility at Warwick.
And a very interesting side point is
the Governing Body tried for several years (really hard)
to sell this property
with absolutely no results.
Then we came to realize
that this is ideal property
to build a much-needed facility
that can consolidate onto one site
the functions currently being done on many different properties
—one site to produce
our audio/video and beautiful artwork.
So this is just another example of Jehovah’s eyes seeing things.
In fact, we think of his words in Psalm 32.
Please go there—Psalm 32:8.
Jehovah says: “I will give you insight
“and instruct you in the way you should go.
“I will give you advice
with my eye upon you.”
Jehovah is obviously lovingly directing things.
But I’m sure you’d like to see this video now
that will give you an update
on what is happening there at Ramapo.
So enjoy the video.
The specific purpose of the Ramapo project
is to bring all media facilities
under one roof.
As a project begins, we always want things to move fast.
But sometimes the reality is
that it doesn’t happen as fast
as we would like it to.
It’s been several years
of some pretty dynamic planning,
and we’ve seen a lot of twists and turns
and changes along the way.
We’ve had a number of challenges
on the Ramapo project.
In the state of New York,
there’s only a certain season when you can take trees down.
We’re only allowed to remove trees
between November and the end of March.
The town board approved the special permit for us to be able to cut the trees.
However, when we went to exercise that permit,
we realized that another agency
still had to give their permission for us to be able to use it,
which we didn’t get.
Originally we had planned
about 12 weeks to do all of this work.
And that 12 weeks included using mechanized equipment.
If that wasn’t accomplished, we would be waiting an entire year
to be able to cut those trees.
Well, the window started closing from 12 weeks to 8 weeks
all the way down to 6 weeks.
And then somehow, something in the permitting language
opened our eyes to a new possibility
that allowed us to take the trees down in a different way.
We got permission to cut the trees,
but we had to cut the trees all by hand.
And in four weeks,
we used an outside contractor
to take down all the trees that we needed . . .
. . . two weeks early of the end of the tree-cutting season.
Every single day there’s still much work to be done
to get us the needed permits.
The design is continuing,
and the estimating for the project is continuing.
That hasn’t stopped.
That hasn’t slowed up one bit.
Because of some of the delays that we experienced,
there was a need to reassign some of our brothers and sisters
within the organization.
We had these willing volunteers.
They were skilled; they were trained; they were willing to do whatever was needed,
but we just didn’t have the work for them at the time.
We were able to communicate with different departments
in the branch and at headquarters.
And it just so happened that many of these departments
had been praying for additional help.
The brothers had a meeting with us, and they said:
“We know you’re not 100 percent busy like you want to be.
“We’ll be giving a number of you new assignments.
“Most of you will go out for a while
while we get our permits and come back.”
They said that I would be going into CDE,
and I didn’t even know what that was: Computer Department Engineering.
And I thought: ‘That’s way above me.
I’m a construction girl.’
But actually, I’ve loved it.
I’ve learned so much.
And the team that I’ve worked with,
I’ve gotten close to them, and it’s been a wonderful change.
It’s really shown us that Jehovah is going to take care of us.
For us to be at Ramapo
was one of the most amazing privileges we’ve ever had.
But we’re still working for Jehovah
and right in the center of his organization.
These brothers and sisters are real men and women of faith,
helping to advance Kingdom interests in all these other areas.
Obviously, when we hit some of these points where maybe we were waiting on approvals,
the work did not stop.
The time has allowed us to work with the Bethel departments,
to work with the Governing Body committees,
to work with our outside expert audio/video design teams.
And so because of that, the buildings themselves have changed.
It was looked into. How could flexible spaces be created?
And also how could some of these spaces be shared
maybe between different departments
to make the best use of the property that we have?
The Art Department will be in the same building
with the other aspects of media
—the audio part and the video part—
so that when we need to collaborate,
it will be much easier to work together
and we can make the very best possible product.
It’s a state-of-the-art audio/video and art production facility.
The process of designing that and getting it to stay ahead
of not only the ever-changing technologies that we see in the industry
but also the needs for the organization
is a dynamic process.
The facility has been designed
and will be constructed in such a way
that if modifications need to be made later
to keep up with technology,
we won’t have to deconstruct the building
in order to implement those changes.
We’ve developed beautiful studios
that will be functional not only now
but also for future projects.
One exciting feature of the media center
will be the use of video walls for virtual production.
In fact, we’ve already begun filming with this new technology here at Patterson.
With these video walls,
we can create digital backgrounds
that can be used to give the appearance
that we are shooting it in a foreign location.
The Governing Body made it very clear that their focus
was the spirituality of those
who are involved in our productions.
If the friends have to be off-site for long periods of time filming,
it can really disrupt their spiritual routine.
Virtual production will allow us to reduce the need to travel
or to even work hours
that could interfere with spiritual activities.
There are some circumstances that arise
that can sometimes limit our ability to travel to another location.
But with the use of the video wall, we won’t be stopped.
Video production will continue in the studio.
Now we’ll be able to custom-make some backgrounds
that actually look like Bible lands.
And we’re very confident that with Jehovah’s blessing,
this new state-of-the-art facility
will result in tremendous savings and efficiency
as we continue to produce
beautiful videos and artwork
to the benefit of the brotherhood.
But now, that video you saw
was actually a while back, a little time ago.
We have some late-breaking news events
to share with you since then.
When you saw in the video the trees cut down,
they were just lying haphazardly —weren’t they?—
with snow on the top.
But since then,
contractors have been very busy
removing the trees, taking them out,
and clearing the site in preparation
for other work that will come.
And all of this is preceding this huge construction project
that is looming just ahead.
So we captured some of that work,
and we also are bringing you up-to-date
with a flyover video clip.
So we want to show you this now
so that it’ll bring you even further up-to-date
as to how things are looking.
So you saw the trees being removed;
you saw them carving out the entrance there in the hillside.
So a lot of exciting things are happening.
Now, soon contractors are going to begin blasting away
large underground rock formations
to prepare the site for further site work.
And according to our current time schedule
—and I think you’ll be interested to know this—
in the late summer of 2024
(just a few months from now),
Jehovah willing, with Jehovah’s blessing,
we’re going to call in many more volunteers
to help us to move this project forward speedily.
But dear brothers and sisters,
please remember to pray
for Jehovah’s blessing on these efforts.
But now, as we said, we have another update,
and that’s concerning the exciting project
that is going on in Australia.
As you know, it’s the series of dramas entitled
The Good News According to Jesus.
Please enjoy this video update.
Now we’ll be able to custom-make
some backgrounds that actually look
like Bible lands.
And so The Good News According to Jesus  project
is the perfect candidate for the use of virtual production.
A video wall will be installed and ready for use
at the Australasia branch in early 2024.
There are many formats out there in the world
of Jesus’ life and how it’s depicted.
But our film is so accurate.
The research and effort that’s gone into it
has made it so close to the Bible;
it’s going to make such a difference.
They’re going to see Jesus and what he was truly like.
It’s going to affect hearts,
and it’s really going to help them
to see Jehovah as well.
As we’ve been working
with The Good News According to Jesus  project,
we’ve run into a few challenges, to say the least.
Right from the start, we had fires,
we had floods, and we had a pandemic.
Because of a number of restrictions that were taking place at the time,
things were delayed.
There even came a point when it just completely stopped.
But we did wonder how
we were going to be able to produce this video
in the time frames that we needed to do so.
We had to pick and choose which scenes that we had to shoot first
because construction was trying to keep up with our film schedule.
So trying to manage those two together was quite difficult.
Some of the challenges also are depicting miracles.
How are you going to depict some of the various illnesses and diseases?
How do we film scenes like the miraculous catch of fish
and Jesus walking on water
in a realistic way?
It’s a weighty responsibility,
but there’s also the amazing joy of being able to learn
more about Jesus
just through the process
of trying to put it on film.
The Bible accounts that we’re trying to depict
involve a lot of animals.
We know it was part of the culture at the time.
So we’re really trying to incorporate that into this production.
We’ve had donkeys,
sheep,
pigeons,
and even camels here at the branch on set.
They need to be trained to work with actors
and trained to be ridden.
They need to be familiarized with the sets.
You actually start to see a bond established
between the animals and the actors.
Fortunately, many of our brothers and sisters
that work in farmlands in rural Australia
had many of these animals that they were willing to make available for us.
There’s a sister in a nearby rural congregation
who has volunteered to help raise
the pigeons that we’re going to use in the temple scenes and other areas.
The sheep love to be around kids,
and they love to be around the cast members.
And it really does make a difference.
All of those animals essentially lend themselves
to the realism of the sets that we’re in
and help bring the Bible accounts to life.
So one particular episode
required the Judean wilderness.
After reviewing a few options here within the country of Australia,
we saw that it wasn’t as feasible as we would have liked for it to be.
After presenting the information to our brothers in oversight,
we got a response that we didn’t anticipate.
They came back asking, “What about Israel?”
A small crew traveled to Israel
and actually filmed in the real Judean wilderness.
The local branch office provided support,
a number of scenes were filmed,
and now when we’re reviewing the material,
we see Jehovah blessing that arrangement.
The back lot is a huge film set.
It has five historical areas:
We have the temple area and the temple slab;
Jerusalem area;
there’s Cana of Galilee;
then there’s Capernaum, including a little beach area;
and Nazareth.
The back lot has roads and mounds
—just landscapes so that we can have a variety of filming.
It was designed in a way where you can point the camera anywhere.
So it just helps you immerse yourself into the story and the life of Jesus.
This is a world that you’ve never seen before.
What’s different about those sets there in Australia
than what we’re typically using here is
they have to last a lot longer.
To cover the entire span of the Gospel accounts
requires many, many years of recording.
The brothers and sisters have shown amazing skill,
and they’ve worked through some very challenging conditions.
We’ve had heat, we’ve had rain,
it’s been dusty out here,
and it’s been muddy at times, but they’ve worked through all of it.
And whilst the end product is this beautiful set,
it’s going to bring the ministry of Jesus Christ to life
in an incredibly realistic way.
While construction was going,
a contractor came in to the back lot to see the construction brothers.
He spoke to one of the brothers
and in tears asked what this was all about.
And we explained what we’re trying to achieve.
And with tears, he said, “I come from Israel,
and this looks just like my home.”
Seeing someone who has no idea about this project
come in and say how accurate it was
really shows me how Jehovah is really looking after this project.
It isn’t any one of us that have made this a success;
it’s Jehovah the whole way.
As we study these Bible accounts
and figure out ways to bring them to life on the screen,
it’s teaching us to get into the motivations of who these people were.
Our goal is to take them from being just characters
in black and white on the printed page
into real people whom you’re going to know
and love for the rest of your life.
Roll camera! Roll audio!
And action!
When we recount
the tremendous amount of work that is being done
to visually portray, or depict,
the Gospels of Jesus’ life and ministry, we’re thrilled.
We’re absolutely amazed.
And all of this work and investment
is not just for one convention drama.
In fact, this production sets us up
for convention dramas for years to come in the future.
And you’re going to truly enjoy them as they’re rolled out.
But now, when we think about these dramas,
these episodes,
you probably want to know:
‘When am I going to get to see the first episode?
When?’
Well, you’ll be happy to know
that next year,
we’re going to have them portrayed
into the convention program as two dramas
—that is, Episode 1 will be two dramas
at the 2024 convention,
the regional and the special conventions.
You’ll enjoy them, indeed.
In fact, we’ve prepared a preview
of those two convention dramas,
and I think you’ll enjoy this short preview.
I know it’s really early to show you something
for the 2024 convention,
and I hope I don’t get into trouble
with the Governing Body for showing this prematurely.
Just kidding!
I hope you don’t think I’m that stupid.
It is with the Governing Body’s full blessing and approval
that we show you this.
So please enjoy
this Governing-Body-approved teaser
for these two dramas.
Seeing that many have undertaken
to compile an account of the facts,
I resolved also,
because I have traced all things
from the start with accuracy.
Do not be afraid, Mary.
You will become pregnant
and give birth to a son,
and you are to name him Jesus.
Let Jehovah be praised,
the God of Israel,
because he has turned his attention to his people
and has brought them deliverance.
For look!
I am declaring to you good news.
For today
there was born to you
in David’s city a savior,
who is Christ the Lord.
Look!
Jehovah’s slave girl!
May it happen to me according to your declaration.
The true light
that gives light
to every sort of man
was about to come into the world.
The dramas over the next several years
will have this kind of realism
and will truly bring the Gospel account to life
—The Good News According to Jesus.
Now, what you saw was just
a two-and-a-half-minute teaser video,
a little video.
But as we mentioned, we’re going to—
And that was just for Episode 1,
but we are actively, speedily,
fast-movingly preparing more episodes.
In fact, you’ll be happy to know that we’re working right now
on the next four episodes
after the two that
—the one, really, teaser of the one— you saw.
Four more are being worked on,
and Episode 3 is almost totally finished.
We’ve almost got Episode 3 done.
The Governing Body has already been reviewing Episode 1
and an early edition of Episode 2.
And how powerful indeed they are!
And I know personally I can say that I’ve been inspired;
I’ve been motivated
and even brought to the point of tears several times.
And other Governing Body brothers and helpers were affected similarly.
The realism, the impact,
and the power is absolutely amazing.
Well, we’re confident that you appreciate receiving
these two very important updates
concerning significant fast-moving projects.
And the Governing Body wants to keep you fully informed.
They really want you to be up-to-date
because we need your prayers, we need your support,
and we want you to know what is happening.
And we’re confident that with Jehovah’s blessing,
this is going to be something
that’s going to benefit the spiritual brotherhood
in a tremendous and profound way.
And we’re just so anxious to be able to give you more of this,
even though we gave you what we could now.
But some might ask:
“Why are we embarking
“on two projects like this
“when the new world is so close?
“We might not even finish one of them.
The end may come.”
Well, we just don’t know, do we?
We don’t know exactly when the end is going to come.
Here’s an illustration:
How many carefully selected smooth stones
did David take out when he went to fight Goliath?
He took five, didn’t he?
How many did he need?
One.
He just didn’t know, did he?
So he was prepared for whatever it took.
Well, in the same way, we don’t know when the end is going to come.
Now, here’s another thought, food for thought:
Could not these projects, if needed,
be finished after the great tribulation
and then be used powerfully in the new world?
And thinking of The Good News According to Jesus  episodes,
would they not be wonderful tools
to teach resurrected ones about God’s Son?
Well, only Jehovah knows.
Time will tell.
But what did The Watchtower  say some years ago
about the activity
of Jehovah’s people right when the end would come?
Here’s what it said; let me read you this quote.
It said:
“The arrival of the Lord Jesus to execute judgment
“will come as a complete surprise
“—even to Jehovah’s people,
for it will no doubt find them at their busiest time of activity!”
So we’re going to be surprised.
We’re going to be very busy when the end comes.
And we say— If the end comes
before we finish either one of these projects,
then we say: “Hallelujah!
Praise Jah!”
But we’re going to be busy right up until the end
—Jehovah with his help and his support.
And you think of the scripture
at 2 Kings 13:18.
Jehovah was not at all pleased
with King Jehoash.
Remember, he took the arrows,
he struck the ground three times, and then he stopped.
Why?
Because Jehovah does not like
—and he doesn’t bless— a lack of zeal and enthusiasm.
So we want to make sure we’re zealously working
right up until the end comes.
Well, in conclusion,
we say with your continued support
and prayers in our behalf,
fast-moving and amazing things are happening
in the earthly part of Jehovah’s organization.
And we give all thanks to Jehovah,
that great celestial chariot Rider.
We give thanks to him,
and we give thanks to the heavenly part of his organization.
How we appreciate
the direction we are receiving
by means of holy spirit!

想篡夺王位的押沙龙
为自己预备了一辆气派的马车
还有一些马匹
又派了50个人在前面奔跑开路
气派的马车和众多的骑兵看上去很壮观
不过，跟以西结书1章提到的
耶和华天上战车比起来
押沙龙的马车就像是一辆又小又破的老爷车
我们知道
以西结书1章提到的战车
代表的是耶和华组织的天上部分

因为耶和华掌控一切
怀着爱心指引他的组织
来成就他想达成的旨意

这样描述
战车车轮的“轮圈上都布满眼睛”

指挥一切
耶和华战车的速度又怎样呢？
押沙龙马车的速度
可能会达到每小时72公里
这是一匹赛马的速度
那耶和华的战车呢？
根据以西结书1:14的描述
耶和华的天上战车移动的时候
就像“闪电”一样快

这是光速
其实耶和华战车的速度远比光速快得多

是以他思考的速度行进的
耶和华思考的速度有多快呢？
无法测量
已经超越了能测量的范围

天上战车的行进速度快似闪电
我们无法看到耶和华怎样指挥天上部分
完成他的工作

行进有多快

耶和华组织的地上部分有什么进展呢？
库克弟兄会介绍两个工程
进展的速度都很快
这显然有耶和华的指引
我们很想跟大家分享一些最新消息
因为大家都喜欢一手资讯
尤其是跟耶和华组织有关的事
我们可以从这些工程的进展看出

en.text: All around the world,

Have you ever wondered what happens
inside a Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses?
It’s a place where Bible study programs
and lectures are held each week.
The first time I attended a meeting,

The atmosphere was so good;
I’ve never seen anything like it anywhere else.
The people are loving, orderly,
and show an interest in people.
Every meeting is open to the public.
Seats are free and no collections are ever taken.
Families are invited to attend and learn together.
All meetings begin and end with song and prayer.
One meeting, usually held on the weekend,
includes a 30-minute Bible discourse
especially designed for the general public.
After that, there’s a question-and-answer discussion
based on an article in the study edition of the Watchtower magazine.
Participation is always voluntary.
At one of the meetings during the week,
we not only study the Bible
but also receive training in public speaking.
Everyone is invited to the Christian meetings,
including those who are not Jehovah’s Witnesses.
You can go into any Kingdom Hall
and receive the same program of Bible instruction.
Bible education, upbuilding association,
and the opportunity to praise God await you
at Christian meetings of Jehovah’s Witnesses.
To find a Kingdom Hall near you,
please visit the About Us section
and fill in the congregation meeting search.

title: 왜 “참을성​을 나타내야” 합니까?—환영사

ko.text: 대회를 통해 큰 유익을 얻게 되실 겁니다!
정말 기억에 남는 대회가 될 것이라고 확신합니다.
이 대회에서 40개가 넘는 연설들과 많은 동영상,
두 부분으로 된 드라마를 즐기게 될 겁니다.
우리가 이 낡은 세상의 남아 있는 기간을
프로그램에 나오는 대회 주제에서 알 수 있듯이,
영의 열매의 아홉 가지 부면 중 하나이죠.
아마도 많은 분들이 영의 열매를 외우고 계실 텐데요.
영의 열매를 이루는 처음 네 가지 특성은
사랑, 기쁨, 평화 그리고 오래 참음이죠.
언어는 시간이 흐름에 따라 계속 변합니다.
뉴욕주 워릭 세계 본부에는 성경 전시관이 있는데요.
그곳에 있는 여러 성경 번역판들을 비교해 보면
그 점을 분명히 알 수 있습니다.
많은 새로운 영어 단어들을 만들어 내야 했죠.
그때 그가 만든 단어들 중 하나가
다른 많은 영어 성경 번역판들에서 계속 사용되었습니다.
오늘날 우리가 사용하고 있는 영어와는 큰 차이가 있습니다.
그러한 변화에 맞게 표현을 수정해야 했죠.
그래야 독자들의 마음을 감동시킬 수 있기 때문입니다.
사실 “오래 참음”에 해당하는 이전 영어 표현은
그저 “오랫동안 고통당한다”는 의미로 생각될 수 있죠.
그러니까 자신이 어떻게 할 수 없는 상황을
원하든, 원하지 않든 어쩔 수 없이 견뎌야 하는
매우 참을성 없는 사람을 묘사할 때도
그보다 더 긍정적인 의미를 담고 있습니다.
힘든 상황을 견뎌 내는 것을 의미하지 않습니다.
개정된 영어 표현이 그 의미를 잘 전달합니다.
참을성 있는 사람은 부당한 대우를 받거나 화가 날 때
그에 더해 참을성은 특정한 상황에서만이 아니라
단순히 화가 나거나 힘든 일과 시련을 겪을 때만 아니라,
매일 접하는 상황에서도 참을성을 나타내야 하죠.
막히는 도로에서 운전할 때 그렇게 해야 합니다.
영의 열매의 이 부면을 나타내는 것이
우리는 참을성이 없는 세상에서 살고 있죠.
무언가 원하는 게 있으면 당장 가지려고 합니다.
우리도 그러한 태도에 물들게 될 수 있습니다.
참을성을 나타낸 훌륭한 본들에 대해 살펴볼 것입니다.
하느님의 예언자들을 포함한 고대의 충실한 사람들,
어떻게 그 특성을 나타낼 수 있는지,
그렇게 할 때 어떤 축복이 있는지 알아볼 것입니다.
그리고 여러분이 끝까지 참을성을 가지고 인내할 수 있도록

en.text: It’s wonderful that we can be together
for this year’s “Exercise Patience”! Convention.
It’s been four years since we’ve had
an in-person regional convention.
Your patience in waiting for this day
will be rewarded!
Speaking for the Governing Body,
I can say that this will be an excellent program
for all of us to enjoy.
We’ll benefit from over 40 talks
as well as videos,
a dramatic Bible reading,
and a two-part feature-length drama.
And all of this is designed to build us up
and to help us endure
the remaining days of this old world.
As you can see from the theme of this year’s program,
we’re especially highlighting
the quality of patience.
Patience originates with Jehovah.
It’s one of the nine aspects of the fruitage of his spirit
that are listed at Galatians chapter 5,
verses 22 and 23.
If you had memorized
that list of qualities some years ago,
when reciting it,
you would have said that the first four aspects are
love, joy,
peace, and long-suffering.
However, in the 2013 revision of the New World Translation,
the Governing Body decided to change the expression
“long-suffering” to “patience.”
Why the change?
Languages are not static; they evolve.
This is obvious
when comparing the translations that are on display in the Bible museum
at our world headquarters in Warwick, New York.
For example,
in the sixteenth century when William Tyndale
translated the Greek Scriptures into English,
he had to invent many new words.
One of those words was “long-suffering.”
That word, “long-suffering,”
continued to be used in many other English Bibles.
But the language used in 1526
is very different from the English language spoken today.
We’ve had to respond to changes in language
in order to touch the heart of today’s reader.
You see, these days,
people often misunderstand the term “long-suffering,”
thinking that it simply means someone who “suffers for a long time.”
But that could describe a very impatient person
who has to put up with a situation that’s out of his control,
whether he really wants to endure it or not.
Instead,
the original-language words used in the Bible
indicate a more positive meaning.
“Long-suffering” does not mean merely “suffering long,”
or just putting up with a trying situation.
It involves deliberate restraint
or calm endurance,
which is better expressed by the word “patience.”
When a patient person is wronged or provoked,
he remains calm
as he awaits the outcome of the situation.
Additionally, patience is a quality
that must be shown in all circumstances,
not just when enduring an offense, a hardship, or a trial.
We must exercise patience in everyday situations
—with one’s spouse and children,
with aging parents and other relatives,
with friends in the congregation,
in public as when sharing in the ministry,
when in line at a store,
or when driving a vehicle in traffic.
Can you see why this aspect of the fruitage of the spirit
is especially necessary now?
We live in an impatient world.
More and more people are not willing to wait
for anyone or anything.
When they want something, they want it now!
That attitude can rub off on us if we’re not on guard.
That is why for three days,
we’re going to delve into the Bible
to see some beautiful examples of patience
that we can imitate
—Jehovah God; Jesus Christ;
faithful men and women of old, including God’s ancient prophets;
and modern-day examples.
We’ll learn why we need patience,
how we can exercise it,
and what blessings await those who are patient.
Now, please give your full attention
to the entire program.
Follow along in the Bible.
Take note of the points that especially touch your heart.
And know that we on the Governing Body
love you all and continue to pray
that you will keep on patiently enduring to the end!

cn.text: 很高兴我们又能聚在一起参加大会
今年的主题是“要有耐心”
我们已经有快四年的时间
没有到现场参加大会了
你表现耐心等候这一天

我们想告诉大家
这个大会的节目
非常精彩
让我们都很期待

还有短片

这些节目会为我们加添力量
帮助我们在最后的日子
保持忍耐

今年我们特别强调的美好特质
就是“耐心”
耐心是来自耶和华的

其中就包括耐心
如果你很熟悉圣经的内容

这些特质

爱心
喜乐
安宁
和坚忍
“坚忍”在其他经文也译作“长久忍耐”
在英语《新世界译本》2013年修订版
中央长老团决定
把“长久忍耐”改成
“耐心”
为什么呢？
因为语言会不断改变
不是死的
如果对比古今的圣经译本
就能清楚看出这一点
这些译本在沃威克的圣经博物馆

举个例

威廉·廷德尔把《希腊语经卷》
翻译成英语时

long-suffering
一般译作“长久忍耐”
今天

在采用这个词

人们在今天所说的英语
和1526年人们使用的英语
已经很不一样了
我们需要调整一些圣经用词
才能打动现代读者的心
在现代
很多人会误会“长久忍耐”的意思
以为是一个人要无奈地忍耐很长时间
其实
这样的人根本说不上有耐心
他只是处于一种自己无法控制的情况
不管他愿不愿意
都只能被动忍受
可是
圣经原文所采用的词
含义却更为积极
“长久忍耐”的意思不只是忍耐很长时间
或者忍受不容易的情况
这个词的意思也包括在逆境下克制自己
保持冷静
更符合“耐心”这个词的意思

此外
有耐心的人
会在各种情况下都表现这种特质
而不只是在面对冒犯
或苦难时才表现
我们每天都需要表现耐心
对配偶

对会众的弟兄姐妹
还有
在向人传道

你看出
为什么神圣力量果实的这个特质
非常重要了吗？
我们生活在一个没有耐心的世界
我们周围有越来越多的人
什么事都不想等
他们想要的
马上就得满足
如果我们不小心
就会被他们影响
染上这种态度
在这三天里
我们会查考圣经
深入了解
圣经中表现耐心的好榜样
这些榜样包括

上帝的忠心仆人
包括古代的先知

我们会学习为什么要有耐心
要怎么表现耐心
还有
表现耐心的人
会得到什么福分
最后
请认真聆听三天大会的所有节目
打开你的圣经
也要做笔记
把打动你的要点记下来

中央长老团的弟兄
非常爱你们

ko.text: 어른이 되려면 배워야 할 게 많은데.

en.text: I wish I was a grown-up already.
Do you?

Dad.

Growing up, August felt like he didn’t have

he’s been using his time to cultivate
a friendship with Ben.
Hey, Ben.

Chantal,

It’s been years since I lost my privileges.
Brothers,
I completely understand the decision,
and I-I fully support it.
Xavier, we know

Will I ever be useful again?
It’s always you! Sure it is . . .
You know what? I’m done talking to you.

I’m done!
Is that it?
No, I’m done!
Nice, now you’re just walking away as usual.
I’m done talking to you.
Come back here!
Hey, Ben!
Everything OK?
It’s Ben.
He’s been ignoring me.
What did I do?
Maybe you didn’t do anything.
Ever think he may be dealing with something?
You know, he may need a friend
more than ever, even if it doesn’t seem like it.
Take a look at Proverbs 17:17.
“A true friend shows love at all times.”
“At all times.”
Where is it?
What are you talking about?
Where did you put it?
I don’t know what you’re talking about.
I told you not to move it!
I didn’t move anything!
It’s all your mess.
Where is it?
Don’t point the finger at me!
‘A true friend
is a brother born for times of distress’
and shows patience
when it’s hard to understand a friend’s actions.
It can be easier to make a friend
than to keep a friend.
That takes patience and time.
Hey.
Hey, great to see you.
Hey, listen.
I really wanted to say thank you.
Don’t even worry about it.
Ready to play?
Ready.
. . . you don’t!
I get up early every day to break my back . . .

And you don’t think I’m breaking my back
around this house?
And what thanks do I get?
Oh, you’re stuck in your own little world
because you’re selfish!
Foul.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, foul!
No, man. That was clean.
That was a foul!
That was a foul!
My dad is angry.
I’m angry.
I want to change.
I just feel stuck.
I’m just like him.
I’m really sorry, Ben.
But you don’t have to be like him.
You can choose who you’re going to be.
It just feels like I’m losing a battle.
You know, my dad always says,

Be patient with yourself.
It will take time,
but you can do it.
You already have an idea
of what’s at the root of your struggle.
‘Each time you lose your temper,

how you could’ve reacted better, and why.’
Come on!
“Wait before reacting.”
“Take a deep breath.”
Colossians 3:8:
‘Put away wrath.’
Proverbs 16:32:
“The one slow to anger
is better than a mighty man”
—“slow to anger.”
Don’t worry about it, man.
Sorry about that.
You really kept your cool out there.
Good job!
I’m moving.
That’s great!
Thank you.
You know, SKE might happen someday,
but I’m really excited

It’s amazing
how you can knock on one door for so long
and Jehovah opens another.
Can we come with you?
You guys better come.
Start saving up!
Yeah.
We have one last announcement.
We’re happy to announce that Brother Ben Leal
has been appointed as a ministerial servant.
See you tonight, Mom, Dad.
Enjoy Kingdom Ministry School.
What is important

What I want

The assembly had a lot of great parts today.
Thank you for your part.
I didn’t have a part.
I’m not talking about up there.
I mean your example

how you contribute in any way you can;

for me, and for Mom.
Yeah, you had a part.
Today when they talked about helping others,
the whole time

It was you.
You helped me grow spiritually;
you never stopped helping me.
If we’re in too big of a rush to get somewhere,
we can miss what Jehovah is giving us right now.
There’s beauty in the journey along the way.
And while we’re waiting to reach our goals,
let’s be grateful for the opportunity
—the time—
to grow spiritually.
Hello?
Hi, Xavier.
After the circuit overseer’s visit this week,
the elder body has some good news for you.
Could the C.O. and I meet with you
before the meeting?

en.text: I enjoyed learning about Jehovah and the Paradise.
So at an early age, I came to love Jehovah.
Yet, later on,
doubts just started nagging away at me.
I was deeply troubled by all the horrible pain
and suffering I saw on the news.
Even though I knew and understood the sovereignty issue,
I kept asking myself, ‘Why is it taking so long?’
I even started feeling a distance
growing between me and Jehovah.
I did a lot of praying and studying during that time.
Marc and I also had many deep and meaningful conversations.
Then I saw a picture in the publications
of a father carrying his little son on his shoulders.
That really resonated with me.
I wanted that same kind of trust
that a child has in his father,
to feel that I could trust Jehovah
without asking questions.
It became a real struggle
between what I mentally understood
and what I was feeling emotionally
in my heart.
I remember earnestly praying to Jehovah
so that I could feel things as Jehovah feels them.
At a certain point, an elder came to visit us.
He specifically asked me, “Edith, how are you doing?”
His interest and concern just made me open up
and tell him what I was struggling with.
I remember he quoted a scripture.
It was at 2 Corinthians 10:5,
where it says we must bring wrong ‘thoughts into captivity.’
I came to realize that our way of thinking is often so limited.
Jehovah sees everything.
He takes all factors into consideration.
As a result,
those negative feelings couldn’t grow and get stronger.
Now I could focus on positive thoughts.
That was the turning point.
I felt like Jehovah had literally held out his hand
and pulled me up out of a deep hole
and put me back up high and gave me a new start.
Jehovah is not indifferent.
His love is the exact reason
why he’s waiting so patiently.
It’s also helped me to be more patient with others.
Jehovah has given me the time and the opportunity
to break out of that vicious circle,
and with his help, I succeeded.

en.text: Do you ever feel that time is flying by
or that it sometimes slows to a crawl?
When we are anxious or dealing with illness,
time can seem to pass slowly.
But when we are absorbed
in new and exciting experiences,
a day may not feel long enough.
To a child, growing up
may seem to take forever.
But to an adult, it can feel
like time slips away all too fast.
To us, some features of creation
appear motionless.
But over time,
they change.
Astronomers believe that the first stars
formed billions of years ago.
It is difficult for us to conceive
of such an enormous length of time.
But Jehovah, who created the stars,
is “from everlasting to everlasting.”
He is not restrained or pressured by time,
but neither is he slow to act.
He always acts at exactly the right time.
Appreciating Jehovah’s view of time
helps us to be patient
while we await his new world.

총을 든 이웃 남자가 그 집을 지키고 있었죠.
그 남자는 클로스 형제를 폭도로 생각했습니다.
그리고 그는 그 지역의 많은 흑인들이
시 강당으로 피신해 있다는 걸 알게 되었습니다.
그래서 클로스 형제는 털사시 시내로 갔습니다.
어떤 흑인도 시 강당을 떠나지 못하게 했습니다.
클로스 형제는 참을성 있게 기다린 끝에 장군을 만났고
하지만 클로스 형제가 시 강당으로 들어가려면
무장한 백인 폭도들 사이를 뚫고 가야 했습니다.
마침 그 강당은 불과 이틀 전에 러더퍼드 형제가
“지금 살아 있는 수백만이 결코 죽지 않을 것이다”라는 연설을 한 곳이었습니다.
클로스 형제는 용감하게 한 군인에게 다가가
백인이 들어오자 틀림없이 매우 당황했을 겁니다.
하지만 클로스 형제는 차분하게 사람들을 지나
‘저것 봐. 저 종교만 유일하게 장군에게 허가증을 받아서 자기네 교인들을 데려가잖아.
우린 다 종교를 잘못 믿고 있는 거야.’
위험에 처한 형제를 도울 수 있었습니다.
계속해서 러더퍼드 형제의 연설 내용을 실었습니다.
하느님의 왕국이 폭동을 비롯한 이 세상 모든 문제의 해결책이라는 걸요.

en.text: Greenwood was a thriving black community in Tulsa, Oklahoma,
with many professionals,
including attorney and newspaper columnist
Richard J. Hill, a zealous servant of Jehovah.
In May of 1921,
Tulsa, Oklahoma, became the site
of one of the worst race massacres
in United States history.
Hundreds of armed men invaded Greenwood.
They beat and killed many black citizens.
It was a massacre.
Arthur Claus was another faithful brother there in Tulsa.
When he heard about the violence, he became very concerned
about his good friend Richard Hill,
who was living in Greenwood.
So Brother Claus went to Brother Hill’s home to check on him,
but Brother Claus found an armed neighbor protecting his home.
He thought that Brother Claus was another stranger coming there.
Brother Claus immediately identified himself.
He explained that he was a friend of Richard Hill’s
and he was looking for him to try to help him.
And that’s when he was told that many of the black people in that area
had been taken to the Convention Hall.
So Brother Claus headed back into downtown Tulsa.
The National Guard had been called in
and had placed General Barrett in charge,
and he decided that no black person
could leave the Convention Hall without a signed order.
So Brother Claus patiently waited to see the general
and explained that he just wanted to help his friend.
After Brother Claus agreed to be responsible for the family,
the general signed the order.
But then Brother Claus had to walk through a mob of armed white men
to get into the Convention Hall.
It happened to be the same location that just two nights before,
Judge Rutherford had delivered the talk
“Millions Now Living Will Never Die.”
But Brother Claus courageously walked up to the guard,
handed him the signed order, and was let in.
Now, the auditorium was filled with black people
who must have been very puzzled to see a white man.
But Brother Claus calmly walked through the crowd,
met Brother Hill and his family,
and took them back to their home.
In the auditorium, Brother Claus overheard people say:
‘Now look at that; they’re the only religious group
‘to go to the general and get a release for their people.
You know, we are in the wrong religion, I’m thinking.’
Brother Claus showed patience and discernment,
and he was able to help a brother in danger.
And in his weekly newspaper column,
Brother Hill continued to echo the message of Brother Rutherford’s talk
—that God’s Kingdom is the solution to all of the world’s problems,
including mob violence.

cn.text: 美国俄克拉何马州塔尔萨
有一个叫格林伍德的黑人社区
那里住了很多成功人士
理查德·希尔也住在那里
他是个热心的弟兄
也是律师和报纸的专栏作家
俄克拉何马州塔尔萨发生了一场种族大屠杀
有成百上千个武装分子闯入格林伍德
他们肆意殴打黑人
很多黑人被杀害了
塔尔萨有一个叫亚瑟·克劳斯的白人弟兄
他听到这件事
就很担心他的好朋友希尔弟兄
克劳斯弟兄就去希尔弟兄家看看情况
他发现一个邻居正拿着枪保护希尔的家
那个邻居以为克劳斯弟兄图谋不轨
于是克劳斯弟兄马上说明自己的身份
他说他是希尔的朋友
来看看希尔需不需要帮忙
那个邻居才告诉他
这个社区的很多黑人都在大礼堂里
克劳斯弟兄就离开那里
当时有军队在维持秩序
负责的人是巴雷特将军
他下令没有他的许可
任何黑人都不能离开大礼堂
克劳斯弟兄等了好久终于见到了这个将军
他说明自己想要帮助他的黑人朋友
并保证为他们一家的安全负责
将军就签署了命令
接着，克劳斯弟兄就穿过一群白人武装分子
走向大礼堂
两天前卢述福弟兄
就是在这个礼堂发表了著名的演讲
《现今活着的千百万人会永远不死》
克劳斯弟兄勇敢地走向警卫
把将军签署的命令递给他
就被放了进去
大礼堂里挤满了黑人
他们看到一个白人进来
肯定很疑惑
克劳斯弟兄镇定地穿过人群
找到了希尔弟兄一家
就把他们带回家
在礼堂里
克劳斯弟兄听到有人说
你们看，只有他们这个宗教去找了将军
把他们的人放出去
我觉得我们信错教了
克劳斯弟兄表现耐心和辨识力
不顾危险帮助了自己的弟兄
之后，希尔弟兄在他的报纸专栏里
报导了卢述福弟兄的演讲
提到只有上帝的王国
才能解决世上的种种问题
包括暴力和冲突

titles.ko: 참을성​을 통해 약속​을 상속​받는 사람​들​을 본​받으십시오—모르드개​와 에스더
titles.en: Imitate Those Who Inherit the Promises Through Patience—Mordecai and Esther
titles.cn: 效法那些因忍耐而得到承诺的人——末底改和以斯帖

title: 참을성​을 통해 약속​을 상속​받는 사람​들​을 본​받으십시오—바울

ko.text: 앙골라에서 믿음 때문에 심한 박해를 받은
많은 여호와의 증인 중 한 명입니다.
하지만 그는 계속 자신의 믿음을 강하게 하고 사람들을 격려했습니다.
만코카 형제는 아버지에게 많은 것을 알려 주셨죠.
성경에 관해 궁금한 점들을 많이 물어보셨습니다.
만코카 형제에 대해 아버진 이렇게 쓰신 적이 있습니다.
‘형제는 아주 참을성 있게 많은 걸 가르쳐 주었다.
그 덕분에 나는 이후의 시련들에 잘 대처할 수 있었다.’
만코카 형제와 앙골라 지부 위원으로 일했습니다.
하지만 두 분이 처음 만난 건
아버지가 성서 연구생으로 첫 집회에 참석했을 때였어요.
그런데 갑자기 관리들이 집회 장소를 급습했어요.
만코카 형제는 연구생들을 보내 달라고 부탁했지만
사실 아버지는 구타를 너무 심하게 당했고
이러다가 죽을 수도 있겠다는 생각이 드셨다고 하셨어요.
자기 자신보다 그들을 먼저 생각한다는 걸 느낄 수 있었습니다.
또 만코카 형제는 다른 사람들이 진리에 대해 배우도록 도와주기도 했습니다.
박해를 인내할 수 있다는 것을 잘 보여 줍니다.
시련이 언제 끝날지에만 초점을 맞추기 때문에
자신이 할 수 있는 일과 여호와의 도움에 초점을 맞추며

en.text: Brother João Mancoca is one
of many of Jehovah’s Witnesses in Angola
who faced cruel persecution
because of their faith.
And during the decades
of the 1940’s until the 1970’s,
Brother Mancoca endured prison,
penal colonies, and much torture
as well as separation from his family.
Despite this,
he never stopped strengthening himself and others.
My father, Adão Agostinho,
was arrested in the early 1970’s.
And in prison, who did he find?
Brother Mancoca and other brothers
who also had faced cruel persecution for a long time.
Brother Mancoca was a mentor to my father.
So every night, he would go by Brother Mancoca’s bed
and ask him many questions about the Bible.
In his memoirs, my father wrote something very interesting:
‘He was very patient with me;
‘I took with me a wealth of knowledge
that helped me in the trials that followed.’
Today, I cannot imagine what my life would be like
without this inheritance that was passed down by those loyal brothers.
My father, Silvestre Simão, and Brother João Mancoca
served together on the Angola Branch Committee.
But that was not where they met.
When my father attended
his first meeting as a Bible student,
Brother Mancoca was conducting
the Watchtower  Study.
Suddenly, the meeting place was raided
and Brother Mancoca became concerned
because a good number of those in attendance were Bible students,
including my father.
Brother Mancoca asked that they release the students,
but that did not happen.
They beat them up.
They beat them up brutally —all the men that were there.
In fact, my dad said he thought that he was going to die on that day
because the beating was so brutal
and he lost a lot of blood.
In the face of this situation,
Brother Mancoca was concerned.
He said a sincere prayer for Jehovah to protect his sheep.
And that was what happened.
Jehovah protected them.
My dad could see that Brother Mancoca was more concerned with them
than he was with himself.
Brother Mancoca also had the opportunity
to help others to get to know the truth.
And one of them is my uncle, Filipe Cunha.
He was in that jail as a political prisoner,
and he learned the truth there.
And as a result, four generations of our family today
are Jehovah’s Witnesses.
The situation of Brother Mancoca
and other brothers who faced persecution here in Angola
proves that with Jehovah’s help,
we can face persecution.
When a person does not have patience,
he cannot persevere
because he is looking at the time when the trial will end.
On the other hand, patience helped the brothers to deal with trials,
focusing on what they could do and on Jehovah’s help.

cn.text: 安哥拉的弟兄姐妹因为信仰受到残酷的迫害
若昂·曼科卡弟兄是其中之一
从1940年代开始的30多年里
曼科卡弟兄经历监禁
流放、拷打
跟家人分离
尽管这样
他一直加强自己的信心
也鼓励别人
我的父亲叫亚当·阿戈什蒂纽
他在1970年代初被捕
你猜，他在监狱里遇到了谁？
就是曼科卡弟兄
另外还有其他弟兄
他们也长期受到残酷的迫害
曼科卡弟兄是我父亲的心灵导师
每天晚上，我父亲都会去找他
问他许多圣经的问题
我父亲这样形容曼科卡弟兄
“他非常有耐心
我从他身上学到很多重要的道理
让我可以应付人生的各种考验”
那些忠贞的弟兄
把宝贵的真理传给我爸爸
这份产业也传给了我
我的爸爸西尔韦斯特雷·西芒和曼科卡弟兄
一起在安哥拉分部委员会服务
但他们并不是在分部认识的
我爸爸第一次参加聚会的时候
是曼科卡弟兄主持《守望台》研究班
那一天，他们被突袭搜查
曼科卡弟兄非常担心
因为许多参加聚会的人
都还只是圣经学生
包括我爸爸
曼科卡弟兄请求他们放了圣经学生
但他们没有听
所有参加聚会的人都被毒打
包括还在学习圣经的人
我爸爸跟我说
当时他觉得自己快死了
因为他伤得很重
流了很多血
看到这种情况
曼科卡弟兄十分担心
他向耶和华恳切祷告
求耶和华保护自己的绵羊
上帝真的垂听了他的祷告
保护了他们
我爸爸看出
曼科卡弟兄关心其他人胜过他自己
曼科卡弟兄也找机会
帮助其他人认识真理
其中一个人就是我叔叔
菲利佩·库尼亚
他当时是一个政治犯
被关在监狱里
到今天，我们家四代
都是耶和华见证人
曼科卡弟兄和其他弟兄经历的迫害告诉我们
靠着耶和华的帮助
我们也能在迫害下保持忍耐
如果一个人缺乏耐心
只想着考验什么时候结束
就没办法忍耐到底
正因为有耐心
安哥拉的弟兄才能忍受考验
把目光集中于他们能做的事
还有依靠耶和华

titles.ko: 참을성​을 통해 약속​을 상속​받는 사람​들​을 본​받으십시오—바울
titles.en: Imitate Those Who Inherit the Promises Through Patience—Paul
titles.cn: 效法那些因忍耐而得到承诺的人——保罗

title: 창조물은 여호와께서 모든 일을 제때에 하신다는 것을 가르쳐 줍니다

ko.text: 추운 계절에는 씨앗과 구근이 휴면 상태에 있습니다.
기나긴 건기 동안 거의 생장을 멈춥니다.
마침내 비가 내리면 자라서 꽃을 피웁니다.
낮 동안에는 계속 해를 따라 움직이죠.
꽃이 피고 나면 더는 움직이지 않고
우리도 지금이 마지막 날이라는 증거에 반응을 보입니다.
그리고 영적 빛의 근원인 분을 바라봅니다.
“이와 같이 여러분도 이 모든 일을 보거든 그가 문 앞에 가까이 있다는 것을 아십시오.”
태어난 곳으로 돌아가 알을 낳아야 합니다.
그들은 상류로 거슬러 올라가기에 강물이 적합한 상태가 될 때까지 기다립니다.
돌고래는 신속하게 행동해야 할 때가 언제인지 압니다.
위험이 닥치면 돌고래 무리는 한데 뭉쳐 서로를 지킵니다.
이 새들은 극한의 환경에서 어떻게 생존합니까?
따뜻한 환경을 찾아 북쪽으로 이주하기 시작합니다.
더 추운 곳인 남쪽을 향해 이동합니다.
그런 다음에는 수컷이 알을 받아 품습니다.
먹이를 많이 먹어 지방을 축적해 놓았습니다.
두 달 동안 수컷들은 아무것도 먹지 않고 알을 품느라
황제펭귄은 새끼들과 함께 살아남을 수 있습니다.
우리는 황제펭귄에게서 교훈을 얻을 수 있습니다.
영적 자양분을 미리 축적해 두어야 한다는 것입니다.
벌과 다른 곤충들은 어떻게 제때에 일을 합니까?
이것은 북아메리카 동부에 사는 매미의 소리입니다.
그리고 단 몇 주 동안 허물을 벗고
우리에게는 해야 할 중요한 일이 있고,
그 일을 할 시간은 제한되어 있습니다.
육지 포유류는 오랜 시간 활발하게 움직일 수 있습니다.
아프리카 코끼리는 하루에 2시간 정도 잠을 잡니다.
작은 갈색 박쥐는 거의 19시간 동안 잠을 잡니다.
잠을 자면 하루의 활동으로 지친 몸이 회복됩니다.
수면 중에 뇌가 재활성화되고 독소가 제거됩니다.
이것은 마치 뇌를 깨끗이 청소하는 것과 같죠.
장기 기억으로 전환하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
우리는 끊임없이 일만 하도록 만들어지지 않았습니다.
충분한 휴식과 균형 잡힌 여가 활동이 필요하죠.
여호와에 대한 믿음과 확신을 강화할 시간도 필요합니다.
항상 우리의 삶에서 가장 중요한 일이 되어야 합니다.
그리하여 여러분이 그리스도의 날까지 흠이 없[기를] 바랍니다.”

en.text: We can watch a tiny seed
transform into a beautiful plant.
But what part do timing
and surrounding conditions play in plant growth?
During the cold season,
seeds and bulbs remain dormant.
Later, as temperatures rise
and the days lengthen, they bloom.
Some desert plants practically shut down
during long, dry periods.
When it finally rains,
it’s their time to grow and flower.
Sunflower plants need lots of light.
Throughout the day, they turn to follow the sun.
After their flowers open,
they stop moving and face east all day.
Jehovah made plants
to respond to their environment
at the right time.
We respond to evidence that these are the last days.
And we focus on the Source of spiritual light.
Jesus said: “Likewise also you,
“when you see all these things,
know that he is near at the doors.”
Sea creatures
—do they benefit by acting at the right time?
These are young salmon.
They start life in fresh water.
Most species migrate downriver
to the ocean to feed and grow.
They time the trip around the currents and available food.
Later, as adults, they’re ready to head back
and start the next generation.
They wait until river conditions are suitable to migrate upriver;
then they go!
Dolphins too perform different activities
at different times.
There’s time to play,
to see what’s for dinner,
and to make friends.
But there are times when a dolphin knows to act with urgency.
When threatened,
the dolphin pod closes ranks to protect everyone,
especially the young.
We stay close to one another for safety
in a spiritually dangerous world.
And no matter how busy we are,
we make time to be taught by Jehovah.
“Look! Now is the especially acceptable time.
Look! Now is the day of salvation.”
Jehovah gave birds inherent abilities that enable them
to survive in challenging environments.
Consider emperor penguins.
How do these birds deal with their unique challenges?
And what can we learn from their sense of timing?
For many birds, the end of the Antarctic summer
marks the start of a migration
north to milder conditions.
But emperor penguins instinctively do the opposite.
They head south, moving deeper
into the cold, to breed.
Each female then lays
a single egg, which is soon
entrusted to the male for safekeeping.
These sites are very inhospitable,
but the emperors are prepared.
Jehovah has given them instinctive wisdom.
Before migrating south, these males had feasted
and built up their fat reserves,
because for two long months
(the coldest and darkest of the year),
they won’t eat and will lose half their body weight
while they incubate the eggs.
During this time, the females
have trekked about 50 miles (80 km) to the sea
and are now ready to return with food,
just in time for when the chicks hatch.
Preparing ahead for the difficult times helps these penguins
to survive along with their young.
Now is the time for us
to learn from the emperor penguin and build up
our spiritual reserves
before this world’s dark days become even darker.
“Even the stork in the sky knows its seasons.”
Bees work hard.
And they have a lot to do.
How do bees and other insects get their work done on time?
Honeybees are adaptable.
They organize their foraging to save time and energy
and to visit flowers when they have plenty of nectar and pollen.
The bees’ timing works out for all involved.
Plants get pollinated,
and the bees make honey.
This is the sound of cicadas
in eastern North America.
This variety develops underground for 17 years.
Right on time, they emerge by the billions.
They’ll have just a few weeks to shed their skin
and finish the most important work of their life
—to find a mate and lay their eggs.
Whether with an adaptable routine, like the honeybee,
or a fixed one, like the cicada,
insects instinctively
accomplish their work on time.
We have an important work to do
and a limited time to do it.
With a regular schedule and by adapting it as needed,
we can make wise use of our time.
“Therefore, the way I am running is not aimlessly;
“the way I am aiming my blows
is so as not to be striking the air.”
Land mammals can stay active for long periods,
from the large
to the not so large.
But all of them need some time each day to sleep.
African elephants get about two hours of sleep per day.
Horses sleep for close to three hours.
A wild sloth might doze for up to 14.
And a little brown bat can snooze for nearly 19.
But how does sleep help them?
Sleep allows the body to recuperate from the day’s activities.
And some scientists believe that sleep
allows their brains to reset
and remove toxins,
as if giving the brain a good scrub.
It may also help to move the day’s memories
into long-term storage.
We humans need sleep too.
The younger we are,
the more we need.
We’re not made to work constantly
without sufficient rest and balanced recreation.
And unlike animals,
we need time to refresh our faith
and confidence in Jehovah.
Our friendship with him
must always be the most important thing in our life.
“Make sure of the more important things,
so that you may be flawless . . . up to the day of Christ.”

en.text: In the parable of the virgins,
the bridegroom is Jesus
and the virgins are his anointed followers.
Jesus gave this parable
to admonish all his anointed followers in the last days
to “keep on the watch” lest they miss out on their precious reward.
In the parable of the talents,
the master is Jesus
and his slaves are his anointed followers.
Before Jesus ascended to heaven,
he entrusted them with talents,
that is, the responsibility
to preach and make disciples.
In the parable of the sheep and the goats,
the shepherd is Jesus
and the sheep are Christians
who have the hope of living forever on earth.
Those Christians are judged to be sheep
because they support the anointed.

ko.text: 뭐, 편지 봉사 맨날 똑같지 뭐.
제가 필요한 물건이 있는데 좀 보내 주실 수 있나 해서요.
올리비아, 근데 편지 봉사 재밌게 하는 거 아니었어?
솔직히, 맨날 쓰고 계속 보내는데 그냥 블랙홀 같아요.
아무도 답장 안 한다고 뭐라 했던 사람이 누구였더라?
아니 뭐, 답장 때문에 신경이 좀 쓰이긴 했지.
같은 반이었던 세라한테도 문자를 했는데 얘가 계속 답이 없는 거예요.
보내 달라고 한 건 이게 다인가?
그래도 이제 장모님 오시면 지내실 공간이 생겨서 다행이야.
이번 주엔 가족 숭배를 좀 색다르게 해 볼까?
오빠랑 낚시 많이 하셨다는 데가 여기예요?
근데 요즘에 봉사하는 게 블랙홀 같다고 했었지?
도구보다 더 중요한 게 있는데, 그게 뭘까?
“오히려 우리는 모든 면에서 우리 자신을 하느님의 봉사자로 추천합니다.”
우린 블랙홀에 그물을 던지는 게 아니라
합당한 사람들이 많은 푸른 바다에 던지는 거야.
우리 눈엔 안 보여도 여호와께는 그런 사람들이 보이지.
시간은 좀 걸려도 참을성이 있다면 결국은 찾게 될 거야.
이제 엄마가 어떻게 하면 편지 봉사를 더 효과적으로 할 수 있는지
좋은 방법을 알려 줄 거야. 그러면서 …
오늘은 거짓 종교가 하느님을 얼마나 나쁜 분으로 만들었는지 살펴볼 거야.
그래, 그럼 교회들이 2차 세계 대전 때 어떤 일을 했는지 동영상부터 하나 보고
다 너무 좀 심각한 내용인 것 같아서.
심각하게 안 받아들일 거면 뭐하러 연구를 해?
내가 파이오니아 시작했을 때 도움이 됐던 게 있는데.
예수께서도 제자들에게 참을성을 보이셔야 했다는 거야.
제자들도 배우는 걸 늘 빨리 받아들인 건 아니었어.
우리가 지금 하는 성서 연구 있잖아.
공부하면서 배우는 내용에 대해서 어떤 생각이 들어?
내용을 읽다 보니까 깨달은 게 있어.
솔직히 아직 이해가 좀 안 되는 것들도 있어.
충분히 그런 생각이 들 수 있어.
천천히 여유를 갖고 왜 여호와의 방식이 옳은지 알아보자.
배우는 내용이 훨씬 마음에 와닿을 거야.
천천히 해 보면 알게 될 거야.
집에 있을 때가 거의 없는데, 여기서 일을 더 하겠대.
왜 나만 이렇게 힘들어야 하는 건데.
그런 기분이 들 수는 있는데 그렇다고 이제 와서 뭘 어쩌겠어.
하긴 언니처럼 잘난 사람이 뭘 알겠어?
처제가 오늘은 기분이 좀 안 좋은가?
걔가 기분이 좋은 날이 있긴 할까?
걔가 믿지 않는 사람하고 결혼한 게 내 잘못은 아니잖아요.
근데 처제 입장에서 한번 생각해 봐요.
… 사람들은 이 세상에 희망이 없다고 말합니다.
그런 말들을 생각해 보면 희망이 정말 중요하다는 것을 알 수 있습니다.
우리 모두는 어떤 식으로든 고통스러운 일을 겪기 때문입니다.
우리에게 무관심하지 않으시다는 사실은 우리에게 위로가 됩니다.
사실 성경을 보면 하늘에 계신 아버지 여호와께서는
여러분과 제가 구원을 받을 수 있는 수단을 마련하기 위해 행동하셨습니다.
그리고 성경에서는 그분이 우리를 구원하기를 간절히 바라신다고 알려 줍니다.
그 점이 예레미야 29:11에 잘 나타나 있는데요.
함께 성경을 펴셔서 그 성구를 찾아 보실까요?
“여러분은 지금 하고 있는 그대로 계속 서로 격려하고 서로 세워 주십시오.”
도라, 조금 전에 한 말 미안하다고 하려고 전화했어.
요즘 네가 많이 힘든 거 알아.
여호와를 사랑하니까 잘 견디고 있다는 것도.
앞으로도 힘들 때 언제든 말해 줘.
잘됐다. 나 재방문 하나 새로 생겼는데 되게 잘 듣는 사람이거든.
자, 이게 지난 몇 년 동안의 공개 강연 계획표야. -어, 웨인 형제.
웨인이 공개 강연 계획하는 거 도와주기로 해서.
혹시 취소되면 빨리 다른 연사를 찾아야 돼.
근데 전화만 해도 충분할 거야. -걱정 마시라니까요.
제가 훨씬 편하게 하는 방법 보여 드릴까요?
연사한테 전화해서 미리 확인 안 했어?
웨인이 연사한테 확인을 안 해서 제가 대신 연설해야 할 거 같아요.
그 … 제가 지난번에 부탁드린 짐 있잖아요.
아, 미안해. 내가 깜빡하고 못 보냈어.
어떡하냐? 그 … 당장 필요한 거였을 텐데.
두 분이 이미 신경 많이 써 주셨잖아요.
우리도 요새 이것저것 일이 진짜 많아.
사실 나도 사과하고 싶은 게 있어.
그때 회관에서 그러면 안 되는 거였는데.
나도 처음에 이 임명 맡았을 때 실수 많이 했었어.
한번은 같은 날 연사를 두 명 초대해서 …

en.text: Hey, Gabe!
Oh, hey, Olivia!
How’s it going?
Uh, you know, it’s going good
—just doing another letter writing territory,
so you know how that is.
OK, well—
Hey, Gabe, good to see you!
Hey, Sue! It’s good to see you too.
Is that Gabe? Aww, hey, baby.
How’s Bethel?
Hey, Mom.
It’s busy but great.
I’m learning a lot.
Oh, look who just got home from work.
Hey, Gabe.
Hey, Max.
So if it’s possible,
can you send me some more of my things?
I can text you a list.
Absolutely!
I’ll get right on it.
Great. Thank you so much.
Olivia, I’ll let you get back to letter writing.
Great.
Hey.
All right, we’ll let you go, love you.
OK, love you too.
Bye!
So, Olivia,
I thought that you enjoyed letter writing?
I don’t know,
it just feels like another letter,
another envelope, and another black hole.
Hmm.
Black hole?
Yeah, you know, stuff goes in, but nothing ever comes out of it.
It’s not that bad.
What do you mean?
You were just telling me that no one has responded to you.
OK, yeah, I get a little antsy for replies.
Like I texted my old classmate Sarah,
but she just hasn’t said anything back to me yet.
I just hope I didn’t overdo it.
What do you think?
Is it too much?
Do you think it’s too much?
It’s too much.
I’m sure she’ll, uh—
I’m sure she’ll get back to you.
All right, this is everything on Gabe’s list.
Thank you!
At least we’ll have a little more room
for, uh, when your mom moves in.
Yeah.
Anyway, Gabe will love this.
He already told me how much he misses fishing.
What if we do something a little different for family worship this week?
Sure.
So this is where you and Gabe would fish, right?
Yep.
We learned a lot of lessons about fishing here.
So lately, preaching’s felt like a black hole, right?
We have the right equipment,
but what does a fisherman need more than anything?
At 2 Corinthians 6:4,
it says: “But in every way we recommend ourselves
as God’s ministers, by . . .”
Now, what does verse 6 say, Olivia?
It says “by purity, by knowledge, by patience.”
Patience.
It helps us to keep trying
again and again
—to not give up.
And we’re not casting into a black hole
but into a blue sea full of deserving ones.
Now, maybe we can’t see it, but Jehovah knows they are there.
And it may take some time, but if we’re patient,
together we’ll find them.
Now, Irene has some great ideas
on how to make our letter writing more personal.
Um, all ready for Section 2, right?
I guess so.
OK, well, first we’ll see how false religion gets God totally wrong.
Did you get a chance to study?
Yeah, I— I read ahead.
OK. Is— Is everything OK?
I’m fine. Let’s just, um, get started.
OK, so then we’ll watch a video on churches during World War II
and why Jehovah will have no choice but to—
Something’s up.
What’s wrong?
Um, I don’t know. I just—
I read that all religions are false?
Well, yeah, but you have to remember that like—
I don’t know. It’s just—
What?
It’s just all getting so, so serious.
Well—
Yeah! It’s life and death!
Why waste time on this study if she’s not going to take it seriously?
So you said all of that to her?
No, just the “well, yeah” part.
But I wanted to.
She used to be so excited to study.
I don’t know.
Maybe she’s just not getting it.
I think she is learning.
Maybe it’s just really sinking in.
If it’s sinking in, then what’s the problem?
Maybe it’s me.
You know what really helped me when I first started pioneering?
I learned that Jesus had to be patient with his disciples.
They weren’t always ready to learn the things that he was teaching them.
That means that we have to be patient with our Bible students too.
Let it reach her heart.
And be patient with yourself.
I was thinking a lot about our study,
and I really want to know how you are feeling about it.
As I was reading ahead, it finally hit me.
All the churches in the world are lying
—my mom’s included.
And God’s just going to destroy them all?
You know, maybe I’m just not ready for some of this.
I understand where you’re coming from.
Give yourself some time to learn why Jehovah’s ways are just.
The better you get to know him,
the more his teachings are going to touch your heart.
Trust me; I promise you it’ll be worth the wait.
OK.
Yeah? OK.
So let’s get to know Jehovah better.
Do you remember, um, Lesson 7?
He’s just going to be working even more.
I just don’t know what to do about it
because he’s barely home as it is.
Are you still listening to me?
Mm-hmm.
I just— I’m so tired.
I don’t have the support I need, you know.
I know.
And it never seems to end.
I don’t know why this keeps happening to me.

we can agree that hope is so important.
Why?
Because we all deal with suffering and tragic events
in one form or another.

that our heavenly Father, Jehovah,
is not insensitive nor uncaring.

we see from the very first point of rebellion
that our heavenly Father, Jehovah, put into motion
the means by which you and I can be saved.
And the Bible tells us
that he is eager to do so.
Note how this is expressed
at Jeremiah 29:11.
If you’ll find that in your Bibles—
It makes me think about
1 Thessalonians 5:11:
“Keep encouraging one another
“and building one another up,
just as you are in fact doing.”
We can do so much good when we’re patient
—just like Jehovah is with us.

I can’t believe I missed that.

And he always has.
I am determined to wait patiently on my God
. . . and never do anything that would displease him
. . . because his blessings are so worth the wait.

ko.text: 어떨 땐 한밤중에 일어나 화장실에 가서
다른 가족들은 아이들과 같이 왕국회관에도 가고
나 같은 사람도 증인이라고 할 수 있을까
형제 자매들이 전화해서 저를 찾기라도 하면
남편은 저한테 불같이 화를 내기 시작했어요.
너무 힘든 날에는 죽고 싶다는 생각이 들었어요.
차라리 죽는 게 더 편할 것 같았죠.
또 제가 배운 성경 진리에 근거해서
‘이제 교도소에서 형제들을 만날 수 있을까’라고 생각했는데,
제가 생활하던 곳에는 형제들이 한 명도 없었습니다.
또 좁은 방에서 동료 재소자들과 함께 지내다 보니
학교에 다닐 때 저는 선생님들에게 많은 압력을 받았습니다.
여호와의 증인의 활동이 금지되어 있었기 때문에
그러고 나서 아내는 임시 구금 시설로 보내졌고
저는 제가 앓고 있는 병 때문에
우린 네 달 동안이나 서로 전혀 만날 수 없었죠.
이 시련을 인내할 수 있게 해 달라고
수감되어 있던 한 젊은 여자를 만났어요.
우린 함께 하느님의 이름에 대해 이야기를 나누었는데
이 종이 뒤에 하느님의 이름을 적어 놔야겠어요.
그 여자는 수색을 받고 나와서 이렇게 말했죠.
아까 그 종이에 쓴 하느님의 이름을 봤어요.”
그 말을 듣고 이렇게 말해 줬어요.
저는 옳은 일을 하게 해 달라고 많이 기도했어요.
용서에 관한 내용이 들어 있는 이유를 깨달았죠.
용서하고 싶은 마음이 들지 않을 때도 있으니까요.
여호와께 도와 달라고 기도하면 그럴 수 있어요.
기도에 더해 저를 영적으로 붙들어 줬던 건
나도 정말 여호와의 증인이라는 느낌이 들었어요.
하지만 대회에 가는 건 쉽지 않았어요.
대회에 갔다 올 때면 남편이 어떻게 나올지 몰라
마음을 졸였던 적이 한두 번이 아니었습니다.
그런데 한번은 여느 때처럼 대회를 보고 집에 왔는데
하루 종일 집 앞에서 저를 기다리고 있다가
잠깐 집에 들어간 사이에 제가 도착한 거죠.
여호와께서 저를 지켜 주시는 걸 느꼈습니다.
이곳에서의 생활을 가치 있게 보내야 되겠다고 결심했고,
동료 형제 한 명만 보내 주시면 감사하겠습니다.
두 명의 형제가 저와 함께 있게 되었습니다.
이제 우리 셋은 집회를 온전히 즐기기 위해서
집에 출판물을 가지고 있는 사람이 아무도 없었기 때문에
집회에 가야만 영적 양식을 얻을 수 있었습니다.
그땐 우리 노래 책에 337개의 노래가 있었는데
저는 거의 모든 노래를 외우고 있었죠.
저는 저를 괴롭히던 선생님을 대할 때
시험 점수를 깎을 때에도 반감을 품지 않았죠.
결혼 생활이 더 나았을 거라고 생각할지 몰라요.
남편이 반대해서 성서 연구를 그만두는 경우가 있으니까요.
그분의 도움을 분명히 느낄 수 있습니다.
스스로는 할 수 없을 것 같았던 일을
중단 없이 그렇게 할 수 있었어요.
여호와에 대해 이야기하는 게 정말 좋아요.
제가 형제들에게 걸림돌이 되지 않는 데
그때 인내하는 법을 배운 것이 도움이 되었습니다.
지금은 대체 복무 중인 두 아들이
또 우리에게 필요한 것을 공급해 주셨다고 느꼈습니다.
감옥에서 저는 여호와를 기다려야 한다는 것과
다른 죄수들을 친절하게 대해야 한다는 것을 배웠습니다.
그래서 항상 그들에게 증거할 준비가 되어 있었죠.
여호와께서는 제가 자기 연민에 빠져 있기보다는
다른 사람들을 생각해야 한다는 걸 깨닫게 도와주셨어요.
1990년대 중반에 저희 부부가 부모님을 뵈러 왔을 때였어요.
어느 날 공원을 가로질러 상점을 가다가
바로 그 역사 선생님이 지나가는 걸 보았죠.
너는 나를 정말 친절하게 대해 주었지.”
이 일을 통해 저는 중요한 걸 배웠습니다.
사람들은 단지 그의 도구로 사용될 뿐입니다.
“자기들이 무슨 일을 하고 있는지 모른다”고 말씀하셨죠.
그땐 자기가 무슨 일을 하는지 모르셨을 거예요.
우리가 좋은 씨를 뿌리면 반드시 좋은 열매가 나온다는 겁니다.

en.text: It’s hard to explain a rage, you know,
of him being angry that I was a Witness,
because I didn’t want to make him angry
and have a fight.
I wanted to have a good marriage, you know.
A few times
I’d get up in the middle of the night
and finish my Watchtower
or finish studying for the book study
in the bathroom.
That was a safe place.
I didn’t have the nice family.
You’re bringing your kids to the hall
and doing things with people,
but it felt impossible to be a good Witness.
If anybody called and asked
for Sister Crosby,
that was flipping on the angry switch
in my husband.
On a bad day,
I did feel sometimes like dying,
or that it’d be easier to die.
Before I was baptized,
based on my father’s example
and the Bible truths that I had learned,
I believed that maintaining Christian neutrality
was the right thing to do.
That’s why I refused military training.
I received a two-year sentence
and was then transferred to prison.
I thought I would meet other brothers,
but in my location,
there was not a single brother there.
Living with inmates
in a cramped cell,
I often experienced emotional issues.
During my school years,
I experienced much pressure from the teachers.
Because my mom was one of Jehovah’s Witnesses,
they often threatened
that they would take us children
(because I have a younger brother and an older sister)
to an orphanage.
The work of Jehovah’s Witnesses was under ban,
so we had to be very cautious and careful.
The search lasted 12 hours.
After that,
Alevtina was taken to a temporary detention facility,
and I was interrogated until two in the morning.
I said that I had a serious illness,
and therefore I needed to eat.
But in spite of that, they didn’t allow it.
For four months,
we did not see each other at all.
Every morning I prayed to endure this test,
and it helped me feel calm.
After one court session,
as I was waiting to return to my cell,
I met a young female prisoner.
And she and I were talking about the name of God.
And she said to me:
“Wait, wait, wait.
“I’m going to write the name
“on the back of this piece of paper
so that I don’t forget it.”
And this girl came out after the search and said,
“When the inspector searched me,
she looked at the piece of paper and saw God’s name.”
And I said to her, “Don’t worry,
now neither the inspector nor you will forget the name of God.”
I prayed a lot to just do the right thing.
And then I realized why
it’s in the Lord’s Prayer to pray to be forgiving
because you don’t always want to forgive the person.
But we need to, we have to,
and it works when you pray for help about that.
Meetings and studying
were my lifeline to Jehovah besides praying.
It just made me always feel like a Witness.
But assemblies were hard
because it was just hard telling him.
Just going made him angry.
A lot of times I never knew what I’d come home to
after an assembly or a convention.
And I came home as usual.
He wasn’t there when I came home.
There was 30 seconds—he just went in to go,
and I pulled up and got out of the car.
He had been waiting there all day for me
because he wanted to come out and say something
to the people that dropped me off
—probably not very nice.
I think I always felt Jehovah’s hand
when I came home.
But I was determined to spend my time well,
so I applied myself to personal study
in order to progress spiritually.
I prayed earnestly to Jehovah God.
Jehovah God, I would be so grateful
if you assign just one brother to my cell.
Soon, two brothers were assigned to my cell.
The three of us tried our best
to fully enjoy the meetings.
Doing so helped us to endure.
At times, issues would arise
among the brothers too.
Practically no one had any literature at home,
so the meetings were the only source of spiritual food.
We had 337 songs in our songbook back then,
and I knew almost all of them by heart.
So when I got anxious or uneasy,
instead of sinking deep into my thoughts,
I simply hummed Kingdom songs.
I prayed earnestly and at length to Jehovah
to remain calm toward the teacher.
Even though he scolded me
or lowered my grades,
I did not consider him an enemy.
Some people might think, well, we would’ve had a better marriage
if I’d stopped being a Witness,
because people stop studying because their husbands are opposed.
Well, how do you feel about Jehovah?
What do you think? How does he feel?
If you depend on Jehovah for help,
he’ll give it to you and you’ll feel it.
It builds your faith,
and you know that you just got through something.
You can’t believe you just did that.
It actually happened, and you know that he helped you.
I continued to be a Witness.
I could be a Witness.
It really happened.
I’ve been pioneering for 13 years,
and I’ve really enjoyed it, getting to study with people.
I like talking to people about Jehovah.
It really makes you feel good.
And even if people aren’t nice,
they’re getting a witness, and they have a chance.
And who knows what will happen in the future?
One thing I learned was that not everything
works out the way I expect.
Even as an elder serving the congregation,
I still experience differences of opinion with the brothers.
But the endurance I learned back then
has helped me to peacefully resolve those conflicts
so that I don’t become a stumbling block to others.
The endurance I learned back then
has also helped me maintain a happy and peaceful family life
with my wife and two sons,
even when problems occur in the family.
When I watched my sons,
who are now serving in alternative civilian service,
boldly defend their faith and give a witness in court,
I was reminded of how Jehovah
had always provided for my father and me
during our imprisonment years ago.
And now for my two sons,
He’s provided the strength to endure
as well as everything we need to overcome challenges.
In prison, I learned that I had to wait on Jehovah
and treat other prisoners kindly.
And so I was always ready to witness to them.
Jehovah helped me understand that this was not a time for self-pity
but a time to think about others.
When you are busy with the Kingdom work, time flies by very quickly.
In the mid-1990’s,
my wife and I came to visit our parents.
So one day on my way to the store
through the park,
I saw the same history teacher at some distance.
He lowered his head
and was about to cry,
and he said,
“Ivan, I have caused you so much trouble,
“and yet you came up to me
and addressed me so kindly.”
From this incident,
I learned that it is important always to understand
who the real source of persecution is
—not people, but Satan, who uses them as a tool.
And just as Jesus said that people “[don’t] know what they are doing,”
I felt that this history teacher also didn’t know what he was doing at the time.
But I am well-aware that if you sow a good seed,
it is bound to bear good fruit.
You just have to wait a little.

我妈妈是个耶和华见证人
他们常常威胁我妈妈
说要把我们姐弟三人送到孤儿院
当时
耶和华见证人的活动受到禁止
我们需要非常小心
他们
搜查了12个小时
后来
阿列夫京娜被带去看守所
我被盘问到凌晨两点
我告诉他们我有严重的疾病，需要吃东西
但他们根本不理我
有4个月的时间
我都不能见到我丈夫
每天我都求耶和华让我忍耐得住
我的内心就感到平静
有一次上完法庭后
我正等着回牢房
旁边有一个女囚犯
我和她谈起了上帝的名字
她说
等一下等一下
我要把这个名字写下来
免得忘了
后来她被搜身检查
之后她告诉我
警卫发现了那张纸
她看到了上帝的名字
我说
没关系
现在你和那个警卫
都不会忘记上帝的名字了
我常常求耶和华让我做正确的事
我明白为什么耶稣要我们这样祷告
就是求耶和华帮助我们宽恕别人
因为这真的很难
但我们必须这么做
祷告真的很有用
除了祷告
聚会和研读也是我的救命稻草
这些事让我能继续忠于耶和华
参加大会很不容易
因为我丈夫一听到我要去
就会很生气
很多时候
我参加大会回来
都不知道要发生什么
我就是硬着头皮回去
那一次
他不在门口
他前脚才刚进屋里，我们就回来了
我趁这个空档下车
他一整天都在外面等我
等着要骂我
还有送我回来的弟兄姐妹
我常常感受到耶和华的帮助
我决心善用时间好好研读
努力让自己进步
我向耶和华恳切祷告
我说
耶和华
求求你
你让一个弟兄跟我关在一起就好
很快
就有两个弟兄来了
我们三个人
就努力一起聚会
这帮助我们保持忍耐
不过有时
我们也会意见不合
那时候大家家里都没有圣经书刊
聚会是我们唯一能听到上帝话语的途径
当时
诗歌本里有337首诗歌
我几乎都能背下来
每当我难过、害怕的时候
我就会在心里唱这些诗歌
这样就不会沉浸在消极的想法里
我会花很长的时间祷告
恳求耶和华让我
用良好的态度面对老师
虽然他骂我
还故意给我很低的分数
我却没有把他当作敌人
有些人可能觉得
我不做耶和华见证人
婚姻关系就会改善
因为有的人就是受到丈夫反对
而停止学习了
但耶和华会怎么想呢？
他会有什么感觉呢？
只要你不放弃
依靠耶和华
你就能感受到他的帮助
这样你的信心就更强
你也会知道他让你忍耐得住
让你做到靠自己做不到的事
你知道是耶和华的帮助
我没有放弃信仰
我真的做到了
坚持下来了
我做先驱13年了
我很喜欢做先驱
跟人讨论圣经
我喜欢跟人聊耶和华的事
这让我感到很快乐
就算有些人的反应不好
但他们至少有机会听到真理
谁知道他们将来会不会改变呢？
我学到的就是
不是每件事
都会按我期待的方式发展
就算是会众里的长老团
每个人的意见也不一样
但我在监狱里学到的忍耐
帮助我在意见不合的时候
用和睦的方式沟通
不做别人的绊脚石
我那时学到的忍耐
也让我享有快乐和睦的家庭生活
帮助我处理
与妻子和两个儿子之间的摩擦
现在我的两个儿子在服替代役
他们坚守信仰
也勇敢地在法庭上作见证
这让我想到过去
我父亲和我都因信仰而坐牢
当时耶和华一直照顾我们
现在他也照顾我的儿子
赐他们力量和需要的一切
让他们保持忍耐
克服挑战
在监狱里
我学到要等候耶和华
善待其他囚犯
我一有机会
就向他们传道
耶和华帮助我看出
现在不是可怜自己的时候
而是关心别人的时候
忙于做耶和华的事情
时间就会过得很快
差不多30年前
我和妻子回老家看父母
我穿过一个公园的时候
看到了小时候的那个老师
我过去跟他打招呼
他低着头
很感动地对我说
伊万
我以前对你那么不好
现在你却跟我打招呼
还对我这么友善
这件事让我学到
我们总要记得
是谁在迫害我们
迫害我们的不是人
而是撒但
人只是他的工具
就像耶稣说
“他们不知道自己在做什么”
我觉得
我的老师当时也一定不知道
他自己在做什么
但我非常确信
只要你撒下好的种子
就一定会结出好的果实
只不过你需要耐心等候

title: ‘여호와께서는 우리에게 은혜를 베풀려고 참을성 있게 기다리고 계십니다’—드라마 복습

ko.text: 우리의 형제 자매들이 실제로 겪은 일을 바탕으로 만들어진 것입니다.
그리고 그 밖의 사회 불안을 초래하는 사건들 때문에
어쩔 수 없이 집을 버리고 떠난 사람들의 수가
이제 드라마의 몇몇 장면을 다시 보면서
어떤 교훈을 배울 수 있는지 생각해 보겠습니다.
정치적 중립 입장을 타협하게 만드는 상황에 직면할 때
당원이 돼야 그 일을 할 수 있었기 때문이죠.
우리의 생각에 영향을 미치는 것들을 경계해야 합니다.
다른 장로들은 지부 사무실의 지침에 따라
하지만 아마니는 과거에 대한 좋지 않은 기억 때문에
셋째, 우리는 위급할 때 대피할 준비가 되어 있어야 합니다.
“자기의 모든 소유를 포기할” 준비가 되어 있어야 하죠.
그리고 회중 장로들의 연락처가 들어 있습니까?
가족들과 비상시에 어떻게 대피할지 연습해 보았습니까?
자녀들이 무슨 일이 있어도 여호와께 순종하고
그분을 신뢰할 수 있도록 가르쳐야 합니다.
잘 훈련받은 자녀들은 부모와 떨어져 있을 때에도
어떻게 부모 없이도 올바른 결정을 내릴 수 있었는지 함께 보시죠.
음, 이쪽으로 가면 될 거 같은데.
다섯째, 우리는 강한 믿음을 가져야 합니다.
우리가 할 수 있는 일을 다 해야 합니다.
집을 잃은 형제 자매들과 그들을 돕는 사람들을 위해
그렇게 할 때 ‘우리 가운데 있는 사랑’을 보고
여호와의 편에 서게 될 수 있습니다.
모든 것이 “창조의 시작부터 그대로 있다”는 말은
인간 역사 그 어느 때보다도 상황이 더 나빠질 거라고 말씀하셨죠.
‘우리의 길을 여호와께 맡기는’ 것에 달려 있습니다.
분명 여호와와 형제들이 여러분이 인내하도록 도와줄 것입니다.
그분의 길로 걷게 해 달라고 간절히 청하시기 바랍니다.

en.text: This year’s drama,
“Commit Your Way to Jehovah,”
was inspired by the real experiences
of real families.
Worldwide, the number of people forcibly displaced by conflicts,
violence, persecution,
and other disruptive events
has now passed 100 million,
the highest on record.
This figure includes many of our brothers and sisters
and their children.
Let’s review some scenes from the drama
and consider what lessons we can learn from them.
One:
We must immediately
and completely reject any compromise
of our political neutrality.
At first, Amani firmly declined Dunia’s job offer
because it involved membership in a political party.
But later, family pressure
and the lure of money
caused him to waver,
and it almost cost him his life.
Two:
We must be alert to influences
that can shape our thinking.
Amani’s fellow elders
followed the direction from the branch office
to prepare the congregation to flee.
But Amani’s past experiences
and strong feelings
made him think he knew better.
Three:
We must be ready to flee
in times of danger,
even being ready, as Jesus said,
to “say good-bye to all [our] belongings.”
Yakobo, Sifa, and Musa
took the direction seriously and got ready,
but Amani hesitated.
What about you?
Do you have a go bag with essentials,
important documents,
and an up-to-date list of emergency contacts,
including those of your congregation elders?
Have you rehearsed an evacuation plan with your family?
Lesson 4:
We need to train our children
to obey and trust Jehovah
no matter what happens.
When children are well-trained,
they can remain faithful
even if they’re separated from their parents.
What would your children do?
Let’s see what helped Maombi and Zawadi
to make good decisions on their own.
What are we going to do?
Well, Dad said to keep on going
toward the camp, remember?
OK, but which way is the camp?
There are two directions.
Well, I think the camp’s that way.
Actually, no, I think it’s that way.
Baba always prays before making a decision.
You’re right.
Let’s pray together and ask Jehovah to help us.
Jehovah . . .
Lesson 5:
We must have strong faith.
This time, Amani kindly but firmly rejected
Dunia’s pressure to return home.
Amani trusted in Jehovah
and in the direction from his organization.
He did not waver,
and he counted on Maombi and Zawadi
to be faithful too.
Six:
We must make the best of our circumstances
wherever we are.
Did you notice how Amani
and the other brothers and sisters
kept life as normal and stable as possible?
They played with their children.
They kept themselves and their clothes clean
and their campsite sanitary.
They socialized with friends.
They kept up their routine of preaching,
studying, and attending meetings.
And they helped others.
Finally, seven:
We must show love for our brothers
and others who are in need,
‘not just in word, but in deed and truth.’
When disasters strike,
our branch offices spring into action
to provide material and spiritual aid.
We can help, too, by giving of our time and resources
and by praying for our displaced brothers and sisters
and for those who are helping them.
The ‘love we show among ourselves’
may also help still more people to take Jehovah’s side.
Besides political crises, floods,
wildfires, and other disasters
are increasing in frequency and destructiveness.
Clearly, all things are not
“continuing exactly as . . . from creation’s beginning.”
Yet, as bad as world conditions are now,
Jesus said they’ll get worse
—worse than they’ve ever been
in all of this world’s terrible history!
Although we need to prepare in practical ways,
we cannot prepare for everything.
Our survival and our salvation
depend on ‘committing our way to Jehovah.’
So never allow pride,
family, culture,
money, possessions,
or anything else
come between you and Jehovah.
Strengthen your faith and trust
by absorbing Jehovah’s thoughts found in the Bible
and by staying close to your brothers and sisters.
You can count on Jehovah
and our brotherhood to help you endure.
And may your constant prayer be
to continue walking in Jehovah’s way
right on into the new world,
where he will make “all things new.”

cn.text: 今年的影剧
《把你的前途交托给耶和华》
是根据弟兄姐妹的真人真事改编的
在全球
有许多人因为战争、暴力、迫害
或其他灾难被迫离开家园
这个数字超过了1亿
是有史以来的最高峰
这些人当中有很多人是我们的弟兄姐妹
和他们的孩子
让我们回顾一下影片的内容
谈谈我们可以从中学到什么
第一
我们现在就要决心完全保持中立
不参与政治的事务
阿曼尼起初坚定地拒绝多尼亚给的工作
因为这份工作需要加入政党
但后来
人情的压力和金钱的诱惑
让他开始动摇
还差点因此失去生命
第二
我们要保护思考力
不要让情绪
或过往的经历等因素影响我们
阿曼尼会众的长老听从分部的指示
准备撤离
但阿曼尼因为小时候的经历
和消极的感受而不愿意听从
第三
情况危急的时候
我们要随时准备逃走
甚至要像耶稣说的
“放弃一切财物”
雅各博、西法、穆萨
认真看待指引
做好准备
但阿曼尼犹豫了
你呢？
你准备了应急逃生包吗？
里面是不是装了必需品
重要文件
紧急联络人与长老的联系方式呢？
你有没有跟家人事先演练
并熟悉逃生路线呢？
第四
我们要训练孩子
不管发生什么事
都要听从并信赖耶和华
孩子受过良好训练之后
即使跟父母分开
他们也可以忠于耶和华
你的孩子会怎么做呢？
我们来看看
为什么马奥比和扎瓦迪
可以作出正确决定
我们现在怎么办？
爸不是说要继续朝难民营的方向走吗？
好，但我们要往哪里走？
这里有两条路
我觉得应该是这条
不，也可能是那条
爸爸做决定前都会先祷告
你说的对
我们一起祷告，求耶和华帮助我们
第五
我们必须有坚强的信心
这次
多尼亚向阿曼尼施压
说要回家
但阿曼尼坚定地拒绝了
阿曼尼信赖耶和华和组织的指引
他没有犹豫
也相信马奥比和扎瓦迪
会听从指引
第六
无论在哪里
都要尽力做你能做的
在影片中
阿曼尼和其他弟兄姐妹
努力恢复正常生活
让生活有规律
他们陪孩子玩
留意衣服和住处的整洁卫生
也跟朋友一起来往
他们维持崇拜的习惯
包括传道、研读、参加聚会
他们也帮助别人
最后第七点
我们必须用真诚的行动
向弟兄姐妹和其他有需要的人表现爱心
不要只是说说而已
灾难发生时
分部办事处会立刻采取行动
提供物质和崇拜方面的援助
我们可以付出时间和提供资源
帮助弟兄姐妹
也可以为那些受灾和救灾的人祷告
我们以实际行动显出爱心
也许能吸引别人
让人想认识耶和华
现在的时代
战争、洪水、森林大火
和其他灾难越来越多
也越来越严重
很明显
我们现在这个时代
跟以往的时代很不一样
但不管现在的情况多糟糕
耶稣说
世界的情况还会更坏
比人类历史的任何一个时期都要糟糕
我们要做好充分的准备
但不可能做到万无一失
要记得
我们得救的关键
在于把前途交托给耶和华
信赖他
所以
不要让骄傲、家庭、文化、金钱、财产
或其他事物
影响你和耶和华的关系
要培养上帝的观点
努力研读
也要跟会众的弟兄姐妹经常来往
借此加强自己的信心
耶和华和整个弟兄团体
一定能帮助你忍耐到底
要不断祷告
求耶和华帮助你一直留在真理的路上
在将来的新世界里
亲眼看到上帝更新一切
