en.text: Welcome, brothers and sisters!
In our program,
we have a thrilling update
about the Ramapo project
and reports about our brothers and sisters
in Norway, Russia, and Ukraine.
We’ll also hear about the tremendous increase
in Bible studies earth wide.
And finally, we have a very exciting announcement!
Stay tuned.
Starting this month, January 2023,
we’ll resume in-person circuit assemblies and theocratic schools.
We’re thrilled to have these opportunities
to gather together again!
And we’re also looking forward
to our in-person conventions later this year.
I’m sure, like me, you’re looking forward
to singing that opening song at the convention
with thousands of our brothers and sisters.
How is the new headquarters project at Ramapo, New York, progressing?
We’re thrilled to inform you
that on December 28, 2022,
the Town Board of Ramapo
approved the zoning for the facility
and gave approval for tree removal.
This key approval
will allow the overall project to move forward.
We hope to begin clearing the site
as early as January 2023—this month!
As the project at Ramapo gains momentum,
it reminds us of how we felt about the Warwick project
and the thousands of volunteers who supported it.
Soon after we moved in from Brooklyn,
Brother Lett read an open letter from the Governing Body at morning worship.
With the Ramapo project now moving forward,
let’s hear that beautiful letter from 2016.
When we think about this first morning worship
from our beautiful new headquarters,
the Governing Body thought it would be appropriate
to provide an open letter
to thank all who have shared
in the hard work that went into this project.
How we appreciate it!
But permit me, please, to read this open letter from the Governing Body.
“Dear Brothers: On behalf of the Warwick Bethel family,
“the Governing Body would like to express deep appreciation
“for our lovely new home here at Warwick Bethel.
“How we love our new residences and offices!
“The fresh air, quiet environment,
“and beautiful scenery
“are already having a beneficial effect on how we feel.
“We are confident that now
“—with Jehovah’s blessing and help—
“we will be able to work even harder
“and accomplish even more in behalf of Kingdom interests.
“Even though we do not deserve such a wonderful place to live and work,
“we truly appreciate this generous expression
“of Jehovah’s undeserved kindness.
“We are most grateful to Jehovah
“for the more than 27,000 different brothers and sisters
“who volunteered to work on the construction of this project.
“Many of you dear friends took vacation time,
“paid your own transportation costs, lived in small rooms,
“and got up very early in the morning to ride buses or shuttles
“to the work site.
“Then you worked tirelessly in all kinds of weather,
“putting your heart into supporting
“this theocratic building project.
“Many of you accepted multiple invitations to work here.
“Unquestionably, Jehovah loves you very much
“for what you have done.
“Please be assured that the Governing Body
“loves you very much too!
“To borrow Paul’s words to the Thessalonians,
“‘you have become so beloved to us.’
“—1 Thessalonians 2:8.
“In addition to those who shared in the actual construction work,
“countless other dear brothers and sisters
“supported this project from afar.
“Self-sacrificing wives backed their husbands’ participation,
“diligent remote workers lent a hand,
“generous publishers assisted financially,
“and other loyal ones
“encouraged and provided practical help
“to those who were able to work at the Warwick site.
“Reflecting on those who helped from far away
“reminds us of 1 Samuel 30:24.
“God’s Word tells us that the ones who stayed behind with the baggage
“received the same share
“as the ones who went into battle.
“Even though we do not personally know
“the vast majority of you brothers and sisters
“who have supported this project,
“for a certainty, Jehovah knows each and every one of you.
“As Hebrews 6:10 assures:
“‘God is not unrighteous so as to forget your work
“‘and the love you showed for his name
“by ministering . . . to the holy ones.’
“Jehovah expects us to give him our best.
“That is why He found Cain’s sacrifice displeasing.
“He knew that Cain could have done better.
“—Genesis 4:5.
“But like Abel,
“you dear friends have given Jehovah your best.
“We are confident that you will continue
“to show your wholehearted love for Jehovah
“in harmony with your circumstances.
“—Genesis 4:4; Matthew 22:37.
“Additionally, the Governing Body would like to thank from the bottom of our heart
“the five brothers
“who served on the Warwick Construction Project Committee
“for their inexhaustible labors of love.
“We also want to thank profusely
“the many Bethelites who worked ‘shoulder to shoulder’
“with us in connection with this massive theocratic endeavor.
“—Zephaniah 3:9.
“Included are the brothers on the United States Branch Committee
“and the hardworking brothers and sisters
“in the Furniture Moving Department,
“the Maintenance Department, the Computer Department,
“the Broadcasting Department, the Transportation Department,
“and the Bethel Office
“who are still carrying out the gigantic task
“of moving the Bethel family from Brooklyn to Warwick.
“We would certainly be remiss
“if we failed to thank also
“the thousands upon thousands of devoted brothers and sisters
“who labored on the project at Wallkill.
“That too was a massive undertaking!
“May Jehovah bless the willing spirit
“that you dear ones have shown.
“In the Bible,
“sometimes a thought is repeated three times for emphasis.
“In this vein, we say,
“‘thank you, thank you, thank you’
“to all who have helped us and are continuing to help us
“bring this wonderful theocratic project
“at headquarters to completion!
“‘May Jehovah reward you for what you have done,
“‘and may there be a perfect wage
“‘for you from Jehovah the God of Israel,
“under whose wings you have come to seek refuge.’
“We express our warm love
“and affection for all of you!
“Your brothers, Governing Body
of Jehovah’s Witnesses.”
As was the case for the Warwick project,
thousands of volunteers from the United States
will be needed for Ramapo.
Thank you, brothers and sisters, for offering yourselves willingly,
for your heartfelt prayers,
and for your generous donations
in behalf of the Ramapo project.
Soon a special video report on the Ramapo approval
will be released on jw.org.
You may recall that in our last update,
we informed you about what is happening in Norway.
We were shocked when we received a letter
from government authorities in Oslo, Norway,
threatening to remove our registration as a religious community.
We’re happy to update you on this case.
On December 22, 2022,
the authorities announced their decision
to deregister Jehovah’s Witnesses
as a religious community in Norway.
Then, on December 28,
we filed an injunction application
with the Oslo District Court,
asking them to suspend the deregistration
until the matter had been resolved by the court.
On December 30,
the court granted a temporary injunction.
We’re very grateful to the Oslo District Court
for granting this injunction.
Please continue to pray for a successful outcome.
Recently, we’ve had some interesting developments regarding Russia.
On December 9, 2022,
the Council of Europe “strongly urged” Russia
“to reverse the ban imposed on the activities
“of all Jehovah’s Witnesses . . .
“and to discontinue
all criminal proceedings against them.”
Time will tell how the Russian government responds.
Please continue to pray
for all of our imprisoned brothers and sisters.
We have full confidence in the thoughts expressed by the psalmist
at Psalm 9:9, 10:
“Jehovah will become a secure refuge for the oppressed,
“a secure refuge in times of distress.
“Those knowing your name will trust in you;
you will never abandon those seeking you, O Jehovah.”
We’re happy that some of our brothers have been released in recent months.
For example, on November 30, 2022,
Brother Sergey Polyakov
was released after serving a three-year sentence.
But we want to keep in mind the over 175 brothers and sisters
around the world who are still in prison for their faith.
This includes Brother Andrey Vlasov,
who was sentenced to seven years in a penal colony in Russia.
The following video gives us an update on his case.
Andrey Vlasov is a seriously ill, disabled man from Siberia
whom a Russian court sentenced to seven years in a prison colony.
This peaceable, religious man was convicted
merely for believing in God and reading the Bible.
There wasn’t a single piece of legitimate evidence presented.
For example, regarding the charge of subverting
the constitutional structure of the country,
how did he do that?
There wasn’t a single example of anything my husband had done.
Supposedly, he broke up family bonds.
What families did he break up?
What are their names and places of residence?
Nothing was substantiated.
In the bill of charges, only Article 282
regarding extremism was referred to.
After Andrey had given his concluding speech
the court took a break for just five minutes
and then the judge announced the verdict
—a seven-year prison sentence.
Before we left for the hearing,
my husband asked me not to cry whatever happened.
I tried to fulfill his request.
My reaction was one of shock.
It was the same for everyone there
—friends, acquaintances, and relatives— they were all in shock.
Neither the prosecutor nor the judge considered Andrey’s health condition.
He was arrested in the courtroom
and taken to the detention center in the city of Novokuznetsk.
When he reached the detention center,
he was initially in a cell by himself.
There were huge cockroaches running around and cobwebs.
It was dirty.
He made it as orderly and livable as possible for himself so that he could stay there.
Andrey suffers from a severe form
of deformational arthrosis
of both hip joints with ankylosis,
which is a total loss of movement.
As a result, his ability to move around,
care for himself, and socialize are impaired.
Just to put his trousers on by himself (elementary things like that),
he has to lie on the floor and wrestle his way into them.
The Russian Federation
ratified a list of serious illnesses
that exempt someone from being imprisoned.
Andrey’s illness is clearly included.
To unequivocally prove this to the judge,
I procured confirmation from a specialist.
The illness can be progressive.
And, unfortunately, in Andrey’s case it is already progressing.
Despite the fact that Andrey is disabled and needs constant medical assistance,
he was put in a temporary holding cell immediately
after the authorities raided his home in 2020.
Subsequently, he was placed under house arrest.
His pretrial restrictions lasted for one year and ten months.
When under house arrest,
it was difficult for my husband to be confined at home.
He was only allowed two hours to walk around the building.
He wasn’t allowed to use the telephone or the Internet
or to associate with anyone except me,
as I lived at the same address.
Even to visit any doctor or a dentist,
we had to formally request permission
from the investigator in charge of Andrey’s case.
According to Natalia, Andrey has not lost his optimism.
He tries to keep in contact with her and his friends by writing letters.
They all hope that the Court of Cassation will release Andrey from confinement.
I’ve reflected on all that we’ve been through the last two years
and realized that I was really only frightened
when I was anticipating what might happen.
Whenever things did happen,
Jehovah was very close to me and I felt his support.
Behind Jehovah’s wall of protection,
I now see that the winds of persecution and trials
are nothing to be afraid of.
Jehovah continues to take care of Brother Vlasov,
as can be seen from this experience that he had in October:
Another brother, Aleksandr Putintsev,
was being transported in a prison train to a penal colony.
He had already traveled on the train for ten days
when it stopped in the Kemerovo Region to add more prisoners.
Our brother Andrey was loaded onto the prison train
and placed in a cell with other prisoners.
The other prisoners started to ask who he was and what he was convicted of.
He answered, “I am Andrey Vlasov,
and I am in prison for my faith in God.”
At hearing this, a man almost fell off the bench and said to Andrey,
“You and I must be fellow believers!”
Can you imagine?
Although they were  from such different regions and different prisons,
they were placed on the same train
and even in the same cell on the train!
As it turns out, the wives of these brothers
had prayed that their husbands would be able to meet.
It seemed impossible,
but Jehovah made it happen.
The brothers spent over 12 hours together!
They enjoyed a much-needed “interchange of encouragement.”
Truly, the “Hearer of prayer” knows how to care for our brothers.
And we don’t forget our three sisters in Russia
who are currently in prison for their faith:
Sister Olga Ivanova,
Sister Lyudmila Shchekoldina,
and Sister Anna Safronova.
Sister Safronova is serving
a six-year sentence in a penal colony.
That is the harshest, longest sentence
imposed on a sister since the 2017 ban.
We also keep in mind
71-year-old Brother Shamil Khakimov,
who’s been imprisoned in Tajikistan
since February 2019.
Regarding Brother Khakimov,
the Commissioner of the United States Commission
on International Religious Freedom,
Nury Turkel, stated:
“Since 2019,
“this ailing, elderly man
“has been languishing in a decrepit
“and overcrowded prison
“on a bogus seven-and-a-half-year prison sentence.
“This term could very well represent a death sentence
“for a man wrongly imprisoned
“for peacefully practicing
his religious beliefs as a Jehovah’s Witness.”
Although his sentence was reduced in 2020,
Brother Khakimov is not scheduled for release
until May 2023.
Please keep praying for Brother Khakimov.
Around the world,
our brothers and sisters are also busy with disaster relief.
For example, some months ago,
it was anticipated that many brothers and sisters in Ukraine
would need warm clothing for the winter.
So over 200 congregations in Germany
were invited to donate clothing and other basic items.
What was the result?
Approximately 36,000 pieces of clothing
and 6,500 pairs of shoes
were generously donated.
With assistance from the Poland branch,
105 pallets
with 23.7 metric tons (26.1 tons)
of donated clothing were shipped by truck to Ukraine.
One grateful brother said:
“The items we received as humanitarian aid
“help us to endure the cold and wet weather. . . .
“It was warm when I had to flee from my home
“and I could not take along any warm clothes . . .
“Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your care.
“This is vivid evidence
of the love of Jehovah, our Father.”
A sister said: “We are so touched by your generosity and kindness. . . .
“You have helped us overcome excessive worries.
“Through you, Jehovah reminded us
“that he will never leave us or forsake us,
that there is no need to be afraid and worried.”
What beautiful expressions!
Following recent natural disasters,
the reconstruction work is progressing well in Cuba,
Nigeria, the Philippines, Puerto Rico,
the United States, and elsewhere.
We keep all those affected by disasters
and those providing relief in our prayers.
And we thank all of you for your generous contributions,
which help us care for our brothers and sisters
facing these disasters.
Thank you!
Since June 2022,
when we returned to in-person forms of the ministry,
we have been hearing exciting reports from the field.
We’ve seen a tremendous increase
in the number of Bible studies.
In fact, worldwide,
we’ve seen an increase
of nearly 30 percent since May!
That means that now
more than one and a half million new Bible studies are being conducted.
Isn’t that wonderful?
Notice a few comments from branch offices around the world
about the growth we’ve observed since May 2022.
In Angola, from May to October 2022,
we had an increase of over 265,000 Bible studies.
In the lands under the Central America branch,
we’re now reporting over 680,000 Bible studies.
That’s over 20 percent more studies
than were reported in May of 2022.
In Papua New Guinea,
we’ve had a 15 percent increase in Bible studies
since our return to in-person preaching.
In the lands under the Central Europe branch,
we are happy to report an increase in Bible studies.
More than 6,800
new Bible studies have been reported
just in the first three months of the 2023 service year.
In Congo (Kinshasa), we have reported
over 290,000 additional Bible studies
since the resumption of public witnessing and the house-to-house ministry.
In the lands under the United States branch,
we had nearly 30,000 more Bible studies
in just the first two months of the 2023 service year.
In Spain, we had a 4 percent increase
in the number of Bible studies from May to October 2022.
In Mozambique, we are reporting 47,000 more Bible studies
since we have returned to our in-person ministry.
In Venezuela, we reported
over 67,000 Bible studies back in May.
But in October, we reported nearly 105,000.
It’s exciting to see Jehovah blessing the work.
In Korea, we’ve had 30 consecutive peaks
in the number of publishers.
We now have 106,050.
And we had our 27th consecutive peak
in the number of regular pioneers.
We now have 50,846.
That means almost half of the publishers
are serving as regular pioneers.
Here in Malawi,
we’ve had a tremendous increase in the number of Bible studies.
In May, we had more than 87,000 studies.
But in October,
we had more than 130,000 Bible studies.
In the Philippines, since May
the number of Bible studies has increased by more than 60,000.
And in November, for the first time,
we have crossed the 240,000 publisher mark.
Wasn’t that encouraging?
Well, here’s one more example:
In a country where the work is under ban,
there was an increase
of nearly 3,000 Bible studies since May.
It’s wonderful that, despite opposition,
the work is moving ahead!
The Governing Body is thrilled when we hear these reports
about what’s taking place in the field.
Truly, Jehovah is speeding up the work.
Recently, it was announced
that regular pioneers will once again have an hour requirement,
effective March 1, 2023.
Pioneers are now busy looking at their schedules
and planning how they’ll be able to meet the hour requirement.
The Governing Body, though, is realistic about the world situation.
Many branches have reported
that pioneers are struggling to meet their hour goal
because of the rising cost of living.
And many are contending with natural disasters,
unrest, and war.
the Governing Body considered the situation of the pioneers.
The January 1999 Kingdom Ministry  said:
“[We have] observed
“the mounting difficulties faced by pioneers,
“especially with regard to finding
“part-time secular work that will allow them
“to care adequately for their personal needs
“so as to remain in the full-time service.
“The present economic situation in many lands
“has also made it increasingly difficult
“for others to enter the pioneer work,
“even though that is their heartfelt desire.
“During recent months,
“these and other factors
have been carefully considered.”
Because of those factors,
the Governing Body decided back in 1999
to adjust the hour requirements for the pioneers.
Now, 24 years later,
as world conditions continue to deteriorate,
the Governing Body sees that our pioneers
are facing similar challenges.
Therefore, we are very pleased to announce
that the Governing Body has decided
to adjust the hour requirements for pioneers,
effective March 1, 2023.
You may want to get a pen or something to write this down on.
Are you ready?
Here are the new requirements:
For regular pioneers,
the requirement will now be 600 hours per year,
that is, an average of 50 hours per month.
For auxiliary pioneers,
the requirement will now be 30 hours.
But notice this—this is very exciting:
During March and April
and during the month of the circuit overseer’s visit,
publishers can choose to auxiliary pioneer
with a reduced hour requirement of 15 hours.
This should make it possible for many more of us
to share as auxiliary pioneers
during those months of special activity.
What about special pioneers and missionaries?
They will now have an hour requirement
of 100 hours per month.
Sisters who are serving as special pioneers or missionaries
and who are 40 years of age or older
have a reduced hour requirement of 90 hours.
How should we view these adjustments?
This is powerful evidence
of the great love and tender concern
that Jehovah feels for his people.
We want as many as possible
to retain their precious privilege of serving as pioneers.
And we feel that these adjustments will make it possible
for many more to consider taking up the pioneer work.
Since the number of people requesting Bible studies
is increasing worldwide,
there could never be a better time
to expand our share in the ministry.
If you are serving as a pioneer right now,
we hope that you’ll continue.
If you’re not yet serving as a regular pioneer,
would it be possible for you to do so?
And with the Memorial season just ahead,
no doubt all elders, ministerial servants,
and publishers will prayerfully consider
if they can auxiliary pioneer.
Can you do so?
We look to Jehovah to bless all of these arrangements
to his glory and praise!
Yes, may we all continue to do our very best
to find those who are “rightly disposed for everlasting life”!
We love you all very much!
From the World Headquarters of Jehovah’s Witnesses,
this is JW Broadcasting®.

在本期报导中
我们会跟大家分享拉马波工程的最新进展
也会告诉大家
在挪威、俄罗斯和乌克兰
弟兄们的最新情况

圣经课程的数目都有了极大的增长
最后，我们还有一个好消息要告诉大家
敬请期待！
从这个月，就是2023年1月开始
我们会恢复举办现场的
分区大会和各种训练班
我们真的非常高兴有机会
再次跟弟兄姐妹聚在一起
另外
我们也很期待参加
今年现场举办的区域大会

和成千上万的弟兄姐妹一起高唱王国诗歌

就开始清理建筑场地

看到拉马波建筑工程的顺利进行

当时有许多志愿人员积极地参与
从布鲁克林搬进来之后不久
莱特弟兄在早晨崇拜时
读了中央长老团写给大家的信

现在很适合通过一封公开信
来感谢所有参与这个工作的人员
表达我们的感谢！
现在我想读出这封
来自中央长老团的公开信
亲爱的弟兄姐妹
中央长老团代表沃威克的伯特利家庭
表达我们最深挚的感谢
我们非常爱我们的新家和办公室！
新鲜的空气，清净的环境

我们深信由于耶和华的赐福和帮助

完成更多与王国事务有关的工作

평화로웠던 이곳은 선과 악이 대립하는 곳이 되었습니다.
쿠세로브 가족이 히틀러와 나치의 요구를 따르기를 거부했기 때문이죠.
프란츠 쿠세로브는 그 전쟁에 나가 싸웠지만
후에 그의 삶과 신념이 크게 바뀌었습니다.
이 가족의 이야기를 기록해 온 사람은
만국 성경 연구회의 전 시간 봉사자가 되었습니다.
쿠세로브 가족은 지금은 아무도 이곳에 살지 않지만
제 손을 붙잡고 “하일 히틀러!” 하고서는 절 때렸습니다.
“‘하일 히틀러’는 구원이 히틀러를 통해서 온다는 뜻이야.
성서에서 배운 것처럼 하일 그러니까 구원은 그리스도를 통해서 온단다.”
여호와의 증인이 발행하는 그 잡지의 이름이
그 가르침은 자녀들의 삶에 큰 영향을 미쳤습니다.
여호와의 증인의 가르침을 굳게 믿고 있습니다.
성경에 약속된 대로 사탄이 통치하는 세상이 곧 끝나고 그리스도의 천년 통치가 시작될 것이며,
악인이 죽고 선하고 충실한 사람들이 낙원에서 살게 될 것이라고 믿고 있죠.
성경에서 무엇이라고 가르치는지 알려 주는 일을 했습니다.
뉴욕의 여호와의 증인 본부에서 온 것이었습니다.
당시 독일에는 여호와의 증인이 2만 명밖에 되지 않았습니다.
그런데도 히틀러는 증인들이 나치에 위협이 된다고 여겨
그들의 출판물을 압수하고 조직을 없애려고 했습니다.
1937년에 온 가족이 잠시 함께했던 기간에 찍은 것입니다.
그해 말에 아들 지그프리트가 수영을 하다 사망했고,
지금은 이 도시에 살던 유대인들을 존중하는 분위기이지만,
50년 전만 해도 그들을 색출해 죽이려고 했습니다.
공개적으로 전도 활동을 할 수 있습니다.
맨 아래 세 자녀에게는 먹을 것이 풍부했습니다.
그날 저는 아파서 학교에 가지 않았어요.
그런데 차 한 대가 집으로 왔습니다.
차 안에 두 사람이 타고 있더라고요.
제가 아픈 걸 보고 잠깐 멈칫하더니
경찰관 두 명이 우리를 도르스텐에 있는
경찰관 한 명의 옷이 아주 더러워졌죠.
차를 세우고 그걸 다 닦아 내느라 오래 걸렸습니다.
다른 아이들과 따로 샤워를 하게 했어요.
다른 아이들이 보지 못하게 하려고 한 거죠.
첫째 딸인 안네마리와 둘째 딸인 발트라우트는
우리의 가족이 저에게 얼마나 소중한가를 거듭 생각하곤 합니다.
그렇지만, 우리의 인도자이신 예수 그리스도께서 명령하신 대로
우리가 그분을 옹호한다면, 그분은 우리에게 상 주실 것입니다.”
독일의 증인들 대부분이 아리아인 혈통이었기 때문에
“재판 전에 아드님과 길게 대화를 나누면서 그 차분함과 강한 믿음에 감탄했습니다.
극심한 압력을 받으면서도 그는 흔들리지 않았습니다.
그는 사형 선고 시간을 통보받았을 때에도
처형 당일 아침에 저는 그의 손을 잡고 이렇게 말했습니다.
그는 제 손을 잡고 미소를 지으며 이렇게 말했습니다.
이건 제가 영원한 생명을 얻기 전에 잠시 겪는 일일 뿐입니다.’
아드님이 가족에게 인사를 전해 달라고 하더군요.
그는 결연하게 죽음을 맞이했으며 즉시 숨을 거두었습니다.”
빌헬름 쿠세로브가 히틀러와 제국을 위해 싸우다가
나치는 유가족이 빌헬름이 총살당한 뮌스터의 감옥에서 그의 시신을 가져가게 했습니다.
네, 그리고 입에도 피가 묻어 있었어요.
그 장례식에서 몇 마디 말을 했어요.
그 장례식에서 몇 마디 말과 기도를 했다는 것이 이유였죠.
그는 다하우와 작센하우젠 수용소에서 고문을 당했습니다.
그들은 감옥에서 풀려난 지 얼마 안 된 프란츠와 힐다를 다시 체포했고,
증인들은 죄수복에 특별한 표시를 달아야 했습니다.
증인들은 다른 수감자들보다 더 잘 견뎠습니다.
강한 믿음과 올바른 생활 습관 덕분에
마그달레나는 라벤스브뤼크에서 어머니와 언니를 다시 만났습니다.
어머니도 기뻐하셨고 있었던 일을 다 말씀해 주셨죠.
걷지도 못하고 혼자 옷도 못 입었는데
그 아래 동생인 볼프강도 군 복무를 거부하면서 확고한 태도를 나타내고 있었습니다.
나는 성경에 들어 있는 하느님의 말씀에 따라 여호와의 증인으로 양육받았습니다.
그분이 인류에게 주신 가장 위대하고 거룩한 법은 이것입니다.
“너는 다른 누구보다 네 하느님을 사랑해야 하고 네 이웃을 네 자신처럼 사랑해야 한다.”
그분은 “너는 살인해서는 안 된다”라는 명령도 하셨습니다.
우리의 창조주께서 숲의 나무들을 위해서 이 모든 말씀이 기록되게 하셨겠습니까?
예수와 그분의 제자들이 박해를 받았던 것처럼
오늘날 하느님의 백성들도 박해를 받고 있습니다.
예수께서 지금 땅에 계시다면 과거와 마찬가지로 오늘날에도 박해를 받으실 것입니다.
눈물로 씨를 뿌리는 자는 기쁨으로 거둘 것입니다.
이 말씀을 굳게 믿으며 저는 떠납니다.
파더보른의 이 꽃 가게에서 일하게 되었습니다.
그는 고객에게 “하일 히틀러”라고 인사하도록 명령을 받았지만 거부했습니다.
전쟁을 위한 일은 할 수 없습니다.
이 일은 전쟁을 위한 일이니까 할 수 없어요.
제 오빠는 총살을 당했고, 남동생은 참수형을 당했어요.
1944년 당시 쿠세로브 가족 중에 자유로웠던 사람은 베를린에 있던 안네마리뿐이었습니다.
누군가가 우리를 지켜보고 있었던 것 같아요.
결국 나치가 가족 전체를 체포한 것입니다.
물론 풀려날 수 있는 길이 있었습니다.
믿음을 포기하겠다는 각서에 서명하기만 하면 석방될 수 있었습니다.
체포된 수천 명의 증인 가운데 그렇게 한 사람은 단 몇 명뿐이었습니다.
제가 지금 석방된다 해도 뭘 하겠어요?
어떻게 증인이 아니라고 서명할 수 있겠어요?
살아남은 가족들과 함께 다시 삶을 꾸려 나가기 시작했습니다.
“황금 시대”가 적혀 있던 이전의 집으로 돌아가지는 못했지만
그들은 여호와의 증인으로 계속 충실을 지켰습니다.
당시 독일에서는 프로테스탄트와 가톨릭교회들이 여전히 큰 영향을 미치고 있었습니다.
일부 신자들이 나치에 반대하여 죽임을 당하기도 했지만,
유대인을 비롯한 수많은 사람이 죽임을 당할 때
나치의 대학살로 약 5000명의 여호와의 증인이 죽임을 당했습니다.
하느님이 계시며 이 모든 일에는 목적이 있다는 것을 여전히 알리고 있습니다.

en.text: The locals call this Boden’s Pool,
after the Germanic pagan god
who was credited with creating earth, sky, man, and woman.
The water is the source of the River Lippe,
which flows from the spa town of Bad Lippspringe
into the Rhine and the industrial areas of the Ruhr Valley.
Today, it’s a peaceful and prosperous little town,
just as it was 60 years ago
when Franz and Hilda Kusserow arrived here with their 11 children.
What began as a peaceful idyll became an epic battle between good and evil,
as the Kusserows defied Hitler and the Nazi regime.
Franz and Hilda Kusserow were married in 1911,
three years before the Great War that traumatized Europe.
Franz Kusserow fought for his country, but his life and beliefs were transformed.
The Kusserows’ story has been lovingly chronicled
by the eldest of the 11 children, Annemarie, now age 78.
Annemarie’s parents were born
into a comfortably-off Protestant environment,
but the First World War
and the chance meeting with a Jehovah’s Witness
dramatically changed their lives.
Franz, a post-office clerk, and Hilda, a former schoolteacher,
became full-time missionaries
for the International Bible Students Association.
They came to this house on the outskirts of Bad Lippspringe
to set up congregations in North Westphalia.
No Kusserows live here today,
but when members of the family do return, there are vivid memories.
Magdalena is the Kusserow’s fourth daughter.
What are your early memories of this house?
Well, it was so nice.
We played here in the garden,
in this little place, and then there also.
We had some trees
with apples and some fruit.
We had some potatoes,
salad, and different things.
We played. We danced together.
And then we took some flowers and made a ring on the head.
Then we went down with the geese to the river
—to the river to bring the geese.
They have to—
They could . . .
Swim?
Swim also, yes.
And we swam also.
You took the geese for a swim?
Yes.
And on the way, they took the grass, and they ate.
And we had much fun.
It’s a long time since I was here
—not since 1939, I think.
The door seemed bigger then.
Hans-Werner, now 63, was the Kusserows’ tenth child.
It was a very happy time,
especially as I had so many brothers and sisters.
Everything was happy until I went to school.
That was bad, of course.
Every day when children went to school,
they thought in advance:
‘What will happen today?
What will happen today?’
I remember many things.
I remember how strong we were,
how we didn’t salute the flag,
how we wouldn’t say “Heil Hitler,”
and how we acted a bit differently from other pupils.
Some days were hard.
The teacher was like a devil.
She took my hand, and she said:
“Heil Hitler! Heil Hitler!” and beat me.
Would you say you were frightened when they would hit you?
Did you never say “Heil Hitler”?
No, no, we never said it because my father said:
“Look, ‘Heil Hitler’ means
“that the salvation comes from Hitler.
“As we learned from the Bible,
the heil—the salvation— comes by Jesus Christ.”
The Kusserows’ house was known as “The Golden Age.”
A huge sign advertising the Jehovah’s Witness magazine
was emblazoned in gold letters outside their home.
Inside, the parents gave the children their love and their time,
and they taught the Bible and music
—lessons which would have a lifetime’s impact.
The Kusserows, then and now,
firmly believed the creed of the Jehovah’s Witnesses
—that our world, now influenced by Satan,
will soon be transformed into the Thousand Year Reign of Christ
promised in the Bible.
The evil will die,
while the good and faithful will be physically reborn into Paradise.
I was from morning to evening
visiting people who liked to know what the Bible says
about the preaching work, or missionary work.
They liked to receive me.
Much of the literature distributed by the Kusserows
came from the Witnesses’ headquarters in New York.
In Germany, the Witnesses were a very small sect of just 20,000 people,
and yet Hitler saw the movement as a rival ideology to the Nazis.
So he set out to seize their literature and wreck the organization.
So where were the books and the literature? Where were they hidden?
Here also. Here also and there.
Under the stairs?
Yes, from there and also . . .
Up here.
And how many times did the police come to the house?
Oh, many, many times.
And they hid them here?
Here? Yes.
Here.
So under the eaves?
Yeah, in the roof.
And then the books here—ten meters.
They came how many times did you say?
Eighteen times—16, 17, 18.
And they always searched in this area?
And did not find the books.
The Nazis weren’t easily dissuaded.
“The Golden Age” sign on the Kusserows’ house was blacked out.
But although the Witnesses had been officially banned,
the family maintained their religious activities in secret.
She said: “Magdalena, you go behind
“—three, four meters behind me.
You carry the Bible, and I’ll have nothing in my hands.”
And she spoke with the people.
And there was one man; I don’t know who he was.
He was a stranger.
He didn’t belong to Bad Lippspringe, and he denounced us.
He called the police.
In 1936 was the first time
my mother was arrested in Paderborn.
This was the first time.
Franz and Hilda Kusserow were among the hundreds of Jehovah’s Witnesses
arrested by the Gestapo in 1936.
They were briefly reunited in 1937
when this last complete family photograph was taken.
Later that year,
their son Siegfried died in a swimming accident.
His death signaled the end of the idyll.
By now, most Germans were wallowing in nationalistic pride
and revived economic fortune.
Communists, gypsies,
homosexuals, dissidents, the handicapped and, above all, the Jews
were hunted down even in Bad Lippspringe.
Today, the town memorializes its former Jewish residents.
Little more than 50 years ago,
they were hounding them out and baying for their blood.
It seems a long while ago.
For the moment, dissidents are tolerated.
Jehovah’s Witnesses can sell their magazine, The Watchtower,
and openly recruit converts.
In the 1930’s,
this street in Paderborn was dominated by the prison.
And this is where the Kusserows were jailed.
Witnesses began to lose their jobs and pensions.
The Gestapo stepped up their surveillance.
But the Kusserows’ garden was still supplying fresh produce.
The three youngest members of the family were being well cared for.
They were the next target.
At that time, I was ill and didn’t go to school.
I was lying in bed here.
Suddenly, a car drove up.
There seemed to be two civilians in it.
I could see them from the window.
They burst in and wanted me to go with them.
They hesitated because I was ill, so for appearances’ sake,
they took me to a doctor to see if I could be taken away.
Then they collected my sister and brother from school,
and we left.
We were taken from school.
My brother who was ill was collected from home.
We were taken by two policemen to the orphanage in Dorsten.
I can still remember how I vomited all over the jacket of one of the policemen.
It took a lot of effort to clean it up once the car stopped.
Then the journey continued to Dorsten and the orphanage.
In the morning, he again told us to give the Hitler salute.
And when we refused, he took us into a room,
laid us across the table,
and beat us black and blue.
It was bad.
We took a shower every evening,
and when the female head of the house saw us,
she made us bathe separately
so that the other children would not see.
It was very bad.
When the Second World War began,
the two oldest Kusserow daughters, Annemarie and Waltraud,
escaped surveillance and left to find jobs in Berlin.
It was more difficult for their brothers.
In December 1939, Wilhelm, after refusing military service,
was thrown into jail.
“Dear Parents, Brothers, and Sisters:
“All of you know how much you mean to me,
“and I am repeatedly reminded of this every time I look at our family photograph.
“How harmonious things always were at home!
“Nonetheless, above all else,
“we must love God —as our Führer, Jesus Christ, commanded.
If we stand up for Him, he will reward us.”
As predominantly Aryan Germans,
Jehovah’s Witnesses were sometimes allowed the privilege of a Nazi trial.
Later, Wilhelm’s court-appointed lawyer, Dr. James Roher, wrote to the family:
“I had long conversations with your son before his trial
“and admired his calm confidence of faith.
“He never wavered,
“although he was severely pressed from all quarters.
“He calmly accepted the announcement of the hour of his execution,
“refusing again to change his mind,
“that is, to abandon his faith and save his life.
“On the morning of the execution, I took his hand and said in consolation:
“‘Mr. Kusserow, you have been wonderfully strong.
“Remain strong now.’
“He squeezed my hand and smilingly replied:
“‘No, Doctor, don’t be troubled.
“‘I am gaining everlasting life.
“All this is only a change.’
“He asked me to send you his greetings.
He stood upright when facing death and was dead at once.”
Unable to browbeat the Witnesses,
the Nazis tried lies and subterfuge.
With an elaborate ritual of deceit, they issued certificates and reports
declaring that Wilhelm Kusserow had died a hero’s death,
fighting for Hitler and the Third Reich.
For some unknown reason,
the Nazis allowed the family to collect Wilhelm’s body
from Münster Prison, where he’d been shot.
His sister Waltraud helped to arrange the funeral.
It shocked me deep,
but Wilhelm was true until his death.
I have seen the body
in the little hall there,
and he was in a pilot suit.
And here, like, here . . .
The bullet holes?
Yeah, holes and some blood was in the mouth.
There was a big funeral with the secret police around
and with persons in uniform —policemen.
And my brother Karl
said some words.
And later, my brother Karl
because he spoke a few words and the prayer,
the Gestapo kept him.
Karl, son number three, was the next arrested.
He was brutally tortured in Dachau and Sachsenhausen concentration camps.
In April 1941, the Gestapo swooped again.
After a brief release from jail, Franz and Hilda Kusserow were rearrested,
as were their daughters Hildegard and Magdalena.
Nazi tenants took over the house
that once proclaimed the dawning of a golden age.
The Kusserows were sent to concentration camps,
where the Witnesses were forced to wear distinctive insignia.
The Jews wore a yellow star;
the Witnesses, a purple triangle.
When we went through the concentration camp,
we saw this purple triangle.
Then I knew that there’s my sister.
I said: “Hello, Sister. How are you?
What’s your name? Where do you come from?”
The Witnesses fared better in the camps than many prisoners.
Absolute conviction in their faith and strict discipline
helped their morale.
Soon Magdalena was joined at Ravensbrück
by her mother and her sister Hildegard.
I saw my mother.
I was so happy, and she told me everything.
She was happy.
And it was really good because I had swollen arms.
I couldn’t walk.
I couldn’t dress myself because of this sickness or something.
And my mother dressed me; she fixed my hair.
Despite the evil and hardship at Ravensbrück,
Frau Kusserow kept her faith.
Her son Wilhelm had given his life for the faith,
and his younger brother Wolfgang, when called for military service,
showed true Kusserow defiance.
I was brought up as one of Jehovah’s Witnesses
according to God’s word contained in the Holy Scriptures.
The greatest and most holy law he gave mankind is:
“You shall love your God above all else
and your neighbor as yourself.”
Other commandments read: “You must not kill.”
Did our Creator have all this written down for the trees?
Just as Jesus Christ and his disciples were persecuted,
so are God’s people also persecuted today.
I know for sure that if Jesus Christ were to live on earth today,
he would be persecuted just as he was then.
Wolfgang was beheaded on March 28, 1942.
The night before, he wrote:
“My Dear Parents and My Dear Brothers and Sisters:
“I shall leave you as your third son and brother
“early in the morning.
“Be not sad.
“The time will come when we shall be together again.
“Those who sow with tears will reap with joy.
“At James 1:12, it says:
“‘Blessed is the man that endureth temptation:
“for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life,
“which [Jehovah] hath promised to them that love him.’
“In this faith and in this conviction,
“I go from you.
Your son and brother, Wolfgang.”
By now, Waltraud had returned from Berlin
and managed to find work in this florist shop in Paderborn.
She was ordered to greet customers with the “Heil Hitler” salutation.
She refused.
After being given eight days to change her mind,
she still refused and was arrested
and imprisoned in Paderborn and told to make ammunition.
I cannot work for the war.
For this, I cannot work; this is for the war.
My brother was killed, was shot.
My other brother was beheaded.
My three sisters, little ones,
the Gestapo have kept.
And my other brother is in a concentration camp;
my mother is in a concentration camp;
my two sisters and also my father are in prison.
No, I cannot make them.
By 1944, just one member of the Kusserow family was free,
Annemarie, who was still in Berlin.
Every week,
I had with me in my apartment
some persons
to have a Bible study.
And therefore, I was arrested.
There must have been a person who had observed us.
The Nazis had rounded up every single member of the family.
Some were dead and the future for the rest uncertain.
Yet, they had a lifeline.
Unlike all other prisoners,
Jehovah’s Witnesses could secure their release
simply by signing a declaration that they’d abandon their faith.
Of the thousands arrested, only a handful did so.
I was not ready to sign.
I thought:
‘Oh, I have to think of my parents,
‘my little children
‘—I mean my brothers and my sisters.
‘They are so faithful, so obedient,
‘although we were all separated.
‘We were all separated.
‘And when I am now free,
‘what should I do?
‘My conscience —I have thought it over.
It is impossible to be unfaithful.’
How could I sign that I am not a Witness?
How could I leave my faith?
Never, never, never!
In April 1945, Ravensbrück concentration camp was liberated.
Hilda Kusserow and her daughters were released.
Imprisonment had strengthened their faith,
and morally the Witnesses had defeated the Nazis.
Hilda was reunited with her husband
and, with the surviving members of their family, rebuilt their lives.
Although they never returned to their “Golden Age” home,
they always remained faithful Jehovah’s Witnesses.
They were back in a Germany where the Protestant and Catholic churches
were still the predominant religious groups.
Despite rebellion and martyrdom by some believers,
most church leaders had bowed the knee to the Nazis.
Hitler, confirmed a Catholic, was never excommunicated.
The church was silent while millions of Jews and others died.
Among the organized Christian religions in Germany,
it was only the Jehovah’s Witnesses
who refused any compromise at all with Hitler and the Nazis.
Like the first Christians, they too were reviled and ridiculed
and they were martyred.
Among the millions who perished in the Holocaust,
there were some 5,000 Jehovah’s Witnesses,
and yet those who survived proclaimed that there is a purpose to all this.
There is a God.

cn.text: 当地人把这个池塘叫做博登池塘
博登是德国民间传说里
创造了天、地、人的神
这是利珀河的源头
从巴德利斯普林奇小镇
利珀河经过鲁尔工业区
最终流入莱茵河
今天
这个平静而富裕的小镇跟60年前一样
那时候
库斯罗夫妇带着他们的11个孩子
搬到了这里
库斯罗夫妇不肯服从希特勒和纳粹政权
于是，这个小镇就变成了
正义与邪恶交战的战场
库斯罗夫妇于1911年结婚
三年后，第一次世界大战就爆发了
弗朗兹参军作战
但不久后
他的人生和信仰就完全改变了
库斯罗家的长女安妮玛莉，现年78岁
她把库斯罗一家的故事整理了出来
库斯罗夫妇
都出生于富裕的基督新教徒家庭
但他们的生活因为第一次世界大战
和认识耶和华见证人
而完全改变了
弗朗兹曾在邮局里工作
希尔达在学校里做老师
但后来
他们俩都成了
万国圣经研究者的全时传道员
为了在北威斯特伐利亚建立会众
他们夫妇搬到了
巴德利斯普林奇小镇的这所房子里
现在，库斯罗家已经没有人住在这里
但他们回到这里时
往事依然历历在目
马格达莲娜是库斯罗家的第四个女儿
你记得以前在这里做过什么吗？
这里有很多很好的回忆
我们会在花园这里玩
也会在那里玩
我们种了很多果树
也种了一些马铃薯、生菜
还有很多东西
我们会一起玩，一起跳舞
我们也会采一些花朵
做成花环，戴在头上
然后，我们也会跟鹅到河边去
带着鹅，跟它们，它们可以……
游泳？
对，游泳
我们自己也会去游泳
跟鹅游泳？
对！
我们回来的路上
也会拔一些草，喂鹅吃
真的很好玩
很久没有回来过了
从1939年以后就没有回来过
以前觉得门很大
汉斯·沃纳现年63岁，在家里排行第十
那是一段快乐的时光
因为我有很多兄弟姐妹
但上学后，情况就不同了
我们遇到很多麻烦
每天，弟弟妹妹在上学之前
他们都会想
今天会怎么样呢？
今天会发生什么呢？
我记得，那时我们都很坚强
我们没有向国旗敬礼
也没有喊“希特勒万岁！”
我们跟其他学生都不一样
那段时间真的很辛苦
那个老师就像个魔鬼一样
她捉住我的手说
“希特勒万岁！”
然后就开始打我
你真的不害怕吗？
你从来没有说过“希特勒万岁”吗？
没有，从来没有
因为爸爸说，这句话的意思是
“拯救来自希特勒”
但是圣经说
其实拯救是来自耶稣基督的
库斯罗家住的房子被人叫做“黄金时代”
这是因为他们在房子外墙
用金色的颜料写了“黄金时代”
为耶和华见证人的杂志做宣传
在这所房子里
库斯罗夫妇付出了爱心和时间
教导孩子圣经和音乐
使儿女终身受益
库斯罗一家坚信耶和华见证人的信仰
就是目前的世界被撒但统治
但圣经保证
很快，基督的千年统治就会取代撒但的统治
到时候，邪恶的人会死去
而正义的人会复活过来，在乐园里生活
我每天从早到晚，都会出去传道
我去拜访那些感兴趣的人
跟他们分享圣经的真理
他们都很愿意接待我
库斯罗一家分发的刊物
大多来自耶和华见证人位于纽约的总部
德国的耶和华见证人只有2万，人数不多
但希特勒却非常憎恨他们宣传的道理
他设法没收他们的刊物、消灭他们的组织
你们会把书刊都藏在哪里呢？
这里，这里，还有那里
楼梯下面？
对，是的，还有那里也有
那里吗？
警察一共来过多少次呢？
哦，很多很多次
也藏在这里？
嗯？
哦，对，这里
藏在这下面吗？
对呀
那时，这里放了一些石头
后面放了很多书
你说，他们来过多少次？
18次，来了18次！
每次他们都搜这里吗？
但他们一本书都没有找到
纳粹党并没有罢休
库斯罗家房子上的“黄金时代”这几个字
被涂掉了
虽然耶和华见证人的活动被禁止
但他们仍然在秘密地进行崇拜活动
妈妈说
“你拿着圣经，跟在我后面
到离我三四米远的地方去”
然后，她就开始向人传道
开始跟人交谈
我发现有一个陌生的男人
我不认识他
因为他不是住在我们镇上的人
后来，他向警察告发我们
1936年，我的母亲第一次被捕了
她被关在帕德博恩的监狱里
这是她第一次被捕
那一年，像弗朗兹和希尔达一样
很多耶和华见证人都被盖世太保逮捕了
1937年，他们一家重聚的时候
拍下了最后一张全家福
之后不久
西格弗里德在游泳时发生意外而丧生
之后，小镇就失去了宁静
德国人被民族优越感和经济复苏冲昏头脑
甚至在这个小镇
共产党员、吉普赛人
同性恋、残疾人等等
特别是犹太人都被逮捕
今天，小镇上的人很尊重犹太人
但50多年前，犹太人却被赶尽杀绝
时过境迁，现在这里已经自由多了
耶和华见证人也可以公开地传道
并向人分发《守望台》杂志
20世纪30年代
帕德博恩这条街两边都是监狱
库斯罗家的人都被囚禁在这里
耶和华见证人有的被解雇
有的失去养老金
盖世太保也加强监视
库斯罗一家在院子里种了作物
所以仍然有食物吃
但家里最小的三个孩子
成了下一个被攻击的目标
那天，我生病了
所以，我就留在家里
躺在床上，就在这里
忽然，有一辆车开到我们家门前
我看见车里有两个人出来
他们闯进来，想把我带走
但他们有点犹豫，看见我生病了
就假装关心我，带我去看医生
看能不能把我带走
然后，他们到学校找到我的姐姐和弟弟
把我们一起都带走了
他们到学校找我们
我哥哥生病在家
所以他们到家找哥哥
两个警察送我们到多尔斯滕的孤儿院
我还记得，有一个警察被我吐了一身
他很不容易才把外套弄干净
然后，我们就继续前往多尔斯滕的孤儿院
到了早上
他们又让我们喊“希特勒万岁”
我们不肯说
他就带我们到一个房间
让我们躺下，然后把我们打得遍体鳞伤
我们每天晚上都会洗澡
孤儿院的女院长不让我们跟其他孩子一起洗
免得别人看见我们身上的伤痕
我们真的伤得很重
第二次世界大战爆发后
家里最大的两个女孩
安妮玛丽和瓦尔特劳德到柏林去找工作
对家里的男孩来说，情况更不容易
威廉因拒绝服兵役而被捕入狱
“亲爱的爸妈和兄弟姐妹

我每一次看我们的合照
都会特别想念你们
以前的生活是多么美好啊！
但就像我们的领袖耶稣吩咐的那样
最重要的是要爱上帝
如果我们对他保持忠义
他必定会奖赏我们”
德国的耶和华见证人大多是欧裔白种人
因此，有时可以获得受审的机会
后来
威廉的律师在写给库斯罗一家的信中
这样说

他的信心真的令人钦佩
尽管受到很大的压力
他从来没有动摇过
他平静地接受了死刑的判决

在他被处决的那天早上
我握着他的手，对他说
库斯罗先生

他握了握我的手，笑着说

我会得到永远的生命
这不过是刹那间的改变
他拜托我代他问候你们
他昂然面对死亡，很快就断了气”
纳粹党威吓不成，就造谣惑众
他们举行隆重的仪式为威廉颁发证书
并发表报告说
威廉是为希特勒和第三帝国英勇战死的
不知道出于什么原因
纳粹党让库斯罗一家
从明斯特监狱领回威廉的遗体
瓦尔特劳德帮忙安排葬礼
我很震惊
但威廉至死都保持忠贞
我在那个小礼堂
看到他的遗体
他穿着军队的制服
这里，这里还有那个……
弹孔？
对，弹孔
他嘴里也有血
葬礼的规模很大
周围都是警察
还有一些警察穿着便服
我的一个弟弟，就是卡尔
他在葬礼上负责致词
卡尔负责致词
由于他说了一些话，还向上帝祷告
后来，盖世太保逮捕了他
下一个被逮捕的
是库斯罗家的第三个儿子卡尔
他在达豪集中营和萨克森豪森集中营
饱受折磨
1941年，盖世太保再次发动迫害
库斯罗夫妇被短暂释放之后，再次被捕
两个女儿希尔德加德和马格达莲娜
也一同被捕
纳粹党还没收了那座
宣扬“黄金时代”的房子
库斯罗家的人被送到集中营
在那里
耶和华见证人都必须戴着明显的标志
黄色星型代表犹太人
紫色三角，代表耶和华见证人
我们到了集中营后
如果看到谁的衣服上有紫色三角
我就知道那是我们的姐妹
我会说
“姐妹你好！
你叫什么名字？
你从哪里来？”
耶和华见证人的情况
比其他囚犯要好一些
由于有坚定的信念，惯于吃苦耐劳
他们能够保持坚强的意志
马格达莲娜很快就在集中营里
见到了妈妈和姐姐希尔德加德
能看见妈妈，我真的很高兴
妈妈也很高兴，还告诉我很多事
妈妈来了真好
因为我的手臂肿了
那时，我不能走路
也不能自己穿衣服
我可能是得了什么病吧
现在，妈妈会帮我穿衣服
帮我梳头发
虽然在拉文斯布吕克集中营受到恶待
希尔达仍然坚守信仰
她的一个儿子威廉牺牲了
现在，另一个儿子沃尔夫冈被征召入伍
他的立场也很坚定
“我从小就受圣经里记载的
上帝的话语所教导
成为一个耶和华见证人
上帝给人最大和最神圣的诫命就是
我们应该全心全意爱上帝
也要爱人如己
也有一条诫命说
不可杀人
难道我们的造物主把这些诫命写下来
是给树木看的吗？
以前，耶稣和他的门徒都受到迫害
现在，崇拜上帝的人也一样受到迫害
我深信，如果耶稣基督今天还在地上生活
他也同样会受到迫害”
1942年3月28日，沃尔夫冈被斩首
临死之前，他写道
“亲爱的爸妈和兄弟姐妹
作为你们的儿子和兄弟
明天早上我将会离开你们
请不要伤心，因为我们很快就会重聚
流泪撒种的，必欢呼收割
雅各书1:12说
在考验下保持忍耐的人有福了
因为他们会获得生命的冠冕
这是耶和华承诺赐给始终爱他的人的
我对这一点深信不疑
再会了！
你们的儿子和兄弟，沃尔夫冈”
那时，瓦尔特劳德已经从柏林回到这里
她到帕德博恩这家花店找工作
花店的老板要她向客人说“希特勒万岁”
但她不肯
老板给了她八天时间，她还是不肯说
之后，她就被关在帕德博恩的监狱里
并被叫去制造军火
我不可以做跟战争有关的工作
我不能做这个工作，这等于支持战争
威廉被枪毙了，沃尔夫冈被斩首
还有，我的妹妹
我的三个妹妹都被盖世太保抓走了
妈妈和卡尔被关在集中营里
爸爸和两个妹妹也在狱中
不，我绝对不能做那样的工作
1944年，库斯罗家只有一个人没有被抓
就是安妮玛莉
她还住在柏林
每个星期
我都会邀请别人到我的公寓里
跟我学习圣经
所以，我后来也被捕了
我想一定是有人在监视我们
库斯罗家的所有人
都受到了纳粹党的猛烈迫害
有的被杀，有的前途未卜
但他们还有一个机会
跟其他人不同
耶和华见证人只要签署声明放弃信仰
就可以得到自由
但在数千个被捕的耶和华见证人当中
只有几个人签字了
我是不会签字的
我是这样想的
我的父母还有家里的小孩子们
就是我的弟弟
还有我的妹妹
他们都那么忠贞，那么服从
我们现在都不在一起，我们分开了
如果我签字之后获释了
我会怎么样呢？
我仔细想过了
我的良心绝不允许我背叛耶和华
我怎么能签字
说自己不再是耶和华见证人呢？
我怎么能离弃信仰呢？
不可能，绝对不可能！
拉文斯布吕克集中营解放了
希尔达和她的女儿们重获自由
狱中的经历加强了她们的信心
从道义的角度来说
耶和华见证人战胜了纳粹政府
希尔达跟丈夫以及其他的家人重聚
恢复了正常的生活
他们没有回到原来的房子居住
但他们一直是忠贞的耶和华见证人
在德国
基督新教和天主教
仍然是社会上的主流宗教
虽然有些教徒不惜以身殉道
但绝大多数的宗教领袖都向纳粹党屈膝了
希特勒是天主教徒
但他从来没有被开除教籍
眼看着数百万人被杀
教会也一直保持沉默
在德国所有的宗教团体中
只有耶和华见证人
拒绝向希特勒和纳粹政权妥协
像1世纪的基督徒一样
他们被嘲笑、受迫害、被杀害
在大屠杀遇难的人当中
包括大约五千个耶和华见证人
幸存的耶和华见证人都强调
“我们没有白白受苦，真的有上帝！”

title: 게리트 뢰시: “진리의 기둥”

ko.text: 이 말은 상대적으로가 아니라 절대적으로 거짓입니다.
어떤 사람에게는 진리인 것이 다른 사람에게는 진리가 아니라고 생각하는 사람들이 있죠.
많은 종교가 자신들이 진리를 가르친다고 주장합니다. 하지만
그 종교들의 가르침은 서로 모순되는 경우가 많습니다.
이것은 모든 진리가 상대적이고 절대적인 진리는 없다는 증거일까요?
굳건하고 신뢰할 만하고 안정되고 충실한 것을 가리킵니다.
따라서 많은 경우 진리는 감춰져 있던 것을 밝히는 것과 관련이 있습니다.
“주의 깊이 감추어진 것은 모두 드러나게 되어 있고, 은밀한 것은 모두 알려지게 되어 있습니다.”
예수께서는 자신이 하는 말이 진리임을 강조하기 위해 특별한 표현을 사용하셨습니다.
그분은 문장을 시작하실 때 “아멘”이라고 자주 말씀하셨습니다.
이 말에 해당하는 히브리어는 “확실한, 참된”이라는 의미입니다.
「신약 신학 신 국제 사전」은 이렇게 지적합니다.
“예수께서는 아멘으로 말씀을 시작하심으로써 그 말씀이 확실하고 신뢰할 만한 것임을 명시하셨다.
그분은 그 말씀을 끝까지 지키셨고 그 말씀이 자기 자신과 듣는 사람들에게 구속력이 있게 만드셨다.”
「신약 신학 신 국제 사전」 제3권 901면에서는 이렇게 알려 줍니다.
“[많은 사람들은] 그 누구도 그 무엇도 진리를 소유하고 있다고 진정으로 주장할 수 없다는 신념으로
언제 어디서 나오든지 진리에 대해 나타내는 겸손한 복종[을 보여야 한다.]
진리에 대한 그와 같은 개방 정신이 진리의 하느님을 숭배하는 사람들에게 요구[된다.]
진리에 대한 합당한 숭상은 사람이 자기 이웃을 대할 때 말과 행동에서 정직하게 만든다.
이것이 우리가 본 바, 구약과 신약에서 증거하는 태도이다.”
V.R.루제로라는 사람이 「생각하는 기술」 이라는 책에서 그런 질문을 했는데요.
“때때로 [진리가 변하는] 것처럼 보일 수 있지만, 더 면밀히 조사해 보면 그렇지 않음이 밝혀진다.”
“성서의 첫째 책인 창세기의 저자 문제를 생각해 보자.
여러 세기 동안 그리스도인들과 유대인들은 한결같이 창세기는 단일 저자의 책이라고 믿었다.
마침내 창세기의 저자가 무려 다섯 명이나 된다는 신념으로 대치되었다.
창세기에 대한 5년에 걸친 언어 분석 결과가 발표되면서,
원래 생각대로 단일 저자일 가능성이 82퍼센트임이 명시되기에 이르렀다.
“진리는 우리의 지식이나 우리의 무지에 의해 바뀌는 법이 없다.”
사실 진리가 없다고 믿는 사람은 아무도 없습니다.
의학이나 수학이나 물리 법칙과 같은 분야와 관련해서는 모든 사람들이 특정한 점들이 진리라고 믿습니다.
만일 공기 역학의 법칙이 절대적 진리라고 생각하지 않는다면 우리 중 누가 위험을 무릅쓰고 비행기에 타겠습니까?
실증될 수 있는 진리들이 우리 주위에 존재하며
우리는 우리의 목숨을 걸 정도로 그 진리들을 신뢰합니다.
우리가 진리를 더 잘 이해하게 됨에 따라
진리에 대한 우리의 이해는 변하지만 진리 자체는 결코 변하지 않습니다.
유대인들은 자기들의 신성한 기록을 오랫동안 읽으면서 진리를 이론이 아니라 실제적인 것으로 여겼습니다.
이 단어는 확고한 것, 견고한 것,
그리고 무엇보다도, 신뢰할 수 있는 것을 의미합니다.
유대인들에게는 진리를 그렇게 여길 만한 타당한 이유가 있었습니다.
그들은 자기들의 하느님을 “진리의 하느님 여호와”라고 불렀습니다.
그분이 최종 심판을 내리시면 그 심판은 집행되었습니다.
수많은 이스라엘 사람들은 그러한 일을 실제로 목격했습니다.
영감받은 성경 필자들은 그러한 일을 논란의 여지가 없는 역사적 사실로 기록했습니다.
신성하게 여겨지는 다른 경전들과는 달리 성경은 신화나 전설을 배경으로 삼지 않았습니다.
성경은 역사적, 고고학적, 과학적, 사회학적으로 증명할 수 있는 것들, 즉
실증될 수 있는 사실들에 확고한 바탕을 두고 있습니다.
시편 필자가 여호와에 관해 이렇게 말한 것도 당연합니다.
예수 그리스도께서는 여호와께 기도하실 때 시편 필자와 비슷한 말씀을 하셨습니다.
절대적으로 확고하고 신뢰할 수 있는 것임을 알고 계셨습니다.
예수께서 하신 모든 말씀과 행동은 참된 것, 즉 진리였습니다.
모세 율법도 진리였지만 온전한 진리는 아니었습니다.
예수의 가르침은 모세 율법과는 다른 점이 있었습니다.
성경에서는 모세 율법이 그리스도를 통해 오게 되어 있는
“내가 여러분에게 말할 것이 아직도 많지만 지금은 여러분이 그것을 감당할 수 없습니다.
그러나 그 곧 진리의 영이 오면 여러분을 모든 진리 안으로 인도할 것입니다.
그는 자기 뜻대로 말하지 않고 듣는 것을 말할 것이며 앞으로 올 일을 여러분에게 알려 줄 것입니다.”
하느님의 영은 그들이 맡은 임무를 수행하기 위해 알아야 할 모든 것을 가르쳐 줄 것이었습니다.
이해하지 못한 것들을 생각나게 해 주고 이해할 수 있게 해 줄 것이었죠.
또한 하느님의 영은 다가오는 일도 알려 줄 것이었습니다.
그중에는 예수의 죽음과 부활에 어떤 의미가 있는지 알려 주는 것도 포함되었죠.
그런 일들은 당시 제자들에게는 아직 미래의 일이었고,
제자들은 그 의미를 이해하지 못하고 있었죠.
찰스 테이즈 러셀 형제는 「시대에 관한 하나님의 경륜」이라는 책을 저술했습니다.
그 책에는 “성경은 이치의 빛 안에서 보인 하나님의 묵시”라는 주제 아래 이런 말이 나옵니다.
“성경 말씀의 깊이와 힘과 지혜와 그 말씀이 다루는 범위는
그 책이 사람이 아니라 전능한 하나님에게서 나온 것임을 확신시켜 준다.”
진리를 더 소중히 여기기 위해 진리를 몇 가지에 비해 보겠습니다.
진리는 사물을 있는 그대로 볼 수 있게 해 주고,
필요하다면 우리의 외모를 개선할 수 있게 해 주는 거울과도 같습니다.
거짓 가르침에 맞서 싸우게 해 줍니다.
또한 진리는 전사가 착용했던 “허리띠”에 비할 수 있습니다.
옳은 일을 계속 행할 수 있도록 도와주죠.
진리는 추운 밤에 피워 놓는 따뜻한 모닥불과도 같습니다.
많은 분들이 좋아하실 만한 비유를 들어 볼까요?
진리는 하루를 활기차게 시작할 수 있게 해 주는 모닝커피와도 같습니다.
진리는 폭풍우가 치는 바다에서 배를 잡아 주는 닻과 같습니다.
진리는 밤에 배가 해안이나 항구로 안전하게 갈 수 있게 해 주는 등대와도 같습니다.
진리는 항해할 때 방향을 알려 주는 나침반과 같습니다.
밀림에서 안전한 곳으로 빠져나올 수 있게 해 주는, 방향을 알려 주는 나침반과 같죠.
진리는 대지를 밝은 빛으로 물들이는 떠오르는 태양과도 같습니다.
진리는 우주에서 오는 해로운 방사선으로부터 지구를 보호해 주는 자기장과도 같습니다.
성경에서는 “빛의 열매는 온갖 … 진리”라고 알려 줍니다.
또한 “누구든지 참된 일을 행하는 사람은 빛으로 나아온다”고 말하죠.
여러분이 태어날 때부터 앞을 볼 수 없었는데 수술을 통해 보게 되었다면 정말 기쁘지 않겠습니까?
진리를 깨닫고 사랑하게 될 때 느끼는 감정이 바로 그와 같습니다.
진리는 혼자서 또는 오케스트라가 연주하는 아름다운 음악과도 같습니다.
진리는 아기에게 젖을 먹이는 어머니와 같습니다.
진리는 무더운 날에 마시는 시원한 물과 같습니다.
댐을 만들어 물길을 막으려고 해도 그 위로 흘러넘치죠.
진리가 전능하신 하느님 여호와에게서 나오기 때문입니다.
진리는 아름다운 꽃 한 송이 또는 꽃다발과도 같습니다.
“진리는 생명의 광야에 핀 수수한 작은 꽃처럼, 무성하게 자란 오류의 잡초에 둘러싸여 거의 질식할 지경에 놓여 있다.
진리의 꽃을 찾으려면 계속 유의해서 살펴보아야 한다.
진리의 아름다움을 보려면 오류의 잡초와 편협의 가시덤불을 헤쳐 나아가야 한다.
진리의 꽃을 소유하려면 그것을 얻으려고 기꺼이 자신을 낮추어야 한다.
하나로 충분했다면, 더 이상의 꽃이 없었을 것이다.
진리는 다이아몬드보다 훨씬 더 가치가 있습니다.
여호와와 친구가 되게 해 주고 영원한 생명을 얻게 해 주기 때문입니다.
진리는 우리가 걷는 길에 비할 수 있습니다.
그러므로 그분을 숭배하는 사람들은 영과 진리로 숭배해야 합니다.”
진리를 배울 수 있는 그리스도인 집회에 참석해야 합니다.
회중은 진리가 더럽혀지지 않게 보호하고 진리를 옹호합니다.
여호와께서는 성경뿐만 아니라 그리스도인 집회를 통해서도 우리를 가르치십니다.
또한 우리는 전파 활동을 통해 진리를 말해야 합니다.
형제들과 함께 있을 때도 진리를 말해야 하죠.
우리의 입에도 진리가 있어야 하고, 허리에도 진리를 둘러야 합니다.
에베소서 6:14에서는 우리가 “진리의 허리띠를 둘러야” 한다고 말합니다.
세상은 무엇이 진리인지 모르고 혼란에 빠져 있습니다.
진리를 안다는 것은 얼마나 큰 축복입니까!
우리는 기꺼이 진리를 전하고 진리를 가르칩니다.
우리는 진리를 말하고 진리 안에서 걷습니다.
지금 진리 안에서 걷는 사람들은 영원히 그렇게 하게 될 것입니다.
“모든 민족은 저마다 자기 신의 이름으로 걸을 것이나 우리는 영원토록 우리 하느님 여호와의 이름으로 걸을 것이다.”
연구생이 진리를 사랑하고 진리에 따라 살도록 도와주십시오.
필요하다면 진리와 여호와를 위해 목숨을 버릴 수 있을 정도가 되어야 합니다.
진리는 결코 없어지지 않으며 이 악한 세상을 이길 것입니다.
진리 안에서 걷고 진리에 대해 말하겠다고 굳게 결심해야겠습니다.
우리가 진리를 사랑하고 진리의 하느님을 사랑하기 때문입니다.
또한 우리는 그리스도인답게 생활함으로 진리에 따라 살아야겠습니다.
형제 여러분, 우리는 진리를 가지고 있습니다!
그렇게 하면 영원히 살면서 진리의 하느님을 찬양하게 될 것입니다!

en.text: Is the following statement true or false?
“Truth is relative.”
That statement is not relatively but absolutely false.
Some think that something is truth for one person
but not truth for another person.
Many religious organizations claim to have the truth.
However, between them there are many contradicting teachings.
Is this just another evidence that all truth is relative
—that there is no absolute truth?
No.
The truth is that truth is not relative;
it is absolute.
Those who say truth is relative
are not only relatively but absolutely wrong.
The Hebrew word for “truth,” ʼemethʹ,
is often rendered “truth”
and may designate what is firm,
trustworthy, stable, or faithful.
The Greek word for “truth,” a·leʹthei·a,
originates with a word meaning “not concealed,”
so the truth often involves the revealing
of that which was formerly hidden.
Jesus said according to Luke 12:2:
“But there is nothing carefully concealed that will not be revealed,
and nothing secret that will not become known.”
There are over 70 places in the Gospel accounts
where Jesus is said to have used a unique expression
to emphasize the truthfulness of his words.
He would often say “Amen”
to introduce a sentence.
The corresponding Hebrew word meant “certain, true.”
Notes The New International Dictionary of New Testament Theology:
“By introducing his words with amen
“Jesus labelled them as certain and reliable.
“He stood by them and made them binding
on himself and his hearers.”
The New International Dictionary  of New Testament Theology,
Volume 3, page 901, says:
“[Many people try] to ‘unmask’ everything,
“in the belief that no one and nothing
“can genuinely lay claim to truth. . . .
“Truth can indeed be found . . .
“[We need to display] a humble submission to truth
“whenever and wherever it emerges.
“Such openness to truth is required
“of those who worship the God of truth . . .
“Reverence for truth ensures honesty
“in a man’s dealings with his neighbour,
“both in word and deed.
“This is the attitude . . . to which both the O[ld] T[estament]
and the N[ew] T[estament] bear witness.”
Does the truth ever change?
That question was raised by V. R. Ruggiero
in his book The Art of Thinking.
His answer is no.
To quote him:
“It may sometimes seem to [that it changes],
but on closer inspection it will be found not to.”
Yes, the truth never changes!
“Consider,” he says, “the case of the authorship
“of the first book of the Bible, the book of Genesis.
“For centuries Christians and Jews alike
“believed that the book had a single author.
“In time this view was challenged,
“and eventually replaced by the belief
“that as many as five authors contributed to Genesis.
“Then, in 1981,
“the results of a 5-year linguistic analysis of Genesis
“were published, stating that there is
“an 82 percent probability of single authorship,
“as originally thought.
“Has the truth about the authorship of Genesis changed?
“No.
Only our belief has changed.”
He also wrote:
“The truth will not be changed by our knowledge or by our ignorance.”
And we agree.
In fact, no one really believes that there is no truth.
When it comes to physical realities,
such as medicine, mathematics, or the laws of physics,
all people believe that some things are true.
Who of us would dare to ride in an airplane
if we didn’t believe that the laws of aerodynamics
were absolute truths?
Verifiable truths do exist.
They surround us, and we stake our lives on them.
Does the truth ever change?
It does not.
Our understanding of truth changes
as we progress in understanding it,
but the truth never changes.
When Jesus said that our purpose in life was to talk about the truth,
he was speaking of something that faithful Jews had valued
for centuries.
In their sacred writings, the Jews had long read of truth
as something concrete, not theoretical.
In the Bible, “truth” translates the Hebrew word ʼemethʹ,
which signifies that which is firm, solid
and, perhaps most of all, reliable.
The Jews had good reason for viewing truth in that way.
They called their God, “Jehovah, the God of truth.”
This was because everything Jehovah said he would do, he did.
When he made promises, he kept them.
When he inspired prophecies, they were fulfilled.
When he uttered final judgments, they were carried out.
Millions of Israelites had been eyewitnesses of these realities.
The inspired writers of the Bible
recorded them as indisputable facts of history.
Unlike other books viewed as sacred,
the Bible is not set against a backdrop of myth or legend.
It is firmly grounded in verifiable facts
—historical, archaeological, scientific,
and sociological realities.
No wonder the psalmist says to Jehovah:
“Your law is truth. . . .
“All your commandments are truth. . . .
The very essence of your word is truth”!
Since Jehovah God is the Author of the Bible,
the Bible is truth.
Jesus Christ echoed the words of that psalm
when he said in prayer to Jehovah:
“Your word is truth.”
Jesus knew that everything his Father spoke
was absolutely firm and reliable.
Likewise, Jesus himself was “full of . . . truth.”
Yes, Jesus was even the personification of truth.
The Mosaic Law was truth.
But it was not the full truth.
Jesus taught something different from the Mosaic Law.
The Bible shows that the Mosaic Law
was a “shadow,” or prophetic picture,
of greater realities, which came true through Christ.
So the Mosaic Law was not the full truth
but a pattern of it.
Jesus was not the shadow but the reality.
He said at John 14:6:
“I am . . . the truth.”
But as far as teachings are concerned, what is truth?
What helps us to understand it?
The Bible speaks of “the spirit of the truth.”
What is “the spirit of the truth”?
It is the spirit that proceeds from Jehovah God.
It is pure and holy.
Jesus told his disciples at John 16:12, 13:
“I still have many things to say to you,
“but you are not able to bear them now.
“However, when that one comes,
“the spirit of the truth,
“he will guide you into all the truth,
“for he will not speak of his own initiative,
“but what he hears he will speak,
“and he will declare to you
the things to come.”
God’s spirit would teach them everything they needed to know
to carry out their work,
recalling and opening up their understanding
to things they had previously heard from Jesus
but had not understood.
God’s spirit would also declare to them the things coming,
including the bringing to light
the significance of Jesus’ death and resurrection,
as these events were then yet future
and were among the things
that his disciples did not understand in the beginning.
Brother Charles Taze Russell wrote the book
The Divine Plan of the Ages.
It was published in 1886.
It included a discussion on
“The Bible as a Divine Revelation
Viewed in the Light of Reason.”
It said:
“The depth and power and wisdom and scope of the Bible’s testimony
convince us that not man, but Almighty God, is the author.”
To appreciate the truth more,
to what can we compare the truth?
Truth is like a mirror that helps us to see the facts
and, if necessary, to improve our looks.
Truth is like a pillar —firm and supportive—
and it helps to combat false teachings.
Truth is also compared to a girdle, or “belt,”
that warriors used.
It helps us to continue with right conduct.
Truth is like a rainbow for beauty.
Truth is as beautiful as the song of the nightingale.
Truth is like a romantic bonfire for warmth
on a cold evening.
Here is an illustration that many of you will like:
Truth is like the first cup of coffee in the morning,
invigorating somebody.
Yes, truth is invigorating.
Truth is like a magnet,
drawing honest-hearted ones to God.
Truth is like an oasis in the desert.
Truth is like an anchor in the stormy seas.
Truth is like a lifeboat on a sinking ship.
Truth is like a lighthouse in the night,
guiding a boat safely to the shore or harbor.
Truth is like a compass showing sailors the way.
But it is also like a compass
showing the way out of a jungle to a safe area.
Truth is like the rising sun bathing the landscape in warm light.
Truth is like the display of fireworks for beauty.
Truth is like the magnetic shield around the earth,
protecting it from deathly cosmic radiation.
Truth is like light.
“The fruitage of the light consists of every sort of . . . truth.”
He that “does what is true
comes to the light,” the Bible says.
Imagine you were born blind and received eyesight through an operation.
Wouldn’t you be elated?
Truth is like that when somebody comes to know and appreciate it.
Truth is like beautiful music played solo or by an orchestra.
Truth is like the most delicious food for taste and gives strength.
Truth is what a nursing mother is to her baby.
Truth is like a hidden treasure; we need to dig for it.
Truth is like refreshing water on a hot day.
Truth is like a mighty river.
If you try to stop it with a dam, it will overflow the dam.
Nobody can stop the truth.
Why?
Because Jehovah, the Almighty, is backing it up.
Truth is like a flower
or even a bouquet of beautiful little flowers.
Brother Russell once wrote:
“Truth, like a modest little flower
“in the wilderness of life,
“is surrounded and almost  choked
“by the luxuriant growth of the weeds of error.
“If you would find it you must be ever on the lookout.
“If you would see its beauty you must brush aside the weeds of error
“and the brambles of bigotry.
“If you would possess it you must stoop to get it.
“Be not content with one  flower of truth.
“Had one been sufficient there would have been no more.
Gather ever, seek for more.”
Truth is like a fragrance, or perfume.
Truth is like a sparkling diamond.
Do you love diamonds?
But the truth’s value is so much more than diamonds
because it brings Jehovah’s friendship
and leads to everlasting life.
Truth is compared to a way on which we walk.
Second Peter 2:2 speaks of “the way of the truth.”
‘God is a Spirit,
and those who worship him must do so with spirit and truth.’
Now is the time to study the truth
and attend Christian meetings where the truth is taught.
Do not miss congregation meetings.
First Timothy 3:15 compares the congregation
with “a pillar . . . of the truth.”
The congregation preserves the purity of the truth
and upholds it.
True, Jehovah teaches us through the Bible
but also through Christian meetings.
We are also to speak the truth by preaching.
We speak the truth also with one another.
We have the truth on our lips;
we have the truth around our hips.
Ephesians 6:14 says
that we have “the belt of truth fastened around [our] waist.”
The world is in utter confusion.
What a blessing it is to know the truth!
We rejoice in it!
We are ready to preach the truth and teach the truth.
Yes, we talk the truth, and we walk in the truth.
At 3 John 3, we read:
“Go on walking in the truth.”
Those who walk in the truth now will walk forever.
Micah 4:5 says:
“For all the peoples will walk, each in the name of its god,
“we will walk in the name of Jehovah our God
forever and ever.”
And that is a long time!
Help your students to love the truth and to live the truth
but, if necessary, to be willing to die for the truth and for Jehovah.
The truth is invincible and will conquer this wicked world.
May we all, including our relatives
and our Bible students,
have the determination to walk in the truth
and talk about the truth.
Why shall we do this?
Because we love the truth and we love the God of truth.
We are also to live the truth by our Christian conduct.
Brothers, this is the truth!
His Word is truth.
Keep talking the truth, and keep walking in the truth.
Then you will walk forever and praise our loving God of truth!

cn.text: 你觉得这句话是对还是错呢？
“真理是相对的”
可以说
这句话绝对是错的
有些人以为真理适用于某一个人
但不一定适用于另一个人
许多宗教组织都声称自己拥有真理
而实际上
这些组织的教义却互相矛盾
这是不是说明真理是相对的
世上没有绝对的真理呢？
不是的
事实上
真理并不是相对的，而是绝对的
有些人以为真理是相对的
他们的看法绝对不对
被译作“真理”的希伯来语词“埃梅特”
指的是信实真诚、可信可靠
正确详实的事
译作“真理”的希腊语词“阿莱蒂阿”
源自于另一个词，意思是
“并非隐藏起来”
可见
真理意味着
将以往一向隐藏的事揭示出来
在路加福音12:2
耶稣说
四福音书记载
耶稣有70多次使用一个独特的措辞
去强调他的话是真实的
在圣经原语里
耶稣说话时，通常先说“阿们”
“阿们”这个词的意思是
实在的、真实的
《新编国际新约神学辞典》解释说
“借着用阿们去介绍自己的话
耶稣表明
他的话是实在的，是可靠的
他自己遵守这些话
也鼓励他的听众照着去做”
《新编国际新约神学辞典》
在第3册第901页解释说
“很多人凡事都想揭露真相
因为他们认为没有任何人或事
能真正自称是真理
真理确实可以找到
但我们需要保持谦卑
无论真理在什么时候显露
都乐意接受
想要崇拜拥有真理的上帝
这样的开明态度是必不可少的
一个人如果尊重真理
就一定会在言行上都诚实地对待别人
无论是在旧约圣经里
还是在新约圣经里
都有很多这样的例子”
说得很好
真理会改变吗？
作家鲁杰罗
在他写的《思考的艺术》一书中
也提出了这个问题
他的答案是
不会
他解释说
“有时真理看来改变了
但我们若进一步仔细查看
就会发觉它其实没有改变”
是的，真理永远不会改变
鲁杰罗还说
“我们可以举一个例子
就是圣经第一部书创世记的作者
一直以来，基督徒和犹太人都相信
这部书只有一位作者
后来这个看法受到质疑
最后，人们认为
一共有五个人执笔写作了创世记
后来，在1981年
学者就创世记
做了一项长达5年的语言分析研究
结果显示
创世记只有一位作者的可能性是82%
跟原来的观点相同
关于创世记作者的真理有改变吗？
没有，只是我们的信念改变了”
鲁杰罗还说
“不论我们知道还是不知道
真理并不会因此就有所改变”
我们很同意
事实上
所有人都相信世上确实有真理
在医药、数学、物理法则等实际问题上
我们都相信
有些事是确定不移的
假如我们不相信空气动力学定律
是绝对真理
谁还敢坐飞机呢？
能够证实的真理
的确存在，随处可见
我们能活着，也有赖于它们
那真理会改变吗？
真理不会改变
随着我们在真理中不断地进步
我们对真理的理解可能会改变
但是，真理本身不会改变
耶稣曾说，我们都应该传讲真理
而一直以来
忠心的犹太人都非常珍视真理
在他们的神圣著作里
犹太人一向将真理视为确凿不移的事
而不仅仅是理论
在圣经里
被译作“真理”的希伯来语词“埃梅特”
所包含的意思是
稳确牢固
以及信实可靠
犹太人对真理的看法是有着充分的理由
他们称自己的上帝耶和华是信实的上帝
耶和华是言出必行的上帝
他许下诺言，就一定会履行
他启示人写下预言
就一定会使预言应验
他作出判决，就一定会执行这些判决
许许多多的以色列人
都亲眼见证过这些事
圣经执笔者在上帝启示下
把这些真实的历史事件记了下来
跟其他所谓的圣典不同
圣经不是以神话或传说为背景的
圣经的记载都是以真实的事件为根据的
这包括历史、考古、科学
以及社会等方面的真实事件
诗篇执笔者谈到耶和华时说
“你的法律是真理”
“你的诫命全是真理”
“你话语的本质是真理”
因为圣经的作者就是耶和华上帝
所以圣经也是真理
耶稣基督在祷告时说的话
跟诗篇执笔者类似
“你的话语就是真理”
耶稣深知天父所说的一切话
都是绝对稳确
绝对可靠的
同样，耶稣自己也充满真理
我们甚至可以说
耶稣就是真理的化身
摩西法典也是真理
但不是全部的真理
耶稣基督教导的
就跟摩西法典有所不同
圣经指出
摩西法典只是“影子”，不是实体
它预示将来通过基督实现的更美好的事
因此可以说
摩西法典不是全部的真理
只是一个“影子”
但耶稣不是“影子”
而是实体
在约翰福音14:6
他说
“我就是真理”
但什么样的道理算得上是真理呢？
什么能帮助我们理解真理呢？
圣经谈到“显示真理的神圣力量”
这指的又是什么呢？
它就是耶和华上帝发出的力量
既神圣又圣洁
耶稣对门徒说
神圣力量会把门徒需要知道的一切
都教导他们
帮他们执行使命
神圣力量也会帮他们想起耶稣说过的话
并明白其中的含义
而有些事，他们之前并不能理解
另外，神圣力量也会向他们宣讲将来的事
这包括耶稣的死亡和复活的重大意义
由于这些事当时还没有发生
所以门徒之前并不完全理解
查尔斯·罗素弟兄
写了《上帝的历代计划》这本书
这本书于1886年出版
在这本书里
罗素弟兄讨论了
“以理智的眼光去看上帝的启示”这个问题
他这样写道
“圣经的深刻、力量、智慧和广博
使我们深信这本书绝非来自人
而是来自全能的上帝”
为了帮助我们更加珍视真理
我们可以把它比作什么呢？
真理就好像一面镜子
帮助我们看清楚自己
也作出一些必要的调整
真理就像是栋梁
稳固而结实
能够帮助我们抵抗错误的道理
真理像古代士兵全副盔甲当中的腰带
能帮助我们继续做对的事
真理像天空中美丽的彩虹
真理像夜莺唱的动听的歌
真理像寒夜里
为了取暖而点燃的温暖的篝火
真理也像你们大家都很喜欢的一个东西
就是早上醒来的第一杯咖啡
让你充满力量
没错，真理能给人力量
真理像磁铁
吸引心地正直的人归向上帝
真理像沙漠中的绿洲
真理像波涛怒吼时的船锚
真理像下沉的船上的救生艇
真理像夜里的灯塔
引领船只平安地抵达港口
真理像指南针
给水手指引方向
它也能帮助那些在丛林中迷失的人
回到安全的地方
真理像是初升的太阳
让一切都沐浴在温暖的阳光里
真理像夜空中绚丽的烟花
真理像地球四周保护我们的磁场
让我们不会受到宇宙辐射的伤害
真理像光
真理是光明结出的果实之一
圣经说
实践真理的人都会到光这里来
假如你生来就失明
后来接受手术恢复了视力
你会不会很兴奋呢？
人认识真理并珍视真理
他的感受也是这样的
真理像独奏或乐队演奏的美妙的音乐
真理就像美味可口的食物
给人加添力量
真理像照顾婴孩的慈爱的母亲
真理像隐藏的宝藏
我们需要努力挖掘它
真理像炎热天气里一杯清凉的水
真理像汹涌奔流的河
就算你修建大坝阻挡它
它也会越过大坝
谁也阻挡不了真理之河
为什么呢？
因为它来自于全能的上帝耶和华
真理像一朵或一束漂亮的小花
罗素弟兄曾写道
“真理像生命旷野里的一朵朴实小花
四周都长满谬误道理的杂草
几乎使真理之花窒息
你要找到这朵花
就得不断寻找
你要看到这朵花
就得清除谬误道理的杂草和偏见的荆棘
你要拥有这朵花
就得弯腰采摘
不要只拥有一朵真理之花就满足
假如一朵就够
世上就不会有这么多花了
要不断采摘，不断寻找”
真理像迷人的香水
真理像闪闪发光的钻石
你喜欢钻石吗？
但真理的价值比钻石大得多
因为它可以帮我们与耶和华建立友谊
并让我们得到永远的生命
真理像我们行走的道路
彼得后书2:2也提到
“真理之道”
崇拜上帝的人必须在神圣力量的引导下
按照真理崇拜他
现在我们就要认识真理
并通过参加基督徒聚会来学习真理
千万不要缺席聚会
提摩太前书3:15
把会众比作“真理的栋梁”
基督徒会众维护真理、捍卫真理
耶和华通过圣经
也通过基督徒聚会
来教导我们真理
我们在传道时宣扬真理
彼此间也会谈论真理
我们把真理放在舌尖
也会把真理系在腰间
以弗所书6:14说
我们“要把真理当作腰带束上”
坦率说，现在整个世界一片混乱
我们能够认识真理多么有福
我们因真理而欢欣
也随时准备好了
宣扬真理，教导真理
我们要谈论真理
也要按真理而生活
约翰三书3节这样说
“按真理处世为人”
这样做的人会永永远远走下去
弥迦书4:5说
我们有很长的路要走
要帮助你的学生热爱真理
按真理生活
甚至愿意为了真理和耶和华而牺牲
谁都不能消灭真理
但它会战胜这个邪恶世界
愿我们
我们的亲朋好友、圣经学生
都下定决心
谈论真理，按真理而生活
为什么要这样做呢？
因为我们热爱真理
也热爱赐人真理的上帝
我们也要跟随耶稣
按照真理而生活
弟兄们，这就是真理
他的话语就是真理
要继续谈论真理
按真理而生活
这样，我们就能永远
追随、赞美赐人真理的上帝
