title: 가짜 평화에 속지 마십시오!—데럴 프라이싱어와 데버라 프라이싱어

ko.text: 신혼 때, 예상하지 못한 어려움들을 많이 겪었죠.
우린 맨날 싸웠고, 서로 말도 하지 않았어요.
우린 한 번도 장로들을 찾아간 적이 없죠.
우리 문제는 우리가 알아서 할 수 있다고 생각했죠.
여러 면으로 상황이 더 나빠질 뿐이었죠.
한번은 사고를 쳐서 경찰이 온 적도 있었어요.
남편과 함께 살다가 이제 혼자 지내게 되니까
그제서야 장로들의 도움을 좀 받아야겠다는 생각이 들었습니다.
우리가 별거 중이었기 때문이었던 것 같아요.
전 결혼 서약에 대해 생각해 봤습니다.
믿지 않는 남편과 결혼한 후에 진리를 받은 자매였죠.
자녀들을 집회에 데리고 가지 못하게 했어요.
그리고 우리 부부 사이를 생각해 봤습니다.
두 사람이 모두 열심히 노력해야 했죠.
여호와를 생활의 첫째 자리에 두기 위해
이 세상에서 완벽한 결혼 생활을 하는 건 불가능하지만
여호와를 첫째 자리에 두면 분명 더 나아질 수 있죠.
별거하는 건 아무런 문제도 해결해 주지 못합니다.
그러면 여호와의 축복을 받을 수 있죠.
자녀들이 모두 여호와를 충실히 섬기고 있죠.
우리는 “여호와가 얼마나 선하신 분인지 맛보아 알”려고 노력해야 합니다.

en.text: Newly married life came with a lot
of unexpected challenges.
You dream about the way your marriage will go,
but then the reality is quite different.
All we ever did was argue,
or we wouldn’t speak to one another.
We never ever went to the elders.
We just didn’t want to bother them.
We just felt, you know, we needed to figure it out ourselves.
We decided that if the house sold,
then we would separate.
The separation wasn’t a good thing,
because in some respects it made things worse.
It did have an impact on the boys.
They started acting out.
They got into some trouble with the police one time.
And there was a loneliness because you’ve gotten married,
and now you don’t have that, and you’re by yourself.
And the same old routine went on where you’re
cooking and cleaning and doing laundry and working.
I felt sick to my stomach.
I had a hard time getting up every morning and facing the world.
At that point, I felt that I needed
to have the elders help out a little bit.
I did pray for Jehovah’s help to direct me,
and I kept wondering why Jehovah wasn’t really
answering my prayers.
But I kind of realize now that it was because we were separated.
The expectations of the separation were not at all what I was thinking.
I reflected on the marriage vows.
One of the things I thought
about was a sister in our congregation.
She was married to an unbeliever, and then she learned the truth.
And he was so violent.
He would beat her; he would burn her books; he would burn her clothes.
He did not allow her children to attend the meetings.
And I thought about the problems that Darrel and I had.
And I thought: ‘Well, Darrel is a kind person.
He’s never done that.’
And I thought:
‘You know, this is something
‘that we need to really work on.
‘We need to really put forth the effort
‘to start applying Bible principles
‘to put Jehovah first in our life
so that we can bring our marriage back in union with Jehovah.’
I realized that it wasn’t what I wanted,
but it was what Jehovah wanted.
There was just no other choice.
Jehovah wasn’t going to bless us unless we got back together.
When we got back together, our marriage was still a work in progress.
You can’t have a perfect marriage in this world,
but you can sure make it better when you put Jehovah first.
We enjoyed the feelings we had toward each other.
I felt closer to Debbie.
Debbie and I have been married now for 48 years.
Separation does not make anything better at all.
If you even have an inkling of love for one another,
you want to work on that, and you want to make it bloom
so that Jehovah can bless it.
The blessings have been endless.
Our children are all doing
fantastic in the truth.
Jehovah said: “Taste and see that [He] is good.”
So we’ve got to do that.

cn.text: 结婚之后
我们遇到很多没想过的问题
我原本对婚姻充满期待
但现实生活却完全不一样
我们不是争吵就是冷战
我们没有去找长老
因为不想麻烦他们
我们觉得
就是我们想要自己解决问题
我们当时决定
房子一卖出去就分居
分居并没有解决什么问题
反而造成了更多问题
分居对儿子有很大的影响
他们越来越叛逆
有一次他们做的事让警察都来了
分开生活以后
我觉得很寂寞
因为以前有丈夫陪伴
但现在就我一个人
我要自己做饭
打扫、洗衣服
还要去上班
我痛苦极了
早上醒来什么都不想做
不想面对这个世界
在那个时候
我发现我应该去找长老
向长老寻求帮助
我当时一直祷告求耶和华帮助我
但是我觉得
耶和华都没有回应我的祷告
后来我才明白
问题的根本是在分居这件事情
分开后的生活和我想的一点都不一样
我想起结婚时许下的承诺
我也看到会众里的一个姐妹
她结婚后认识真理
她的丈夫非常暴力
也极力反对她的信仰
她的丈夫会打她
烧她的书
烧她的衣服
也不让他们的孩子参加聚会
然后我想到我的丈夫
其实他好像还不错
他从来不会这样对我
然后我想
我们确实要采取行动了
我们要努力把圣经原则在生活上运用出来
也要把耶和华当作生活的重心
这样我们的婚姻才能得到耶和华的认可
我开始明白
最重要的不是我的想法
而是耶和华的想法
我们只有一个选择
因为只有重新一起生活
耶和华才会赐福给我们
当然搬回去之后
我们还是需要努力
现在我们不能期望有完美的婚姻
但只要有耶和华在家庭中就一定会更好
我们的关系也更紧密
感情也更好了
我们结婚到现在48年了
遇到事情就分居不是解决问题的办法
就算你们的爱只剩一个小火苗
也不要放弃努力
让你们的爱再次燃烧起来
这样耶和华才能赐福给你
福分还不止如此
我们的孩子全部都热心崇拜耶和华
我们努力尝尝主恩
就知道耶和华是良善的

titles.en: Do Not Be Misled by Imitation Peace!—Darrel and Deborah Freisinger
titles.cn: 不要被虚假的安宁所骗！——达雷尔．弗赖辛格、德博拉．弗赖辛格

title: 가짜 평화에 속지 마십시오!—치비사 셀레마니

ko.text: 우리 가족은 영적으로 아주 잘하고 있었어요.
그런데 저희 가족의 경제적인 상황이 나빠졌어요.
그래서 그날 먹을 음식을 살 돈도
그 결정 때문에 영적으로 큰 영향을 받았는데
저는 거기 언어를 할 줄 몰라서
또 그렇게 가족과 멀리 떨어져 있다 보니
가장 역할도 제대로 할 수가 없었습니다.
외국으로 온 것이 잘못된 결정이라는 것을 깨달았고
아마 경제적인 여유를 추구하려고 했을지 모릅니다.
그리고 가족을 떠난 지 약 6개월 만에 다시 돌아와
그리고 그 행복은 지금도 계속되고 있죠.
성경을 연구하는 게 큰 도움이 되었습니다.
어디서든 문제를 겪지 않고 살 수는 없다는 걸 기억하려고 합니다.
또 어느 때보다 여호와와 가깝다고 느낍니다.

en.text: As a family, we were doing very well spiritually.
We did family worship, went preaching,
and went to the meetings together.
After some time, we began
to encounter financial problems.
At times, we did not even have money to buy food
for each day.
Many people in our area were going to South Africa
to provide basic needs for their families.
So I decided to go as well,
leaving behind my wife to take care of our seven children.
This affected me spiritually
because I did not know the language, I was unable to preach,
and I did not benefit from the meetings.
Being so far from my family
caused me to neglect my responsibility as a family head.
As a result, my family grew weak spiritually
and we all missed each other very much.
I realized that I had made a wrong decision going abroad.
My conscience started to trouble me greatly.
Then I remembered the example of Baruch
found at Jeremiah 45:5.
Baruch may have wanted to pursue material riches as I had.
When he was helped, he returned.
I decided then to put Jehovah in first place
instead of searching for material things.
So I started to make changes to go home
and help my family spiritually.
When I left South Africa and reached the border of Malawi
(after leaving my family for about six months),
I felt great happiness in my heart,
and I am still happy till now.
Studying the Bible has helped me.
We still encounter financial problems,
but I remember that in Satan’s world,
there is nowhere we can go and have no problems.
Now I serve as an elder.
My family is progressing spiritually.
And this makes me very happy,
because my relationship with Jehovah is strong.

cn.text: 以前
我们家在崇拜上帝方面做得很好
我们会举行家庭崇拜
一起传道
一起去聚会
后来我们遇到了经济难题
有时甚至连买食物的钱都没有
我们这里有很多人都去南非打工
赚钱养家
所以我也决定去那里打工
让妻子在家照顾我们的七个孩子
这大大影响了我跟耶和华的关系
因为我不懂那里的语言
不能从聚会受到鼓励
也不能出去传道
我不在家人身边
所以没办法负起家主的责任
好好照顾他们
结果
整家人都跟耶和华疏远了
我们也因为见不到彼此而非常难过
我这才意识到
去国外打工是一个错误的决定
我感到很后悔
我想到了
耶利米书45:5里巴录的例子
巴录很可能像我一样
想要追求物质财富
他受到提醒以后就改正过来
我决定要像巴录一样
把耶和华放在生活的首位
不再把赚钱当作生活的重心
于是我决定回家
帮助家人巩固跟耶和华的关系
在离开家六个月以后
我从南非回到家乡马拉维（马拉威）
到达边境的那一刻
我真的开心极了
到现在我都还是很开心
研读圣经给我很多帮助
我们还是会有经济难题
但是我知道
在撒但的世界里
不管在哪里
都会有难题
现在，我是一个长老
我们一家人
跟耶和华的关系都越来越好了
这让我非常开心

titles.ko: 가짜 평화에 속지 마십시오!—치비사 셀레마니
titles.en: Do Not Be Misled by Imitation Peace!—Chibisa Selemani

title: “평화의 군왕”을 충성스럽게 지지하십시오

ko.text: 하지만 정말 조금도 속해 있지 않을까요?

그러다 보면 마음의 평화를 잃을 수 있고, ···
어느 한쪽 편을 들게 될 수 있습니다.
··· 저는 세상에 속해 있지 않기 때문입니다.

en.text: “I am no part of the world.”
But is the world a part of me?
I’m pressured every day
to get involved in political issues that affect me socially,
. . . environmentally,
. . . and economically.
That pressure could rob me of my peace of mind
. . . and influence how I think.
I could take sides in my heart,
even if I’m not aware of it.
But I know that Jehovah
will care for all of mankind’s concerns
. . . by means of his Kingdom
ruled by his Son, Jesus Christ.
I show my support for him in my prayers,
. . . in how I think and feel,
. . . and by teaching others
what the Kingdom will do for mankind.
I know there are millions
of brothers and sisters all over the world
. . . who loyally support the “Prince of Peace”
just like me, because I
. . . I am no part of the world.

cn.text: 我不属于世界
但我真的没有让这个世界影响我吗？
每天我都会受到压力
因为政治议题影响到生活的各个方面
比如社会问题
环境问题
还有经济问题
这种压力让我失去了内心的安宁
也影响了我的想法
我一不留神
就在心里支持了其中一方
但我知道耶和华会解决人类的所有问题
就是通过上帝的王国
通过他的儿子耶稣基督
为了支持耶稣
我会在祷告中提到这件事
我会留意自己对事情的看法和感受
我会教导别人上帝的王国将要成就的事
我知道在世界各地有好几百万的弟兄姐妹
都在和我一起忠贞地支持和平的领袖
因为我
我
我
不属于世界

en.text: Through Isaiah,
Jehovah promised to feed his servants
physically
and spiritually.
Today, Jehovah invites us to a banquet
that is spiritually nourishing.
Bible-based videos and publications
draw us close to God
and satisfy our hunger for truth.
In the new world,
abundant, healthy food will be more
than a promise
—it will be a reality.
“There will be an abundance of grain on the earth;
on the top of the mountains it will overflow.”
Do you long for a home of your own?
Jehovah promised the returning exiles
that they would build and enjoy comfortable dwellings.
Jehovah likewise cares for us,
whether we lose our home
or we’re taken from it.
Above all,
true worship provides spiritual security
that is found nowhere else.
The spiritual home we have now
reminds us that Jehovah will give us
a physical place to call home
in the new world.
“They will build houses and live in them.”
How would you feel during a long journey
where you might meet wild animals and criminals along the road?
Jehovah assured the returning exiles that they would return
in safety and dwell in peace.
In the spiritual paradise we enjoy right now,
people who were once violent
have learned to be humble,
loving, and peaceable.
Imagine the peace that will reign in God’s new world,
where we can wander this beautiful globe,
explore every corner,
and admire the handiwork of the true God
with no fear.
“‘They will do no harm nor cause any ruin
in all my holy mountain,’ says Jehovah.”
Clear instruction from Jehovah
draws us close to him
and maintains spiritual health.
While false teachings hold many
in the grip of spiritual darkness,
Jehovah offers true freedom.
The spiritual health we enjoy now
reminds us that perfect physical and mental health
await us in Paradise.
Imagine waking every day
feeling clean,
healthy,
happy,
and full of the joy of life.
Jehovah promises:
“No resident will say: ‘I am sick.’”
Jehovah fulfilled his word to the exiles.
He restored that ruined nation
as if bringing it back to life.
Jehovah did something similar.
He released his modern-day people from spiritual captivity
and energized them to preach.
Just as Jehovah raised his people from figurative death,
so will he reverse the effects of literal death.
Indeed, God “will swallow up death forever.”
Imagine living longer than any tree
because “death will be no more.”

title: 여호와—“평화를 주시는 하느님”

ko.text: 뉴욕주 블루레이크에 있는 이곳 세계 본부에서는
평화로운 자연의 정취를 느낄 수 있습니다.
독수리와 매가 날아다니는 모습을 볼 수 있습니다.
그리고 가을에 단풍이 든 숲의 모습은
하지만 이러한 평화로운 주변 환경보다 더 중요한 것은
여호와께서 그분의 조직에 베푸시는 풍부한 평화입니다.
우리는 국적, 언어, 인종, 부족, 사회적 배경에 상관없이
오늘날 전 세계에서 일어나는 많은 문제들과
사람들이 정치적, 사회적, 종교적으로 분열되어 있는 상황을 고려할 때,
결코 저절로 이루어지는 것이라고 생각하지 않습니다.
우리 각자는 하느님의 승인을 얻기 위해
매우 힘이 되는 말로 백성들을 축복하게 하셨습니다.
무엇이라고 말해야 했는지 읽어 보도록 하겠습니다.
“여호와께서 그대를 축복하고 그대를 지켜 주시기 바랍니다.
여호와께서 자신의 얼굴을 그대에게 비추고 그대에게 은혜를 베푸시기 바랍니다.
여호와께서 그대를 향해 자신의 얼굴을 들고 그대에게 평화를 주시기 바랍니다.”
“그들은 이스라엘 백성 위에 내 이름을 두어야 한다.
여호와께서는 우리 위에도 그분의 이름을 두셨으며
우리는 어떻게 하느님의 평화를 계속 누릴 수 있는지 살펴볼 것입니다.
첫째, 어떻게 하느님과 평화를 누릴 수 있는지 살펴볼 것입니다.
우리가 누리는 가장 큰 평화는 여호와와의 관계에서 오죠.
여호와를 우리의 가장 가까운 벗으로 삼으면
생활 전반에 걸쳐 평화를 누리게 됩니다.
그러면 어떻게 하느님과 가까운 관계를 누릴 수 있습니까?
그분에 대한 기본적인 지식만으로는 충분하지 않습니다.
그분이 일하시는 방식을 잘 알아야 합니다.
여호와에 관해 알려 주는 점들에 면밀한 주의를 기울인다면
두 번째로는 어떻게 다른 사람들과 평화를 누릴 수 있는지 살펴볼 것입니다.
가정은 우리의 평화로운 보금자리가 되어야 합니다.
자신보다 가족의 유익을 먼저 생각하는 것이 필요합니다.
세 번째로, 문제가 많은 세상에서 시련을 겪으면서도
평화를 누릴 수 있는 방법을 살펴볼 것입니다.
우리 형제 자매들을 만나 볼 것입니다.
여호와의 조직으로부터 어떤 도움을 받고 있는지,
어떻게 영적 활동을 계속해 나가고 있는지 유의해 보십시오.
생명의 위협을 받거나 심한 경제적 어려움이 닥치더라도
여호와께서는 분명 우리가 그 상황을 잘 헤쳐 나가고
마음과 정신에 평화를 누리게 해 주실 것입니다.
어떻게 평화를 영원히 누릴 수 있는지 살펴볼 것입니다.
하느님의 왕국을 통해 인류가 완전성에 이르면
더는 평화를 추구하기 위해 노력할 필요가 없을 것입니다.
달이 없어질 때까지 평화가 풍부할 것입니다.”
이번 대회는 여호와께서 미래에 베풀어 주실 축복에 대한 기대감을 키워 줄 것입니다.
추구한다는 말은 어떤 것을 뒤쫓아 구한다는 의미입니다.
평화를 누리기가 정말 힘들 수 있습니다.
따라서 우리는 삶에서 평화를 뒤쫓아 구해야 합니다.
우리가 그렇게 하는 데 도움이 될 것입니다.
여러분을 정말 사랑하는 중앙장로회 성원 모두는
모든 대회 프로그램을 온전히 즐기시기 바랍니다!

en.text: On behalf of the Governing Body,
I can say that we really appreciate
your attending this “Pursue Peace”! Convention.
Speaking of peace,
we love the serene setting
here at our world headquarters
on Blue Lake in New York State.
At times, the water is as smooth as a mirror.
We occasionally see eagles and hawks fly by.
And in the fall of the year when the leaves change color,
the forest can look spectacular.
More important than this tranquil setting, though,
is the abundant peace
that Jehovah has given to his organization.
We can say this because of the peace and harmony that unite us
no matter what our nationality,
language, race, tribe, or social background is.
This is truly spectacular,
especially when we consider all the turmoil in the world
and how divided people are
politically, socially, and religiously.
However, we cannot take our beautiful peace for granted;
it’s not maintained automatically.
Each of us personally must pursue peace
in order to have God’s approval.
Jehovah certainly wants his worshippers to enjoy lasting peace.
That was true in ancient times.
God told Moses to have the priests in Israel
bless the people with very reassuring words.
Notice these words that we find
at Numbers 6:24-26,
and hear what the priests were to say to the people:
“May Jehovah bless you and safeguard you.
“May Jehovah make his face shine upon you,
“and may he favor you.
“May Jehovah lift up his face toward you
and grant you peace.”
The next verse states:
“And they must place my name
“upon the people of Israel,
that I may bless them.”
Jehovah has placed his name on us too,
and he is richly blessing us.
Let’s consider what this convention program is going to cover
so that we’ll know how we can continue
to enjoy God’s blessing of peace.
First, we’ll consider how to be at peace with God.
Our greatest peace comes
from having a personal relationship with Jehovah.
Making him our best Friend benefits us
and leads to peace in every other aspect of our life.
How can we reach out for a close relationship with God?
We need more than a superficial knowledge of him.
We need to get to know Jehovah as a person
and admire his qualities and ways.
Then we can love what he loves
and hate what he hates.
During this program,
listen for details about Jehovah
that will draw you ever closer to him.
Second, we’ll consider how to be at peace with others.
Our homes should be havens for peace for our families.
This means more than the absence of arguing.
It involves putting the interests of our family members ahead of our own.
As we’ll learn from this program,
that includes showing love and respect to one another,
working as a team,
improving family communication,
and worshipping Jehovah together.
Third, we’ll consider
how to be at peace despite trials
and troublesome world conditions.
During this convention, we’re going to tour the world to see how,
despite opposition, illness,
economic problems, and natural disasters,
our brothers really care for one another,
how they receive help from Jehovah’s organization,
and how they continue their spiritual activity.
No matter what may threaten our lives or livelihood,
we can be confident that Jehovah can help us get through it
and retain our peace of mind and heart.
Fourth, we’ll consider
how to enjoy peace eternally.
Once God’s Kingdom has lifted mankind to perfection,
we’ll no longer have to pursue peace.
As Psalm 72:7 promises:
“The righteous will flourish,
and peace will abound until the moon is no more.”
In other words, there will be peace forever.
This program will help us
to anticipate future blessings from Jehovah.
Can you see why “Pursue Peace!”
was well chosen as the theme for this year’s convention?
To pursue something means
to chase it in order to capture it.
Because of the influence of Satan,
his wicked world, and our own imperfections,
peace is constantly trying to elude us.
Therefore, we have to chase after it to capture it in our lives.
This convention program will help us do that.
May the God of peace be with all of you now and forever!
That’s the heartfelt wish of all of us on the Governing Body
because we love you dearly.
Please enjoy the entire convention program!

不管面对什么危险的情况
我们都可以确信
耶和华能帮助我们
渡过难关
并让我们
得到内心安宁
第四
我们会讨论
当上帝的王国使人类恢复完美
我们就不再需要
追求和平与安宁
诗篇72:7保证说

也就是说
我们会永享和平安宁

会帮助我们

美好前景
你看出

这个主题非常合适了吗？
追求的意思包括
我们为了得到某个东西
而付出努力

ko.text: 저도 걔네 폰 뺏어서 집어 던지고 싶었어요.
중립? 웃기고 있네. 그냥 비겁한 거지.
제 마음은 슬픔으로 가득했어요. 마음의 평화가 없었죠.
아주 조금이라도 질투심이 섞여 있진 않아?
2018년 6월에 무장한 요원 여럿이 우리 집에 들이닥쳤습니다.
어릴 때 저는 그런 사람들처럼 되고 싶었어요.
야! 너 때문에 손해가 얼만지 알아?
그래서 걸린 사람 하나라도 있는 줄 알아?
항상 그랬죠. 제가 힘이 다 빠졌다고 느낄 때면
여호와께서는 무언가를 하셔서 저에게 새 힘을 주십니다.
얼마 안 있어 세상이 큰 혼란에 빠졌으니까요.

en.text: Hey, everyone.
Guess who just walked in?
Olivia.
Today’s poll: Would she ever?
No, she would never; she’s an angel.
I wanted to go up to the girls and smash their phones.
Neutral? Ain’t no neutral.
You’re just a coward.
Take your trash.
What I was feeling back then
was just sadness,
never really peace.
Hello, everyone.
Haley from DeNure Design here.
Is there just a little bit of envy in there?
In June of 2018,
a huge group of armed men came to us.
They represented the ideals of my childhood.
Do you have any idea what this is going to cost us?
I didn’t have a choice. You went behind my back!
Where’s your mask?
Do you know how many people have actually gotten sick?
Zero.
That’s what always happens.
When you’re just about to lose all your strength,
Jehovah does that something for you.
I’m so grateful that we made peace
before the world turned upside down.

cn.text: 大家早，看看谁来了？
奥莉娅
今天的投票：她有没有做过？
肯定没有，人家是修女
很想把她们的手机抢过来摔烂
中立？你们这些人就是废物
谁要你的东西！
那段时间，我非常难过，内心没有安宁
哈啰，大家好，我是你的美丽顾问海莉
其中有没有掺杂一点妒忌呢？
一大群武装人员冲进我们家，逮捕了我
小时候，我很钦佩执法人员
你知道这么做要花掉多少钱吗？
那怎么办，谁叫你不跟我商量！
你的口罩呢？
现在有人被感染了吗？没有
耶和华总是这样

他会为你做一些事
让你再次充满力量

cn.text: 使徒保罗在传道旅程中
不止一次“来到哥林多”
第一次到访时
“保罗在那里住了一年零六个月
教人学习上帝的话语”
在保罗的时代
哥林多是个相对年轻的城市
以前的希腊古城哥林多
在公元前146年被罗马人摧毁了
大约100年后
尤利乌斯·凯撒重建哥林多
使其成为罗马帝国的殖民地
不久后
哥林多被划入亚该亚行省
公元50年
保罗来到哥林多时
这座城已经是个繁荣的商贸中心
哥林多之所以能蓬勃发展
主要是因为它的战略位置
这座城建于哥林多地峡的西端
而地峡连接着伯罗奔尼撒半岛和希腊大陆
由于这一地理位置
哥林多掌控着地峡两侧的两个港口
也就是莱凯阿姆和坚革里
哥林多因此成为商人汇集的地方
哥林多人有机会接触到
来自罗马帝国各地的旅客
以及各种思想
保罗应该很熟悉城里的市集广场
市集广场周边有柱廊和一些公共建筑
市集里成排的店铺售卖各种物品
既有日常用品
也有奢侈品
靠制造帐篷谋生的保罗、亚居拉和百姬拉
可能就是在这里
或城中其他地方的店铺工作
哥林多人常常在市集广场
跟过路的旅客和商人闲聊
这里因此成为基督徒传道的理想地点
市集广场还有个高台
称为审判座
罗马官员会在审判座上
对公众讲话以及宣布判决
犹太人也许就是把保罗
押到了这个审判座前
让他在行省总督迦流面前受审
宗教是哥林多人生活中的一个重要部分
在通往哥林多卫城这座陡峭石山的路上
有大大小小的庙宇
城里市集广场的周围
也有不少神庙
这些宗教建筑是献给不同神明的
包括福尔图娜
阿波罗
阿佛洛狄忒
今天 ，在离市集广场不远的地方
可以看到一块铺路用的石板
上面的铭文提及一个叫
“以拉都”的政府官员
保罗在哥林多写的一封信
提到了来自“财务官以拉都”的问候
他说的以拉都
可能就是铭文提到的人
来哥林多的人都会留意到城里的大剧场
那里可以容纳1万5000多人
保罗在写给哥林多基督徒会众的信里说
他和其他使徒“在世人面前
就像剧场里的表演”
当时他想到的
可能就是在这样的剧场里
演员的一举一动
多么清楚地呈现在观众眼前
保罗完成了在哥林多的使命
在那里建立了一群会众
附近的坚革里会众
可能也是他建立的

title: JW 방송—2022년 9월

ko.text: 이번 달 방송에 여러분과 함께하게 되어 정말 기쁩니다.
이번 달 프로그램에서 어떤 내용을 살펴볼지 간단히 소개해 드리죠.
세 명의 형제가 어떻게 여호와를 온전히 신뢰함으로
사소한 것으로 시작될 수 있지만, 괴롭힘을 당하게 되면
자신이 혼자이고 무가치한 느낌이 들면서 ‘왜 나지?’ 하는 생각이 들 수 있습니다.
이번 달 「나의 십 대 이야기」에서는 어떻게 찰리와 페린이
괴롭힘을 이겨 내서 더 강해지고 자신감을 회복했는지 볼 것입니다.
새로운 동영상에서 우리는 니타와 제이드를 다시 만나게 될 것인데요.
그들이 진리에 대한 잘못된 정보를 들었을 때 어떻게 충실을 유지했는지 알게 될 것입니다.
여러분 모두 큰 기대감을 가지고 시청해 보십시오.
추산에 의하면 오늘날 지구 상에는 1500만 종의 동물이 있다고 합니다.
성경에서 선한 사람을 가리키는 데 가장 많이 사용된 동물은 뭘까요?
첫 번째로 12사도에게 마태 10:16의 이 말씀을 하셨죠.
‘내가 여러분을 마치 양을 이리들 가운데로 보내는 것과 같습니다.’
두 번째로 그분은 아마겟돈 직전에 자신이 하실 일에 관해 마태 25:32, 33에서
이어지는 구절들에서 그분은 어떻게 양이 영원한 생명을 상속받고
어떻게 염소가 영원한 멸망으로 들어가는지 묘사하십니다.
세 번째 예는 예수께서 요한 10:16에서 하신 말씀이죠.
“나에게는 이 우리에 속해 있지 않은 다른 양들도 있습니다.
그래서 한 목자 아래 한 무리가 될 것입니다.”
분명, 양이 가진 바람직한 특성들 때문일 것입니다.
우선 양들은 함께 있는 걸 좋아합니다.
좋은 특성인데 양이 무리에서 떨어져 목자의 보호를 받지 못하면
사자나 곰이 공격할 때 방어할 수 없기 때문입니다.
그럴 때 양이 할 수 있는 거라곤 “매애애” 하고 우는 것뿐이죠.
양이 가진 또 다른 좋은 특성은 대체로 평화롭고 공격적이 아니라는 것입니다.
어렸을 때 남동생과 저는 외할아버지가 기르는 염소들을 쓰다듬곤 했는데,
우리가 등을 돌리기만 하면 살금살금 뒤로 다가와 우릴 들이받곤 했습니다.
이런 염소와는 달리 양이 가진 좋은 특성들 때문에
하지만 우리가 초점을 맞추기를 원하는 양의 또 한 가지 좋은 특성이 있는데
자기 양들을 다 데리고 나온 다음 앞장서 갑니다.
그러면 양들은 그를 따라갑니다. 그의 목소리를 알기 때문입니다.
양들은 낯선 사람을 결코 따라가지 않고, 오히려 그에게서 도망칠 것입니다.
낯선 사람들의 목소리는 알지 못하기 때문입니다.”
어떤 좋은 특성을 알 수 있습니까?
양은 목자의 목소리는 듣지만 낯선 사람들의 목소리는 듣지 않습니다.
양의 특성에 관해 파수대 2004년 9월 1일호는 이렇게 알려 줍니다.
양들은 목자의 옷으로 목자를 분간하는 것이지 음성으로 분간하는 것이 아니라고 주장했는데,
이에 대해 한 목자는 양들이 아는 것은 목자의 음성이라고 대답했습니다.
이 점을 증명하기 위해 그 목자는 그 낯선 방문객과 옷을 바꾸어 입었습니다.
그러고 나서 목자의 옷을 입은 이 낯선 사람이 양들을 불렀는데
양들은 목자가 다른 사람처럼 옷을 입고 있는데도 즉시 그에게로 왔습니다.’
‘나는 여호와의 비유적인 양으로서 낯선 사람들의 목소리가 아니라
훌륭한 목자의 목소리를 잘 듣고 순종하는가?’
복화술사처럼 사탄은 뱀이 말하는 것처럼 보이게 했지만
뱀이 아니라 인간을 꼭두각시로 사용해 자신의 목소리를 내고 있습니다.
그런 사람들은 알든 모르든 사탄의 꼭두각시 노릇을 하고 있는 것입니다.
그러면 이제 세 가지 예를 통해
훌륭한 목자가 하는 말과 사탄의 하수인인 낯선 자들이 하는 말이
우리는 올바른 목소리를 듣기 위해 깨어 있어야 합니다.
그들에게 제때에 양식을 나누어 주게 한
주인이 와서 그 종이 그렇게 하고 있는 것을 보게 되면,
주인이 자기의 모든 소유를 돌보도록 그를 임명할 것입니다.”
우리가 알다시피 주인이신 예수께서는 1919년에 “충실하고 슬기로운 종”이
마음이 올바른 자들을 영적으로 먹이고 있는 것을 보셨고,
그분은 앞으로 “자기의 모든 소유를 돌보도록 그를 임명할 것”입니다.
분명 예수께서는 지금도 충실한 종을 온전히 신뢰하십니다.
우리 모두는, 심지어 중앙장로회 각 성원들도 그래야 합니다.
하지만 낯선 자들의 목소리는 무엇이라고 말합니까?
흔히 누가 그런 거짓말을 퍼뜨리는 데 큰 목소리를 냅니까?
그런 이상한 혹은 낯선 가르침 중에는 충실한 종이 소아 성애자들을 용인한다거나
여러분의 헌금을 사용해 호화로운 생활을 한다는 주장이 있습니다.
사도 20:30에서는 배교자들이 “왜곡된 것을 말”한다고 알려 줍니다.
그들은 하느님의 양을 끌어내서 자신들을 따르게 하려고 그렇게 합니다.
왜곡된 것이란 모양이 일그러지고 뒤틀린 것입니다.
그들은 중요한 점을 빼놓거나, 전체의 일부분만을 말하거나,
오해를 불러일으키는 반만 사실인 말로 조작함으로 왜곡된 것을 말합니다.
“그들은 탐욕에 빠져, 지어낸 말로 여러분을 이용할 것입니다.”
진짜처럼 보이지만 가치가 없는 모조품에 불과합니다.
속아서 위조지폐를 받게 되면 돈을 잃게 됩니다.
하지만 속아서 배교자들의 지어낸 말을 받아들이게 되면
배교자들은 가치 있는 그 어떤 것도 우리에게 줄 수 없습니다.
여러분에게 사랑에 찬 양 치는 방문이 정말 필요한데,
보도 매체에 나오는 모든 내용을 믿지 않도록 조심해야 합니다.
보도 매체는 흔히 편견, 증오, 이익에 영향을 받는다는 걸 기억하십시오.
잘못되고 과장된 뉴스 보도가 너무나도 많습니다.
예를 들어 한 유럽 국가에서는 많은 사람들이
한 증인 소녀가 수혈을 받지 않아서 사망했다는
그 대안으로 무수혈 대체 치료를 받아들이는 데 동의했습니다.
병원에서 즉시 그 치료를 해 주었다면, 생명을 구할 수 있었을 것입니다.
이 세상의 모든 뉴스 보도를 불신하는 것은 비합리적인 태도이지만,
“온 세상은 악한 자의 지배 아래 있다”고 알려 주기 때문입니다.
이제 훌륭한 목자인 예수의 목소리의 두 번째 예를 살펴보죠.
누구든지 여자를 계속 바라보고 정욕을 품는 사람은
마음으로 이미 그 여자와 간음한 것입니다.”
우리의 훌륭한 목자께서는 성적 부도덕을 피할 뿐만 아니라 부도덕한 생각과 같이
부도덕을 범하게 만들 수 있는 모든 것을 멀리하라고 말씀하신 것입니다.
“당신들에게 말하는데, 누구든지 성적 부도덕이 아닌 다른 근거로
아내와 이혼하고 다른 여자와 결혼하는 사람은 간음하는 것입니다.”
여기서 예수께서는 이혼하고 재혼할 수 있는
하느님 보시기에 유일하게 합당한 근거를 알려 주셨는데,
불충실한 배우자가 성적 부도덕을 범한 경우입니다.
하지만 사탄의 세상의 낯선 자들의 목소리는
이혼과 간음과 다른 성적 부도덕에 대해 무엇이라고 말합니까?
너에게는 원하는 건 뭐든 할 수 있는 자유가 있어.”
세상에서는 성적 부도덕을 무해하게 보이도록 흔히 완곡한 표현을 사용하죠.
동성애와 같은 성도착 행위를 하나의 생활 방식이라고 말합니다.

en.text: We extend a warm welcome to all of you.
We’re so happy to have you join us
for this month’s broadcast.
Here’s a little sample of what will be contained
in our program.
Proverbs 3:5 tells us
to “trust in Jehovah with all [our] heart.”
We’ll see how three brothers
facing different challenges overcame them
by trusting in Jehovah completely.
Though personal attacks may start small,
being bullied can quickly make you feel alone and worthless,
wondering, ‘Why me?’
In this month’s My Teen Life,
we’ll hear how Charlie and Ferin learned to cope with bullies
and grew stronger and more confident as a result.
And in a new dramatization,
we’ll reconnect with two dear friends, Neeta and Jade,
and see how they remain loyal
when confronted with false reports about the truth.
Yes, there’s much to look forward to
in this September 2022 edition
of JW Broadcasting®.
The theme for this program is
“As Jehovah’s Sheep,
Reject ‘the Voice of Strangers’!”
It’s estimated that there may be
15 million animal species on earth today.
But of all these animals,
which one is most often used in the Bible to represent good people?
Sheep!
Jesus often used this illustration.
Here are three examples.
First, to his 12 apostles, he said
at Matthew 10:16:
“I am sending you out as sheep
among wolves.”
Second, regarding what he’ll do shortly before Armageddon,
he said at Matthew 25:32, 33
that “he will separate people one from another,
“just as a shepherd separates the sheep
from the goats.”
In subsequent verses, he describes how the sheep
will inherit everlasting life
but the goats will depart into everlasting destruction.
Our third example: Jesus said
at John 10:16:
“I have other sheep, which are not of this fold;
“those too I must bring in,
“and they will listen to my voice,
and they will become one flock, one shepherd.”
But a question arises:
Why did Jesus use a sheep illustration
to represent people who will gain everlasting life?
Undoubtedly, it was because of the desirable qualities
literal sheep have.
They’re gregarious, having a liking for companionship.
They don’t like to be alone.
And it’s a good thing because without the flock
and the protection of the shepherd,
they’re defenseless if a lion or a bear approaches.
About all they can do is bleat, “Baa.”
Goodbye, little sheep.
Another good quality is that sheep as a whole
tend to be peaceful, inoffensive
—very different from goats.
As little boys, my brother and I would pet the goats that my grandfather had,
but if we turned our backs on them,
one would often sneak up behind us
and butt us for no reason.
These are some of the desirable characteristics
that make sheep an appropriate illustration for good people.
But the quality we especially want to focus on
is identified at John chapter 10,
verses 4 and 5.
“When he [that is, the shepherd]
“has brought all his own out,
“he goes ahead of them,
“and the sheep follow him, because they know his voice.
“They will by no means follow a stranger
“but will flee from him,
because they do not know the voice of strangers.”
So, what’s the desirable quality?
Sheep listen to the voice of their shepherd
and reject the voice of strangers.
Regarding this quality of sheep,
the September 1, 2004, Watchtower  said this:
“A book on Bible lands relates that a visitor once claimed
“that sheep recognize their shepherd by his dress, not his voice.
“A shepherd answered that it was the voice they knew.
“To prove this, he exchanged clothing with the stranger.
“Dressed in the shepherd’s garb, the stranger called the sheep,
“but they did not respond.
“They did not know his voice.
“Yet, when the shepherd called them,
though he was disguised, the sheep came at once.”
Please ask yourself,
‘As one of Jehovah’s figurative sheep,
‘do I obediently respond to the voice of the Fine Shepherd
and flee from the voice of strangers?’
Well, let’s talk about this.
The original stranger was Satan the Devil.
Like a ventriloquist, he made a serpent appear to talk,
but the words were Satan’s words.
Satan thereby used his voice to slander Jehovah
and deceive Eve.
Today, Satan continues his work as an evil ventriloquist
using, not serpents, but human puppets
to enunciate his voice
—these acting as his agents
either wittingly or unwittingly.
But now let’s discuss three examples
of how our Fine Shepherd tells us one thing
but Satan’s underlings, or strangers,
tell us something opposite.
We must be vigilant to listen
to the right voice.
Our Fine Shepherd tells us, as our first example,
these words at Matthew chapter 24,
verses 45-47:
“Who really is the faithful and discreet slave
“whom his master appointed over his domestics,
“to give them their food at the proper time?
“Happy is that slave if his master on coming
“finds him doing so!
“Truly I say to you, he will appoint him
over all his belongings.”
We know the Master, Jesus,
found “the faithful and discreet slave”
spiritually feeding righthearted ones in 1919,
and at a future time
“will appoint him over all his belongings.”
So, what’s the implication?
Obviously, even now,
Jesus fully trusts the faithful slave.
And all of us,
even individual members of the Governing Body,
should do the same.
But what does the voice of strangers say on this subject?
“Don’t trust the faithful slave.
He will mislead you!”
And who often have the loudest voice
promoting this false message?
Apostates.
Hebrews 13:9 labels false messages
as “strange teachings.”
Yes, they are the teachings of strangers.
Some examples of their strange teachings
are that the faithful slave protects pedophiles
or that the slave will exploit you
so that they can live lives of luxury.
Those are both bald-faced lies.
Acts 20:30 says that apostates
“speak twisted things.”
They do this in order to draw God’s sheep away
and make them followers of themselves.
Something that’s twisted is bent out of shape,
or distorted.
They speak twisted things by leaving out vital details,
taking things out of context,
or in some other way manipulating a truth
into a lie or into a misleading half-truth.
Second Peter 2:3 says:
“They will greedily exploit you
with counterfeit words.”
A counterfeit is something
that’s carefully designed to look like the real thing.
Take, for example, counterfeit money:
It might look genuine,
but it’s fake and thus worthless.
If we’re deceived into accepting it, we’ll lose money.
But if we’re deceived into accepting the counterfeit words of apostates,
we’ll lose our life.
And apostates will give us absolutely nothing of value in exchange.
Can you imagine really needing
a loving shepherding visit
and asking apostates to give you one?
Similarly, we must be careful
about believing everything presented in the media
about Jehovah’s organization.
Remember, the media is commonly motivated by prejudice, hatred,
and a desire for profit.
False and exaggerated news reports
are very common.
For example, in one European country,
many people were indignant when an emotional press report stated
that a young female Witness died
because she refused a blood transfusion.
Were those the complete facts?
No.
The patient refused a blood transfusion on religious grounds,
but she did agree
to alternative nonblood medical management.
This could have been implemented immediately
and likely would have saved her life.
However,
the hospital delayed matters unnecessarily
until it was too late.
The press report didn’t mention these facts.
While it’s unreasonable to distrust
all secular sources of information,
we must be wary.
First John 5:19 says:
“The whole world is lying
in the power of the wicked one.”
Now let’s discuss a second example
of the voice of our Fine Shepherd, Jesus.
At Matthew chapter 5,
verses 27 and 28, Jesus said:
“You heard that it was said:
“‘You must not commit adultery.’
“But I say to you that everyone who keeps on looking at a woman
“so as to have a passion for her
has already committed adultery with her in his heart.”
Our Fine Shepherd is telling us
not only to avoid sexual immorality
but also to flee from anything
that could lead to it,
such as immoral thoughts.
And at Matthew 19:9, our Fine Shepherd tells us:
“I say to you that whoever divorces his wife,
“except on the grounds of sexual immorality, and marries another
commits adultery.”
Here Jesus makes clear
that the only valid basis for divorce and remarriage
in God’s eyes
is if a disloyal mate commits sexual immorality.
But what’s the voice of strangers of Satan’s world telling us
regarding divorce, adultery,
and other forms of sexual immorality?
“No problem. It’s your choice.
You have the freedom to do what you want.”
In fact, in order to make sexual immorality appear more innocent,
it’s often euphemized.
Sexual perversion, such as homosexuality,
is called an alternative lifestyle.
One so-called expert said
that it’s simply like being left-handed!
Pornography is called adult entertainment.
Adulterous betrayal of one’s marriage mate
is called having an affair.
Many call getting married old-fashioned
and see nothing wrong with living together
without marriage.
And this world’s media is very skillful
at presenting something bad as good.
For example, in a movie, a female character might be portrayed
as having a husband who is abusive.
You like the woman, and you want her to find happiness.
Then a handsome man starts working in her office,
and he’s so nice to her.
There’s an attraction between them,
and the budding romance is presented
as something good.
Soft background music makes it hard
to consider her course to be bad.
It’s easy to keep watching
and hope she leaves her marriage mate
and runs off with her workmate.
And usually that’s what happens.
So easily we can forget
that Jehovah and Jesus hate adultery
and unscriptural divorce.
But when we reject the voice of this world
and listen to the voice of Jehovah and Jesus,
we bring protection and blessings
to ourselves and others.
But now our third example of the voice of our Fine Shepherd
is at Matthew chapter 6,
and we’re going to read verses 19 and 20:
“Stop storing up for yourselves treasures on the earth,
“where moth and rust consume
“and where thieves break in and steal.
“Rather, store up for yourselves
“treasures in heaven,
“where neither moth nor rust consumes,
and where thieves do not break in and steal.”
We’re told that our focus
should be on spiritual things
and not on physical things.
And this is especially true
when thinking about where we are
in the stream of time
—in the final part of the final part
of the last days.
But what’s the voice of strangers
of this world on this subject?
“Exert yourself vigorously to acquire
“material possessions.
“Pursue things
“that will make your life comfortable
because that is what will bring you happiness.”
The question is, To whom are we listening?
Jehovah and Jesus tell us to be content now
with a spiritual paradise,
to concentrate on our lifesaving preaching work,
and that they will provide a physical paradise later.
First Peter 2:11 indicates
that we should view ourselves
as “temporary residents”
who are just passing through this old system
and headed for “the real life” in the new world.
What do we mean by “temporary resident”?
Well, imagine that you rent an old house to live in
while a new beautiful house is being built for you.
You’ll live there only a few months.
Would you install a new concrete driveway?
Would you put in new electrical wiring and plumbing?
Would you install brand new vinyl siding?
No.
You might do a few cosmetic things to make your stay a little more comfortable,
but you wouldn’t do anything major.
Why?
Because you know you’re just a temporary resident and that soon
you’ll move into your beautiful new home.
Well, if we think of ourselves
just as temporary residents in this old system,
it’ll be a real protection against the materialism
that is promoted by the voice of strangers.
We’ve now discussed three examples
of Jesus’ voice:
(1) Trust “the faithful and discreet slave.”
(2) Reject sexual immorality
and unscriptural divorce.
(3) Focus on storing up spiritual treasures
rather than material treasures.
Of course, there are many other examples of these two different voices,
but may we all be vigilant
to listen to the right voice!
Of Jesus, Jehovah himself said:
“This is my Son, the beloved, whom I have approved.
Listen to him.”
But in order to do so obediently as Jehovah’s sheep,
we must reject the voice of strangers.
But how would you handle things
if “the voice of strangers” was brought to you by someone close
—a friend or perhaps even a family member?
That’s what Jade faces
in the following dramatization.
How will she learn to reject the voice of strangers
in a sensitive situation?

John 10:5:

How wise it was for Jade to distinguish
between the dangerous falsehoods about Jehovah’s people
and the person unwittingly promoting them!
Jade took a clear stand,
but she also patiently showed
that she loved her mother.
This not only protected Jade from dangerous thinking
but also helped her mother.
Unfortunately, as our children grow and attend school,
many face a modern scourge:
bullying.
How can they overcome the fear and negative feelings
that being bullied causes?
We’ll listen to two of our teenagers share what worked for them
in this edition of My Teen Life.
My experience with bullying
ultimately started
in physical education
when this kid who shared a locker a few spaces away from me
took that opportunity and started to verbally attack me.
I first experienced bullying
in elementary school,
but it was little stuff, nothing too big.
In middle school is when it was really, really something.
It was upsetting that I
was being bullied; it made me feel
like I was doing something wrong.
Why did I have to be the target?
It got really personal.
He would call me names.
He would say that, you know,
I wasn’t good at anything, that no one cared about me, that I was
dumb, that I was weak.
Especially after he found out that I was a Witness,
the texts just got even more intense.
It was one day specifically that was really bad.
It started in a classroom.
I heard one girl
talk to another girl about me,
right in front of me, and these were lies.
We went to lunch, and I was cornered again.
‘Is this how middle school is going to be?
‘I don’t have anybody to be with,
to hang out with during school, because everybody doesn’t like me.’
I felt no one liked me.
It was the worst day ever.
I no longer felt that I was valuable at that point.
I was starting to feel more that I was
this weak person, that I was
defenseless, that no one cared about me,
and that I was worthless to anybody.
So hearing that over and over really took a toll
on my mental health and my emotional health.
I think at my lowest point, after receiving so many
of these vicious attacks, I started to have really,
really dark feelings.
And I realized that I shouldn’t let this go any further than it already had.
That was the moment when I knew I had to get help.
I told my parents about it, of course.
And especially on the worst day, I told them everything.
My parents always brought up scriptures
—Proverbs 27:12.
Anytime I saw the bullies,
I would avoid them as much as possible.
Another thing that I was always doing
was praying constantly —always praying—
before school, during school, after school.
There were times that I would go into the library
and just read books, just stay to myself.
During those times, I would also pray
to Jehovah, and he was a Friend to me.
He was Somebody that I could speak to
on this matter.
I did end up talking to my parents about it.
They let me get my side of the story out.
They were listening, and they wanted to help out.
And they made me feel loved.
I definitely took this time to reach out to the elders.
And they really encouraged me and assured me
that I was not only somewhere where I was needed
but that I was also somewhere where I was wanted.
I took some practical steps.
I moved my locker; I made sure not to retaliate.
Walking away is something very powerful.
Retaliation is something that’s weak
because you’re giving in to your emotions, and you’re just lashing out.
Eventually, the bully got suspended,
which gave me some peace.
He ended up coming back after a week,
and he started up again with the attack.
I noticed that he hadn’t changed at all, but I had.
I was much more confident.
With that change, I began to fear him less.
I wasn’t scared of him.
I just saw him as this person who wanted attention from me.
All the principles that you read
about whether in “Young People Ask” or scriptures that you pick out
—everything really, really helps.
And you can either see the situation
die down or that it’s not that bad.
You can deal with it, or it just stops.
And it was so encouraging for me, and it helped strengthen
my faith in seeing how Jehovah really is there to help.
Don’t keep this to yourself.
Don’t bottle it up, because that’ll make things worse.
This is a problem that won’t go away because you ignore it.
You need to talk to someone.
Talk to your parents, talk to your friend,
talk to Jehovah, talk to someone in the congregation.
Because if you don’t know what to do, they’ll help you find out
what to do and they’ll give you guidance.
And you’ll be so impressed by how much Jehovah takes care of you,
and he’ll show you that you are loved by him.
You are loved by Jehovah.
So if you’re suffering at the hands of a bully,
don’t bottle it up.
You are not alone.
Talk to your parents.
It won’t go away if you ignore it.
But Jehovah can help you face up to bullies,
and you can trust Bible principles
because they always work.
And they work across a wide range of challenges.
In our next video, see how three brothers
learned to trust completely in Jehovah and his righteous principles
when confronted with persecution,
immoral influences,
and the snare of pride.
Proverbs 3:5, 6
made a tremendous impression on me:
“Trust in Jehovah with all your heart.”
When I was younger, I probably said:
“All right. Let me try it and see if it works.”
As much as I loved
what I was learning from Jehovah,
I was still leaning a lot
on my own understanding.
Obviously, when we make
decisions in our lives—
A spiritual person
will review and think,
‘Let’s do this Jehovah’s way.’
And that was something that I had lost sight of
at that moment in my life.
There was considerable opposition to the work.
We expected that when we did street work,
we might be picked up and taken to jail.
But Jehovah’s organization had explained to us
how we were to handle it.
I do remember when the police finally picked me up,
and they drove me down to Chicago.
It was about an hour’s drive,
and they asked me, “So, what did you do wrong?”
So I had one hour to witness to them.
And as I recall, I kept track of it, and I counted the time too.
Things didn’t disturb us
because we were being trained by Jehovah’s organization.
We knew what to do.
So I ended up in a jail in Chicago for a weekend,
and there was nothing I could do about it,
so I put up with it.
So I was home for a day or two.
And then I went back to my assignment, and I kept on working.
I left the rest in Jehovah’s hands,
and he handled it very nicely,
whether we were in jail or whether we were not.
Eventually, I stumbled upon the punk rock anarchist scene.
And this really called out to me because here I could be myself;
I could establish my own standards.
But that scene eventually led me down
to a very dark path of immorality,
drug abuse, drunkenness, and a lot of violence.
I felt lonely.
I felt betrayed.
I felt that nothing made sense.
I remember thinking back
to when I was learning about Jehovah and how simple things were.
I decided to give Jehovah another shot.
Reading Matthew 16:24 hit me really hard,
where it says to ‘disown yourself,’
because I knew that scripture, but I still hadn’t really focused
on what it meant for me.
I knew I had to let go of certain parts of my personality
and of my old lifestyle.
I’d never really given Jehovah a completely fair chance.
So I started applying more fully the principles I found,
and I started trusting Jehovah more.
Very quickly things started falling into place:
the determination that I had to serve him,
the changes that I needed to make —changes that I never thought I could make.
I felt that spiritual progress was
appointments and assignments.
I think pride got the best of me there.
Very shortly after we got to the congregation in Brooklyn,
I’m out in service with the coordinator,
and he says to me:
“The letter came back, and you weren’t recommended as a servant.
Do you know what happened?”
So I said, “Well, you know,
I think those brothers have some problems over there.”
And he said: “Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!
“Stop for a second here.
“You don’t need to tell me anything negative about the brothers in that hall.
“Focus on what you need to do,
and Jehovah will take care of the rest of it.”
It really did feel like Jehovah was just saying: ‘OK, stop.
Right now you need to focus on you.’
And that really just allowed me to relax
and focus on what was really a lot more important
than whether I had a certain position in Jehovah’s organization.
The humility and the patience
and the love and the adjustments that I needed to make
—being a more obedient servant of Jehovah—
those were the things that were so important
that I had forgotten about for a while.
All the time that I spent pursuing my own interests
always led to disappointment.
And now that I’ve learned about Jehovah
and living by his principles,
I have been having the time of my life.
To know that Jehovah just simply wants
to make me the best version of me
and teach me to enhance my personality
and to become better,
that really endeared me to Jehovah.
Jehovah really cared about me enough
to mold my thinking.
It was kind of like my life was back in focus,
and I was able to just relax and serve Jehovah happily.
And then, of course, the blessings started really pouring in after that.
Everything I’ve done connected with the truth,
I have enjoyed every speck of it.
You might have some great idea, but
I found out: You do things Jehovah’s way
and the end result is nothing but good.
Isn’t it wonderful that Jehovah cares so much
that he takes the time to mold our thinking
and help us be the best possible version of ourselves?
And what a life lesson from Brother Adams:
“Do things Jehovah’s way
and the end result [will be] nothing but good”!
With success like that,
why would we try any other way?

You know I’ve had an illness,
but I’m getting along all right.
There’s a little tumor here in the brain,
which the doctors are treating.
And whatever comes, one way or the other,
well, it has been wonderful to work with you all these years,
and I enjoyed it tremendously.
And I’m very grateful to Jehovah
I could come to this meeting
and be with you.
Like C. T. Russell before him,
Brother Knorr had an exceptional gift
for organizing the Kingdom work.
That set the stage for the amazing growth
that the organization experienced during the closing decades
of the 20th century.
Nathan Knorr died on June 8, 1977.
Note what Brother Albert Schroeder,
a fellow member of the Governing Body,
wrote about him:
“As the Society’s principal administrator,
“there have come to be over 90 branches.
“Brother Knorr has proved to be
“the right theocratic entrepreneur
for this period of Jehovah’s Kingdom work.”
Brother Knorr helped to clarify the role
of the Governing Body and its committees.
Headquarters representatives
were sent out to various branches,
branches were better organized,
bodies of elders were appointed
in various congregations,
training programs were instituted,
and schools were established.
Because of the organizational growth,
the number of conventions
being held worldwide
now numbered into the hundreds,
and the Governing Body members
wanted to be present
at as many of those conventions as possible.
For example,
at the 1969 “Peace on Earth” International Convention,
a Governing Body member
would fly to the convention city
for the opening day,
catch a flight to another convention city,
and then return to the original city
so that he could speak on the closing day.
In the 1970’s and 1980’s,
many existing branches
with printing and shipping capabilities
needed to expand to ensure
that the worldwide supply of spiritual food
would flow uninterrupted
no matter what happened on the world scene.
At times,
there were more than 20 branch construction
or expansion projects
going on simultaneously.
And the Governing Body
was very interested in each one
and eager to dedicate
the new facilities once completed.
For me, it was always very encouraging
to have contact with the brothers of the Governing Body,
to see their great zeal
and their loving interests
in the brothers behind the Iron Curtain.
something outstanding happened.
it was possible
for Brothers Jaracz, Franz, and Sydlik
to visit the brothers in Poland.
So that was the first time
—the first time—
that members of the Governing Body
could visit the country
behind the Iron Curtain.
They spoke to many overseers,
pioneers, and longtime Witnesses.
That was, of course, a wonderful experience.
One year after this visit,
Brother Jaracz along with Brother Henschel
were able to get an appointment with government officials
to promote a more tolerant attitude of Jehovah’s organization
and the work that Jehovah’s Witnesses were doing
in Eastern Europe and especially in Poland.
Now, mind you, this was all taking place
some ten years prior
to the fall of Communism in Eastern Europe.
They took various steps
to meet with the local brothers in person.
And Brother Barry of the Governing Body
had the opportunity to hold a secret meeting
in the city of Leningrad with Brother Kose,
who was responsible for the activity in the territory.
Brother Kose said that he received
tremendous encouragement from that discussion,
from the conversation with Brother Barry.
And it was interesting that it wasn’t until after that meeting
that Brother Kose found out that he had been talking
to a member of the Governing Body.
The brothers in Eastern Europe
really needed help to resist
decades of satanic efforts
to destroy their faith in Jehovah
and weaken the unity and confidence in His organization.
The members of the Governing Body
showed very deep appreciation
for the brothers
who kept the communication
with the brothers behind the Iron Curtain.
Because you have to imagine
that to get the spiritual food there,
they had to be willing to take a personal risk
to visit
and to bring the spiritual food to the brothers there,
not just to the countries right close
but down there to the brothers
—down there to Siberia.
In the second half of the 1980’s,
the Iron Curtain began to open up.
There was a sense of freedom in the air.
The brothers in Eastern Europe could feel that freedom.
As governments granted permission,
the Governing Body organized
conventions in Eastern-bloc countries
—for example, in Poland and Czechoslovakia.
And when bans were lifted,
the members of the Governing Body
traveled many times to all the countries that were possible
—Poland, Hungary, Romania,
Czechoslovakia, Russia, Ukraine,
and to the Baltic States,
and also to Belarus.
In November 1989,
the Berlin Wall came down.
Well, this was a great turning point
in the history of the 20th century.
But it also meant greater freedom for our brothers.
The Governing Body really sprung into action.
They wanted to go
and accelerate the work there.
So Brother Jaracz as well as other members
of the Governing Body
closely supervised the work.
Therefore, the number of visits they made,
well, just skyrocketed.
In the fall of 1989,
Brothers Milton Henschel and Theodore Jaracz
had the unique opportunity of visiting
the brothers in the Soviet Union
for the first time.
The brothers really wanted to study the situation on the ground.
They met with all of the elders, circuit overseers,
district overseers, and members of the Country Committee.
It was like one big shepherding visit.
So in Eastern Europe, 1991 was the stage
for three international conventions
with the subject “Lovers of Godly Freedom.”
But, of course, besides these international conventions,
other open conventions
(so not in secret, no, open conventions)
were held for the first time
in the former Soviet Union
—in Estonia, in Russia, and in the Ukraine.
Just imagine!
After decades of such difficult persecution,
we experienced the opportunity to be together
with our worldwide brotherhood
and to see the brothers from the Governing Body.
It was an unforgettable time.
It was the happiest of times.
It was super!
One outstanding convention was held in Zagreb.
Yes, it was a loving and a courageous decision
of the Governing Body to go there
despite the uncertainty
of the political situation in the country
and maybe (coming up) a civil war.
This convention was the only public event
that was allowed by the government
in the city of Zagreb.
All other public events
were canceled,
but the convention of Jehovah’s Witnesses was not.
Policemen and soldiers
assigned to keep security and order in the stadium
were astonished that Serbians, Croats,
Slovenians, Montenegrins, and Bosnians
were sitting together in peace and in unity.
At those international conventions
in Eastern Europe,
members of the Governing Body gave the final motivating talk.
And those talks, given less than five months
after the thrill of obtaining legal recognition
for our work in the Soviet Union,
strengthened and encouraged our brothers
for trials they would face in the future.
It’s plain to see that the Governing Body of years past
expended themselves
to “know well the appearance of [the] flock.”
They poured themselves out
“like a drink offering”
in order to “take good care of [the] sheep.”
The same deep love
and tender concern for you,
the sheep of the Great Shepherd’s flock,
has been evident throughout modern times
right down to this day.
What striking evidence of unity
our conventions provide!
While the world around them roiled with ethnic strife,
hatred, and violence,
our brothers enjoyed a peaceful convention
that rightly impressed the authorities.
Our faith in the fine shepherd and his Father
surely is being rewarded now
and will be even more abundantly rewarded in the future.
Perhaps, like many, you’re still talking about last year’s drama,
Daniel: A Lifetime of Faith.
What moving lessons and awesome depictions
of visions and events from his life!
Would you like to take a look behind the scenes
and see what went into making it?
Let’s enjoy a tour of some of the work
that helped bring this account to life.
The Bible book of Daniel
is filled with imagery,
visions,
and amazing scenery and architecture.
All of it serves
to teach readers about the times we live in now
and how we can faithfully serve Jehovah.
The team that made
Daniel: A Lifetime of Faith
had to portray these amazing things on film.
How did they do it?
Early concept art
was made to help in the development
of the many visual effects scenes.
The architecture and aesthetics of Babylon
were quite different
from what the Israelites were used to.
The sets needed to be designed in a way
that helped convey what it was like to be captured
and brought to a foreign land.
The production design and sets
and props departments built 360-degree sets,
which made for an immersive environment.
All of the other wise men are unable to make the interpretation known to me.
But you are able to do so.
Many costumes and props
were carefully handmade for the production.
Spearheads were hand-forged.
Most of the filming was done
at Mount Ebo Studios in Brewster, New York.
Some additional scenes were filmed in nearby locations
and in Florida.
You need to rest.
Several miniature sets were built,
including a ziggurat,
and then actors were filmed in front of a green screen
and inserted into the final shots.
As filming was completed, scenes were edited together
and the visual-effects team
went to work on many specialized shots.
Digital models of people and animals
were animated and combined
with footage of real environments
to make scenes
that would have been impossible to film otherwise.
For example,
a digital model was made of the immense image
in King Nebuchadnezzar’s dream.
The team researched the characteristics
of the actual materials described in the Scriptures,
such as metals and rocks,
so that when the image falls,
it appears realistic and believable.
Just look at the results of thousands of hours
spent modeling,
animating, simulating,
rendering, and compositing!
Music and sound effects add the final touches.
“What do you see?”
Jehovah asked the prophet Amos.
What Amos saw taught him important lessons.
In the drama Daniel: A Lifetime of Faith,
what did you see?
And more important, what did you learn?
What did you see?
Hours of hard work?
Dramatic visual effects?
Bible characters brought to life on-screen?
Isn’t it amazing how they all combine
to make what happened thousands of years ago
seem so real, so vivid, and so faith-strengthening?
Now let’s enjoy this month’s postcard
as together we climb the peaks of Switzerland.
About 70 percent of Switzerland
is covered by mountains.
Its tallest mountain rises to 4,634 meters,
or over 15,000 feet, above sea level.
Switzerland has four official languages: German,
French, Italian, and Romansh,
a descendant language of the Latin spoken in the Roman Empire.
Switzerland has beautiful waterfalls,
glaciers, lakes,
rivers, streams,
and alpine meadows.
Cows graze these meadows,
and from their milk, the Swiss make
about 450 varieties of delicious cheese.
Switzerland is also well-known
for another treat: chocolate.
In fact, the Swiss consume more chocolate per person
than people in any other country in the world!
Since Switzerland didn’t participate in World War I,
it provided an ideal location to establish
the first Central European branch office of Jehovah’s Witnesses
in the early 1920’s.
During World War II, Jehovah’s Witnesses from Switzerland
helped to provide waters of truth to other countries in Europe.
At great effort and cost, our brothers found ways
to get spiritual food to their brothers in Nazi Germany.
After World War II, our Swiss brothers generously donated
food, clothing, and money to support the brotherhood
as part of the first large-scale relief effort
of our modern-day organization.
Today, over 19,000 Witnesses across the country
meet in 264 congregations
as well as in 39 groups
or pregroups in 26 languages.
Even though a small percentage of the population speaks Romansh,
our fellow Witnesses make a concerted effort
to reach them in the language of their heart.
The 53 publishers in the Bever Congregation
are busy spreading Kingdom truth.
The Kingdom Hall in Bever is located in the middle of the Alps
at a height of some 1,700 meters, or 5,500 feet,
making it one of the highest Kingdom Halls
in all of Europe.
The congregation has 10 regular pioneers
and also hosts an Italian group
supported by 15 publishers.
The Bever Congregation sends its warm love
to our worldwide family.
From the World Headquarters of Jehovah’s Witnesses,
this is JW Broadcasting.

cn.text: 我们热烈地欢迎
各位亲爱的弟兄姐妹
欢迎你们收看本月的电视节目
请先了解一下本期节目有哪些精彩内容
箴言3:5鼓励我们
“要全心信赖耶和华”
我们会看看三位弟兄各自面对什么难题
他们又怎样靠着耶和华的帮助
克服了这些难题
被霸凌刚开始可能程度并不严重
但很快会让人感到孤立、无用
甚至怀疑自己的价值
本期《年少时的我》
我们会看看查利和费琳怎样学会应对霸凌
以及后来怎样变得更坚强、更有信心
在本期节目中
我们还会见到两位老朋友
安娜和小漠
我们会看看她们在面对虚假不实的报导时
怎样对耶和华保持忠贞
没错，有很多精彩节目等着我们观看
欢迎收看2022年9月的JW电视
今天我演讲的题目是
《耶和华的绵羊不会听陌生人的声音》
据估计
现在地球上动物的种类达到1500万种
在这些动物当中
圣经常常用哪一种动物来代表正义的人呢？
就是绵羊
耶稣常常用绵羊作比喻
我们举三个例子
第一
在马太福音10:16，他对十二使徒说
“现在我派你们出去
好像把绵羊派到狼群当中”
第二，在马太福音25:32,33
耶稣说在哈米吉多顿之前不久
他会把所有国族的人分开
“就像牧人把绵羊山羊分开一样”
他在后面的经文里说
绵羊般的人会得到永远的生命
而山羊般的人会遭受永远的毁灭
第三个例子
耶稣在约翰福音10:16说
“我还有另外的绵羊，不在这个羊圈里
我必须把它们带来
它们会听我的声音
并且合成一群，归一个牧人”
你可能会问
为什么耶稣要用绵羊
来比喻那些会得到永远生命的人呢？
很显然，这是因为绵羊拥有一些很好的特质
绵羊很合群
是一种群居动物
它们不喜欢单独行动
这样很好，因为可以得到羊群和牧人的保护
不然它们就会很危险
碰到狮子或熊就麻烦了
它们就只能可怜地
再见，小绵羊
绵羊还有一个很好的特质，就是很温顺
不像山羊
那么好斗
小时候
我和弟弟很喜欢跟外公养的山羊玩
我们没有注意的时候
山羊就会偷偷地跑到我们身后
毫无理由地冲过来撞我们
绵羊拥有这些很好的特质
所以用它们来比喻正义的人非常恰当
但我们今天会集中讨论绵羊的一种特质
就是约翰福音10:4,5里面谈到的
是哪一种特质呢？
绵羊会听自己牧人的声音
但不会听陌生人的声音
谈到绵羊的这种特质
《守望台》2004年9月1日刊写到
请问问自己
作为耶和华的绵羊
我乐意听从好牧人的声音吗？
听到陌生人的声音时
我会远远地避开吗？
我们讨论一下吧
最初的陌生人就是魔鬼撒但
撒但让一条蛇仿佛会开口说话
但实际上说的都是他的话
撒但就这样用自己的声音诋毁耶和华
欺骗夏娃
今天，撒但继续发出邪恶的声音
但不是通过蛇
而是通过一些人
无论这些人是有意的还是无意的
但他们实际上都在被撒但操控
接下来我们会讨论三个方面
看看好牧人告诉我们怎么做
并看看撒但和他所操控的人
发出什么完全不同的声音
我们必须留意，要听从好牧人的声音
第一方面
我们先看看好牧人怎么说
我们知道，在1919年
主人耶稣视察时看到
“忠信睿智的奴隶”正在为仆役们提供食物
在未来不久
主人会委派奴隶管理所有财物
我们学到什么呢？
很显然，甚至现在
耶稣就完全信任忠信睿智的奴隶
我们所有人
包括中央长老团的每一位成员
也要信任奴隶
那陌生人的声音在这方面又怎么说呢？
“不要相信忠信的奴隶
他会误导你们！”
谁常常宣传这个错误的信息呢？
就是叛道的人
希伯来书13:9说这样的道理
是“奇奇怪怪的道理”
它们都是陌生人宣传的道理
这些奇奇怪怪的道理也包括
说忠信的奴隶包庇恋童癖
也说忠信的奴隶会剥削你们
好让自己生活奢华
这些都是彻头彻尾的谎言
使徒行传20:30
说叛道者会“颠倒是非”
他们这样做是为了拉拢门徒
让门徒跟随他们
颠倒是非的话就是被扭曲的不正确的话
叛道者怎样颠倒是非呢？
有时候他们会故意隐瞒重要的细节
有时会断章取义
还有些时候他们会用一些方法
把真的说成假的或半真半假的
彼得后书2:3说
似是而非的东西看起来仿佛是真的一样
比如，假钞
看起来好像是真的
但实际上是假的，毫无价值
如果我们接受了假钞，就会蒙受损失
但如果我们接受了叛道者似是而非的话
我们就会失去生命
叛道者根本不可能给我们
任何有价值的东西来补偿我们
请想想
当你很需要一个仁慈的牧养探访时
叛道者能鼓励安慰你吗？
同样地
媒体上有时会有对耶和华组织的报导
对这些报导我们也要小心
媒体报导通常都会受到偏见、仇恨
和利益的影响
在今天
虚假不实的报导非常普遍
比如，在一个欧洲国家媒体报导说
一个年轻的耶和华见证人女子因为
拒绝输血而死了
很多人读到报导就很生气
但这是全部的事实吗？
不是
虽然那位姐妹因为信仰的缘故拒绝接受输血
但她愿意接受其他无输血的疗法
医院本来可以马上用这些方法
来挽救她的生命
但是
医院人员故意拖延
结果延误时机
而这一切媒体却没有提
当然
不是所有媒体上的报导都不值得信任
但我们还是要小心
因为约翰一书5:19这样说
“全世界都受那恶者控制”
我们来考虑第二方面
先看看好牧人耶稣怎么说
在马太福音5:27,28
耶稣说
好牧人提醒我们
不仅要避免犯下性不道德
也要避开任何可能让我们犯下性不道德的事
包括不道德的想法
在马太福音19:9
好牧人提醒我们说
耶稣说得很清楚
从上帝的角度来看
离婚、再婚的唯一正当理由
就是配偶不忠
犯下通奸罪
但在撒但的世界里
陌生人的声音关于离婚、通奸
和其他性不道德怎么说呢？
“没问题
这是你的自由
你想做什么就可以做什么”
实际上
为了让性不道德听起来不那么糟糕
人们甚至会美化它
一些不道德的性行为，包括同性恋
被称为另一种生活方式
一个所谓的专家说
这就像有些人生来就是左撇子一样！
色情资讯被说成是成人娱乐
一个人对配偶不忠
被说成是有了婚外情
很多人觉得结婚已经太老套了
未婚同居完全没什么问题
而这个世界的娱乐非常善于包装和美化恶事
比如，在一部电影里
女主角的丈夫对她非常粗暴无礼
你很喜欢她，希望她生活幸福
然后一个很帅的男子成了她的同事
对她也很好
他们就这样互相吸引
彼此之间的恋情看起来非常浪漫
再加上柔和的背景音乐
谁都不会觉得她做得有什么错
观众会很想看到女主角离开丈夫
跟同事一起生活
通常电影结尾就是这样
我们会很容易忘记耶和华和耶稣憎恨通奸
和没有圣经根据的离婚
但如果我们不听这个世界上陌生人的声音
而听从耶和华和耶稣
我们就能为自己和别人
带来保护和福分
我们再来讨论第三个方面
先看看好牧人怎么说
在马太福音第6章
我们会读一下19和20节
耶稣提醒我们
要专注于崇拜耶和华而不是聚集财富
他的话对生活在我们这个时代的人尤其重要
因为现在是最后日子的最后阶段的最后时刻
在这方面
陌生人的声音又鼓吹什么道理呢？
“你必须勤奋地工作
这样你才能拥有更多
要让自己生活舒适
因为这样你才会感到幸福和快乐”
但问题是
我们会听谁的呢？
耶和华和耶稣告诉我们
现在要以比喻性的乐园为足
要专注于传道救人的工作
以后，他们会赐给我们一个实际的乐园
彼得前书2:11提醒我们
要把自己当成“寄居的”人
我们要穿过这个旧的制度，进入新世界
得享真正的生命
这里说的“寄居的”是什么意思呢？
请想象一下，你租了一个老房子住
因为你自己的房子正在修建当中
你只会在老房子住几个月
你会购买全套的新家具吗？
你会购买很多的新电器吗？
你会为这个房子换地板吗？
不会
当然，为了住得舒适一点
你可能会做一些小的改动
但不会进行大装修
为什么呢？
因为你只是临时地住在那里
很快你就会搬进自己漂亮的新家了
如果我们记得自己在这个旧制度里
只是临时寄居的
就能保护自己
避免受到这个世界所鼓吹的物质至上的影响
我们讨论了耶稣在三个方面给我们的提醒
我们还可以举出其他例子
对比好牧人的声音和陌生人的声音
愿我们都保持警惕
留心听好牧人的声音
谈到耶稣
耶和华亲口说
“这是我的儿子
是我深爱的，是我认可的
你们要听从他”
作为耶和华的绵羊
要乐意听从耶稣的声音
我们就必须避开陌生人的声音
但如果“陌生人的声音”
是通过你特别亲密的人传来的
比如你的好朋友或者你的家人
又怎样呢？
小漠就遇到了这样很不容易处理的情况
请观看接下来的短片
看看小漠是怎么做的
阿们
好香啊！
喔！等等我忘了
每晚都该你做饭
那都你打扫？
那我们还是轮流吧
当当！
哇，看起来好好吃喔！
谢啦，这是为我的第一个客人练练手

title: 우리의 조직이 이루고 있는 일들—모든 전도인을 지원하는 일

ko.text: 회중을 통해 사랑에 찬 지원을 받습니다.
병원 교섭 위원회 마련을 감독하는 일이 있습니다.
“가서 … 모든 민족의 사람들을 제자로 삼으라”고 명령하셨습니다.
따라서 우리는 예수께서 이 일을 인도하고 계시다는 것을 기억합니다.
전 세계의 형제 자매들이 어디에 살고 있든지
효과적으로 봉사를 수행할 수 있도록 돕기 위해 많은 노력을 기울입니다.
매주 3000명이 넘는 새로운 제자들이 침례를 받고 있습니다.
전파 활동이 전 세계의 239개 나라와 지역에서 수행되고 있죠.
봉사 위원회는 중앙장로회의 인도를 받으며 일합니다.
중요한 문제들은 중앙장로회에 보내 지침을 구합니다.
봉사 도구함에 무엇을 넣을지 정하는 문제가 있죠.
어떤 출판물을 봉사를 위한 기본적인 도구에 포함시킬지 신중하게 고려합니다.
그러한 도구의 수가 그리 많지 않기 때문에
생산적인 성서 연구를 시작하고 사회할 수 있습니다.
많은 분이 도움이 더 필요한 곳으로 이주합니다.
그렇게 하면 다른 형태의 봉사를 시작할 기회가 열리죠.
특별 전 시간 봉사를 할 수도 있습니다.
순회 활동을 하도록 임명될 수 있습니다.
세계적인 전파 활동을 지원할 수 있습니다.
잘 조직되어 있다는 점을 분명히 알려 줍니다.
“성경 원칙을 찾기는 빨리하고 규칙을 만들기는 더디한다.”
우리가 불완전하고 실수를 한다는 점을 기억하죠.
하지만 장로들이 형제 자매들 곁에 있으면서
그들을 격려하고 회중을 영적으로 깨끗하게 유지합니다.
우리는 장로와 순회 감독자 여러분을 정말 사랑합니다.
막중한 책임을 수행하고 계신 여러분은 소중한 분들입니다.
따라서 전 세계 형제 자매들의 필요에 맞게
영적 양식과 신권 지침을 제공하는 것은
그래서 우리는 80여 개 지역의 지부들과 정기적으로 소통하죠.
중앙장로회의 눈과 귀가 되어 주기 때문에
우리는 무엇이 필요한지 알 수 있습니다.
봉사 위원회는 모든 지부 사무실들에 있는 봉사부를 통해 신권 지침을 전달합니다.
그 지침을 전 세계의 약 7000명의 순회 감독자들과
최선을 다해 봉사를 수행할 수 있도록 돕기 위해
지부를 위한 양 치는 방문을 할 때
그 양 떼를 잘 먹이고 돌봐야 한다는 점을요.
회중 형제 자매들이 격려를 받는 것과 비슷하죠.
그에 따라 꼭 필요한 격려와 지원을 베풀 수 있습니다.
우리가 더 잘 연합하는 데 도움이 되죠.
우리는 자기희생적인 태도로 열심히 일하는 여러분을 정말 사랑합니다.
우리는 여러분이 여호와의 일을 하고 있으며,
그 일이 늘 쉽지만은 않다는 걸 압니다.
전파 활동을 사랑하는 것을 볼 수 있습니다.
여호와를 위해 기꺼이 일하는 여러분을 보면서
병원 교섭 위원회는 정말 중요한 일을 하고 있습니다.
여호와의 조직은 언제나 신속하게 도움을 베풀어 줍니다.
병원 교섭 위원회의 활동에 관해 더 자세히 알기 위해
「고난의 때를 위한 사랑의 마련」이라는 동영상을 시청해 보시기 바랍니다.
사랑하는 사람이 큰 사고를 당했다는 걸 알게 되는 것만큼 겁이 나는 일도 없을 겁니다.
여호와께서는 병원 교섭 위원회 마련을 통해
틀림없이 우리의 전파 활동은 계속 확장될 것이며

en.text: All over the world as Jehovah’s people,
we preach to all who will listen
and we receive loving support
from our congregations.
But how is the global preaching work organized?
How do congregations stay united
around the world?
The Service Committee of the Governing Body oversees these tasks.
Their responsibilities
are to oversee the preaching work,
to oversee congregation organization,
and to oversee the Hospital Liaison Committee arrangement.
First, consider how the Service Committee supports you in the preaching work.
Coordinating the worldwide preaching work
is an awesome privilege
for the Service Committee,
but we know that it was Jesus who gave the commission
to “go, . . . and make disciples of people of all the nations.”
And so we recognize that Jesus is the one in charge.
A real effort is made
to provide assistance
so that our brothers and sisters, wherever they are,
can effectively fulfill their personal ministry.
For example, in recent years, we’ve seen the introduction
of special metropolitan public witnessing,
prison witnessing,
harbor witnessing,
and reaching out to displaced individuals —for example, individuals in refugee camps.
And depending on our schedule or our circumstances,
opportunities to witness informally
may present the best way
that we can fulfill our personal ministry.
Well over 3,000 new disciples
are being baptized every week.
And the preaching work is being done in 239 lands
around the globe.
The Service Committee works
under the direction of the Governing Body.
We send significant matters
to the Governing Body for direction.
An example is the establishing of the Teaching Toolbox.
The Service Committee
gives very close attention
to what publications would be considered
as basic tools for the ministry.
And because there are relatively few of those, all of us
can become very well-acquainted with them.
And thus we’re able to become very effective in the ministry in preaching the good news
and in starting and conducting productive Bible studies.
A number of you are moving
to serve where the need is greater.
Many of you are simplifying your life
and, in some cases, a number of you
are learning and adapting to new cultures.
Many thousands have entered into the pioneer service.
Now, this opens up other avenues of service, such as serving where the need is greater,
serving on construction projects,
and even entering into special full-time service.
A special full-time servant does not mean
that they themselves are special.
What is special
is the assignment they receive.
Those in special full-time service
might be assigned to serve as a special pioneer or as a field missionary
or in the circuit work.
We need you young brothers and sisters to set spiritual goals:
to go to SKE,
(for you young brothers) to qualify to be ministerial servants and elders,
and (you sisters) to want to be pioneers and missionaries
to drive the work ahead worldwide.
Brothers and sisters, when we see your love for the preaching work,
it is so heartwarming for us.
No matter what your circumstances,
you’re doing your best to share the good news.
First Corinthians 14:33, 40
tells us that Jehovah wants things to be done ‘orderly’
and “by arrangement.”
The Scriptures confirm that the heavenly part of Jehovah’s organization
is well-organized.
The earthly part must be as well.
Our motto is,
“Fast on principles and slow on rules.”
By holding to what is written in the Scriptures,
we uphold Jehovah’s thinking,
knowing that we’re imperfect
—not infallible.
As the Bible clearly says,
we are not ‘the masters over others’ faith.’
Our brothers and sisters are under much pressure these days.
There’s the spirit of the world,
there are health problems,
there’s persecution, and there are disasters.
But the elders are there
with the brothers and sisters, encouraging them
and keeping the congregations clean.
We love you dear elders and circuit overseers
and respect you for the heavy load you carry.
We have congregations in over 200 lands
and in hundreds of languages,
so providing spiritual food in the form of theocratic direction
that meets the needs of the brothers and sisters worldwide
is not an easy task.
So we’re in communication with the branch offices
in over 80 lands.
Those brothers on the Branch Committees are like eyes and ears
to the Governing Body and, as a result, we know what the needs are.
The Service Committee sends out theocratic direction
by means of the Service Departments in all the branch offices.
As soon as the Service Departments get that information,
they begin translating it,
and then they ensure that it’s distributed
to some 7,000 circuit overseers
and over 700,000 elders worldwide.
That means that that announcement
or that information will then reach your congregation.
Like Jesus did with his disciples,
we want to do everything we can to help you
to carry out your personal ministry
to the best of your abilities and, of course, circumstances.
When making headquarters visits or shepherding visits to the branches,
I keep in mind that I’m visiting Jehovah’s sheep
and that they have to be cared for and fed.
It’s very similar to the excitement
that’s generated when congregations have the visit of their circuit overseer.
That same excitement is generated, albeit on a larger scale,
when representatives come to the branches.
It allows for that personal interaction
where you can correspond with the branches to give them the encouragement they need
with things that they may need assistance with.
It has a tremendous unifying effect.
We love you dear brothers for your self-sacrificing spirit
and the hard work that you do.
We know that you’re doing Jehovah’s work,
and we know that it’s not always easy.
Wherever we go in the world,
we see the love that you brothers and sisters have
for Jehovah and for the preaching work.
And when we see what you’re willing to do for Jehovah, it warms our hearts
and encourages us to keep going.
The work of the Hospital Liaison Committees
is something that is very precious.
When we need help,
Jehovah’s organization is there to provide it.
To help us become
better acquainted
with the Hospital Liaison Committee arrangement,
we should all take a look at the video
A Loving Provision for Times of Distress.
There’s nothing more frightening than learning that we have a serious disease
or learning that a loved one has been in a serious accident.
Jehovah has given us the HLC arrangement
to provide the comfort, the encouragement, and the strength
that we need at those difficult times.
We cherish our privilege to preach and worship together.
In this divided world, our peace, love, and unity
are a modern-day miracle.
With Jehovah’s blessing, we are confident
that the preaching work will continue to advance
and that the congregations will “be made firm in the faith.”

en.text: We’ve been asking people the question,
Where can we find practical advice for daily living?
What are your thoughts?
Hmm, I don’t know.
Sometimes I ask my friends for advice if I’m not sure what to do.
Thank you.
Friends can offer helpful advice, that’s for sure.
This ancient book of wisdom mentions another source.
Anna, would you please read for us 2 Timothy 3:16, 17?
Sure.
It says: “All Scripture is inspired of God
“and beneficial for teaching, for reproving,
“for setting things straight,
“for disciplining in righteousness,
“so that the man of God may be fully competent,
completely equipped for every good work.”
Thank you.
So did you see in those verses
how the Scriptures, or God’s Word, can help us?
Um, it says: “teaching, . . . disciplining.”
Exactly.
And what do the Scriptures equip us for?
“Every good work”?
Exactly! You got it.
The Bible can help us to improve our lives.
For instance, how can we deal with stress?
How can we enjoy our work?
Or how can our families be happy?
The Bible comments on all of those topics.
Wow!
I thought it was just a religious book.
Many people aren’t aware of the Bible’s practical value.
Other people say that the Bible is full of myths or legends.
The next time I stop by, I’d like to discuss why we can trust the Bible.
Will you be home again next week at this time?
Yeah, I should be around.
Great! Do you text?
If you’d like, I can send you a text before I come.
OK.

title: 음란물을 보는 것은 하느님께 죄를 짓는 것입니까?

ko.text: 과거에는 성인 극장, 서점, 신문 가판대에 가야 음란물을 볼 수 있었습니다.
하지만 이제는 터치 한 번이면 어디서나 음란물을 볼 수 있습니다.
고대 문화에서도 외설적인 예술품들을 찾아볼 수 있는데
때로는 그러한 것들이 숭배에 사용되기도 했습니다.
오늘날 종교가 있는 사람들 중에도 음란물이 해롭지 않기 때문에
봐도 문제가 되지 않는다고 생각하는 사람들이 있습니다.
반면에 성경을 읽는 사람들 중 일부는 음란물이나 외설서적을 보는 것이 해로우며
심지어 하느님께 죄를 짓는 것이라고 생각합니다.
하느님께서 성과 관련된 문제들을 어떻게 여기시는지 분명히 알 수 있습니다.
즉 배우자가 아닌 사람과의 성적 행위를 어떻게 여기시는지 이렇게 분명히 알려 줍니다.
“성적 부도덕을 저지르는 자[는] 하느님의 왕국을 상속받지 못할 것입니다.”
예수께서는 부도덕한 욕망을 자극하는 것도 죄라고 가르치셨습니다.
“누구든지 여자를 계속 바라보고 정욕을 품는 사람은
마음으로 이미 그 여자와 간음한 것입니다.”
“성적 부도덕, 더러움, 무절제한 성욕[과] 관련해 … 몸의 지체를 죽이십시오”라고 권고합니다.
음란물을 보는 것은 부도덕하고 더러운 성적 욕망을 불러일으키며
그러한 욕망을 “죽이”라고 즉 억누르라고 한 성경 말씀에 정반대되는 것입니다.
성경 야고보서 1:14, 15은 무절제한 욕망의 결과에 대해 이렇게 경고합니다.
그리고 욕망이 자라면 죄를 낳고, 죄가 이루어지면 죽음을 낳습니다.”
따라서 그분은 우리가 사람들이 그런 행동을 하는 것을 보는 것도 매우 싫어하실 것입니다.
우리가 음란물을 보든, 읽든, 듣든 하느님께서는 그러한 행동을 모두 매우 불쾌하게 여기십니다.
하느님은 남편과 아내가 결혼 관계 내에서 사랑과 애정을 나누기를 바라십니다.
하지만 음란물을 포함해 모든 종류의 성적 더러움을 미워하십니다.
다른 나쁜 습관들처럼 음란물을 보는 습관도 극복할 수 있습니다.
많은 사람이 하느님의 도움으로 실제로 그렇게 했습니다.
이러한 점과 그 밖의 질문들에 대한 성경의 답을 알아보려면

en.text: Once relegated to adult theaters, bookstores, or newsstands,
today pornography is everywhere
—only a click or a tap away.
It is not new.
Erotic art existed in ancient cultures.
For some, it was even a part of their worship.
Today, even some religious people
feel that pornography is harmless
and therefore acceptable.
On the other hand,
some who read the Bible feel that pornography and erotic literature
are harmful, even a sin against God.
What is God’s view of pornography?
Though the word “pornography” doesn’t appear in the Bible,
the Bible’s principles make very clear how God feels about sexual matters.
First Corinthians 6:9, 10
leaves no doubt about God’s view of sexual immorality,
sexual acts outside of marriage.
“Those who are sexually immoral . . .
will not inherit God’s Kingdom.”
Jesus told us that fueling immoral desires
is also sinful.
He said:
“Everyone who keeps on looking at a woman
“so as to have a passion for her
“has already committed adultery with her
in his heart.”
At Colossians 3:5, we are told
to “deaden . . . [our] body members . . .
“as respects sexual immorality,
uncleanness, uncontrolled sexual passion.”
Pornography arouses immoral, unclean sexual desires
—the very opposite of what we are told to do:
“deaden,” or suppress, them.
The Bible warns what uncontrolled desire can lead to.
James 1:14, 15 says:
“[We are] . . . drawn out and enticed by [our] own desire.
“Then the desire, when it has become fertile,
“gives birth to sin;
“in turn sin, when it has been carried out,
brings forth death.”
If God condemns immoral acts,
clearly he would disapprove of us watching people engage in such acts.
Pornography, whether we watch it, read it, or listen to it,
must be highly offensive to God.
God wants husbands and wives to enjoy
love and intimacy in their marriage.
But he hates all forms of sexual uncleanness, including pornography.
Like any bad habit,
viewing pornography can be overcome.
And many, with God’s help,
have successfully done so.
To learn more about what the Bible says
on this and many other topics,
go to jw.org.

ko.text: 자연재해는 우리에게 아주 큰 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다.

자연재해는 모두 그분이 일으키시는 것이라고 생각합니다.
사방이 흔들렸고 순식간에 건물이 무너져 내렸습니다.

부상이 너무 심해서 다리 한쪽을 절단해야 했어요.
하느님은 왜 우리가 이런 일을 겪게 하시는 거지?’
‘내가 뭘 잘못했길래 하느님이 이런 벌을 내리시는 거지?’
하느님의 가장 두드러진 특성이 사랑이라고 알려 줍니다.
자연을 이용해 사람들을 벌하신다고 생각할 만한 내용은 없습니다.
하지만 많은 고통과 죽음을 가져오는 자연재해는 계속 일어납니다.
우리에게 관심도 있으시다면 자연재해는 왜 일어나는 것입니까?
하느님 때문에 우리가 고통스러운 일을 겪는 것이 아니라
“예기치 못한 일”이 누구에게나 일어날 수 있다는 걸 배웠어요.
하느님이 우리에게 벌을 내리시는 게 아니죠.
하루는 저처럼 지진으로 다리를 잃은 친구가
여호와의 증인들이 이 땅이 낙원이 될 거라는 성구를 보여 줬다고 말하더라고요.
이전처럼 걷고 달리고 춤을 출 수 있다는 거예요.
모든 걸 완벽하게 만드실 거라는 확신이 들었습니다.
이사야 35:6의 “저는 사람이 사슴처럼 뛸” 거라는 여호와의 약속을 읽고
절대 선한 사람들에게 고통을 주지 않으실 거라는 점을 이해하게 되었죠.
전 하느님에 대한 거짓말을 들으면서 살아왔어요.
하지만 이제는 여호와의 약속들이 반드시 이루어질 것이라고 믿습니다.
성경은 하느님이 자연재해를 일으키시는 것이 아니라고 분명히 알려 줍니다.
사실 그분은 모든 고통과 고난을 없앨 것이라고 이렇게 약속하십니다.
그분이 그들과 함께 거하실 것이며, 그들은 그분의 백성이 될 것이다.
하느님께서 친히 그들과 함께 계실 것이다.
그분은 그들의 눈에서 모든 눈물을 닦아 주실 것이다.
더 이상 죽음이 없고, 슬픔과 부르짖음과 고통도 더는 없을 것이다.
이전 것들이 다 사라져 버린 것이다.”
하지만 하느님이 사랑이시라면 왜 고통을 허용하십니까?
그분은 당신이 겪는 고통에 대해 어떻게 느끼십니까?
우리가 고통을 겪는 일은 언제 끝날 것입니까?
이 질문들과 그 밖의 질문들에 대한 성경의 답을 알아보려면

en.text: Disasters can shake us to our core.
They can take away everything we have,
in some cases, even our loved ones.
Faced with such tragedy, many think these disasters are “acts of God,”
perhaps even his punishment.
Some may feel that since God, the Creator of the universe,
has the power to control the forces of nature,
when natural disasters occur, they must be his doing.
We were on the fifth floor
of our apartment building when an earthquake hit.
Everything shook,
and in just seconds the building collapsed.
The hurricane destroyed everything.
I was terrified.
When I woke up, I realized I was trapped.
I couldn’t move.
I lay there for two days before rescuers found me.
When I was in the hospital, my injuries were so severe
that I had to lose one of my legs.
I kept thinking: ‘We are good people.
Why would God allow such bad things to happen to us?’
And I thought,
‘What could I have done
to make God so angry with me?’
Are natural disasters really “acts of God”?
What does the Bible say?
At 1 John 4:8,
the Bible assures us that God’s foremost quality is love.
In fact, it says: “God is love.”
He wants us to be happy, to enjoy
all the beautiful things he created, and to benefit from earth’s natural forces.
There is nothing in the Bible to suggest
God is presently using the forces of nature
to punish anyone—wicked or not.
Still, natural disasters
continue to happen and bring suffering and death
to many, including good people.
Since natural disasters are not “acts of God”
and he does care about us, why do they happen?
I learned that God does not cause suffering,
but “time and unexpected events”
may overtake any of us.
But it’s not because God is angry with us.
One day, a friend of mine, who also lost her legs in the earthquake,
told me that Jehovah’s Witnesses showed her from the Bible
that the earth will be a paradise.
We will have our legs again, and we will be able to walk
and run and dance.
That gave me confidence that God loves us very much,
and he’s going to make everything wonderful.
When I read Isaiah 35:6 where Jehovah God
promises that “the lame will leap like the deer,”
I finally understood
that a God who would make that promise
would never hurt good people.
I had been lied to about God.
But now I know
that Jehovah’s promises are real.
The Bible clearly teaches that God
is not responsible for natural disasters.
In fact, he promises to eliminate all causes of pain and suffering.
“Look!
“The tent of God is with mankind,
“and he will reside with them, and they will be his people.
“And God himself will be with them.
“And he will wipe out every tear
“from their eyes, and death will be no more,
“neither will mourning nor outcry
“nor pain be anymore.
The former things have passed away.”
“The former things,” including natural disasters,
will “have passed away.”
But if God is love, why does he allow suffering?
How does he feel about your suffering?
How long will human suffering continue?
To learn more about what the Bible says
on this and many other topics,
go to jw.org.

cn.text: 天灾可能会给我们的生活
带来翻天覆地的影响
我们可能会失去一切
甚至亲朋好友
面对这样的情况
有些人可能觉得
这是上天降下来的灾难
是上帝在惩罚人类
有些人可能认为
既然上帝创造了宇宙
就有能力控制自然界的各种力量
所以他们认为
天灾肯定是上帝一手造成的
我们家住在公寓的五楼
地震发生的时候
我感觉天摇地动
没过几秒钟
整栋楼就倒塌了
飓风……
摧毁了一切
我当时真的吓死了！
当我醒来的时候
我发现我被困在瓦砾堆里
动弹不得
救难队花了两天才找到我
我被送到医院后
医生说……
我的伤势太严重了
有一条腿保不住了
我就想，我没有做什么坏事
我真的不懂上帝为什么会让我遇到这样的事
我就想……
我到底做了什么
让上帝发怒呢？
天灾真的是上帝一手造成的吗？
约翰一书4:8告诉我们
上帝最显著的特质就是爱
经文说
他希望我们过得快乐
享受他所造的一切
他也想用自然界的力量来造福我们
“上帝正在用天灾来惩罚人”这样的观念
并不符合圣经的说法
不过，天灾持续发生
带来痛苦和死亡
连好人也受影响
既然上帝很关心我们
天灾也不是他一手造成的
为什么我们还会遇到这样的事呢？
我学到我会遇到这些事
不是上帝在对我发怒
而是像圣经说的
这些遭遇取决于“时间和无法预料的情况”
我有一个朋友在地震中失去双腿
有一天她跟我说
她从耶和华见证人那里学到
圣经说地球会变成乐园
到时我们不会再有残疾
我们能走、能跑还能跳舞
这让我确定上帝非常爱我
一切都会变得更美好
以赛亚书35:6说
“跛脚的会跳跃如鹿”
既然耶和华上帝作出这么美好的承诺
他是绝对不会伤害好人的
关于上帝，我从以前的宗教学到的
都是谎言
但现在我终于知道
耶和华上帝的承诺是真实可靠的
圣经清楚告诉我们
天灾不是上帝一手造成的
不仅这样，上帝还承诺会消除一切苦难
“从前的事”包括天灾
一定会成为“过去”
既然上帝就是爱
想了解更多相关内容
请上jw.org网站
